raw.title: Capital Markets Compliance Lead
raw.excerpt: Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide.
raw.description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.


Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.


Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.


As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.


We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.


Collectors is seeking a Capital Markets Compliance Lead to build the governance, oversight and integrity of its market-facing activity across grading, custody, pricing data and marketplaces. You will report to the Head of Risk & Compliance and work closely with Legal, Product, Engineering, Finance and business leaders.


Our businesses sit unusually close to the market: we authenticate, store, price, publish data about and help sell the assets themselves. We hold our market conduct to a capital-markets standard because collectors and partners make financial decisions based on our grades, prices and custody. This role is strategic: you will design and inspect controls and set the standard.

What You'll Do

Build a firm-wide markets compliance framework that is risk-based, auditable and scalable, and keep it current as our product set grows. Understand how our roles as grader, custodian, data and index publisher, and marketplace operator interact while documenting and implementing controls around each of those roles.


Market Integrity and Information Controls:

  • Design the controls around market-sensitive, non-public information: grading and population data before release, pricing and index changes, vault holdings and transaction activity. This includes wall-crossing, restricted and watch lists, access controls and escalation, treated with the seriousness of a securities-market information barrier.
  • Own the employee and insider trading framework for relevant assets: pre-clearance, personal-trading and holdings rules, blackout periods, attestations, surveillance and escalation. Align with Legal and HR and the existing employee market participation policy.
  • Oversee conflict-of-interest management across all of our roles, including vendor solutions, and report it to executives and the board as necessary.
  • Lead internal investigations of suspected misuse, working with Legal and Employee Relations.

Pricing, Index and Data Governance:

  • Build the governance framework for the prices, valuations and indexes we publish: methodology, change control, error handling, complaints and conflicts.
  • Design and implement controls over how partners and licensees use Collectors grades, prices and data in their own marketing. Much of this is rigorous documentation.
  • Review data and pricing products, licensing and marketing for accuracy, fairness and regulatory risk, including claims about performance, accuracy and ratings.
  • Embed controls over data quality and pricing inputs where people rely on them to make financial decisions.

Transactions and Fair Dealing:

  • Design the compliance program for the transactions we facilitate: fair-dealing standards, pricing and disclosure, what we are obliged to deliver, and settlement controls.
  • Address the risk of self-dealing and side-dealing: trading ahead, principal versus agent conflicts, undisclosed interests, and staff or affiliate participation.

Products, Partners and the Business

  • Provide compliance input into new products and features from inception, with a fast new-product review that gives product teams a clear answer with documented conditions.
  • Work with Legal and outside counsel on regulatory questions, and turn their conclusions into operating controls.
  • Run due diligence and ongoing oversight of commercial and data partners, including review of their marketing and disclosures.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, including teaching executives how well-run market businesses manage conduct risk, what regulators look for, and what has to be true before a new product ships.
  • Be a systems thinker: automate monitoring, attestations, testing and reporting wherever regulation allows, so the program is data-driven and scales without headcount.
  • Build and develop a markets compliance team over time. Produce reporting for executive and board audiences on conflicts, attestations, exceptions, testing and open issues.

Who You Are

  • 8+ years in markets, capital markets or investment compliance experience at an exchange, trading platform, broker-dealer, asset manager, or index or market-data provider. A broad alternative-assets or digital-assets platform is a strong fit.
  • Deep hands-on experience with MNPI, information barriers and wall-crossing, restricted and watch lists, pre-clearance, personal-trading surveillance and code-of-ethics programs.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. securities and markets regulation and of marketing and communications standards, the judgment to apply them by analogy where they do not strictly reach, and the instinct to bring in counsel at the right time.
  • Understanding of trading mechanics, market microstructure, fair dealing and principal versus agent conflicts.
  • Experience reviewing investment marketing, disclosures, and data or research products.
  • Familiarity with surveillance technology and data-driven monitoring.
  • Experience building a program in a business adopting market-conduct standards for the first time; treats controls as how we get to yes.
  • Can explain regulatory expectations to senior executives and coach non-specialists, with results you can describe with numbers (for example exam findings closed, program coverage, review turnaround).

Salary Range:

The salary range for this position is $157,000 - $200,000. Actual compensation within this range varies based on a variety of factors, including location, job level, experience, and skill set. This role may be eligible for bonuses or other forms of compensation; please ask your recruiter for more details.

Reasons To Join Us

  • Health Insurance: All full-time employees are eligible to enroll in Medical, Dental, and Vision.
  • Additional Benefits: Full-time employees are eligible for fertility, commuter, and educational assistance benefits.
  • 401(K) Matching Plan: We are proud to offer a competitive 401k matching plan to support your future financial goals.
  • Vacation: All salaried employees are eligible for flexible time-off.
  • Holiday Pay: All regular, full-time employees are eligible for ten company-paid holidays.
  • Employee Discounts: Employees receive discounts on select grading services for approved submissions.

Collectors uses e-Verify to validate your ability to work legally in the United States.


We are aware that there are instances where individuals are receiving job offers that fraudulently allege to be from Collectors or one of our business units. This type of fraud can be carried out through false websites, through fake e-mails claiming to be from the company or through social media. We never ask for personal information such as your bank account, Social Security numbers or National IDs, nor do we send or request payments for the purchase of business-related equipment. If you suspect fraud, please reach out to .


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. We believe that a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills will better service the diverse community of collectors we support.


If you require an accommodation to apply or interview with us due to a disability or special need, please email .


U.S. residents: for disclosures relating to personal information we collect during the employment application and recruitment process, please see ourPrivacy Notice for U.S. Applicants.


For New York Residents: In connection with hiring, Collectors Universe, Inc. uses an automated employment decision tool (Brighthire) to assist in evaluating candidates. Collectors Universe, Inc. began using this tool in October 2026. In accordance with NYC Local Law 144, a summary of the most recent independent bias audit of this tool is available from Brighthire . To request information about the type of data collected, its source, and our data retention policy, contact .

raw.title: Remote Bilingual Mandarin Customer Experience Specialist
raw.excerpt: Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail.
raw.description:
Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first.We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

The Customer Experience Specialist plays a critical role in delivering compassionate, seamless service to our valued members — primarily older adults and individuals with disabilities. This role goes beyond answering questions; it is about building caring connections, owning the member experience, and always resolving issues completely and correctly the first time. This is a remote role that requires compliance to work only within the contiguous US.
Customer Experience Specialists take personal responsibility for each interaction — listening deeply, advocating for the member, navigating complex systems, and following through until resolution is achieved. Every contact is an opportunity to make health care easier, clearer, and more supportive for our members.

Job Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Build caring connections with every member by always leading with empathy, patience, and respect, ensuring members feel heard, supported, and valued throughout every interaction.
  • Own each member interaction end-to-end, taking accountability to resolve inquiries during the initial contact and ensuring clear follow-through when additional steps are required.
  • Deliver exceptional service by consistently exceeding member expectations and reinforcing a culture focused on trust, compassion, and first-call resolution.
  • Accurately respond to member inquiries regarding benefits, eligibility, services, policies, and procedures in a clear, confident, and member-friendly manner.
  • Assist members with provider network and claim/reimbursement inquiries, benefit questions related to transportation, food, dental and other support services and needs, proactively identifying solutions and next steps.
  • Answer incoming contacts within established service levels while always managing complex and sensitive situations with professionalism and care.
  • Thoroughly document all member interactions, actions taken, and outcomes in real time to ensure accuracy, continuity of care and effective resolution.
  • Proactively address member complaints, grievances, and disenrollment concerns with goal to resolve by listening for root causes, offering solutions, and escalating appropriately when needed.
  • Support outbound outreach initiatives and service programs designed to improve engagement, education, and overall member experience.
  • Represent Alignment Healthcare with integrity and positivity, modeling a serving-heart mindset and commitment to excellence in every interaction.
  • Participate actively in ongoing coaching, feedback, and learning to continuously strengthen service skills and member advocacy.

Hourly Rate $20


Job Requirements:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.


Required: Mandarin Bilingual (Speak, Read, Write)


Experience:

  • 2+ years of customer service, contact center, or member support experience, preferably in healthcare and/or Medicare Advantage.
  • Relevant college coursework or an Associate/Bachelor’s degree may be considered in lieu of experience.
  • Proficient in navigating multiple systems simultaneously, including Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, CRM and Contact Center solutions.
  • On camera presence for training, one on one, team and group meetings.
  • Workspace must be free of distractions with the ability to maintain strict confidentiality and compliance with HIPAA regulations.
  • Sufficient internet bandwidth and access to connect with Alignment’s systems during scheduled shift.
  • Proper care and availability of technology equipment such as headsets, keyboard, to perform responsibilities without impact on operational and scheduled shift requirements.
  • Clear, concise and warm verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex information simply and compassionately and ability to document interactions accurately
  • Demonstrated empathy, patience, and respect when working with older adults and individuals with disabilities.
  • Minimum typing speed of 35 WPM.
  • Comfortable working in a culture of continuous coaching, feedback, and performance improvement to meet defined KPIs related to attendance, schedule adherence and quality.
  • Ability to manage high call volumes while handling complex, emotionally sensitive interactions.
  • Flexibility to work shifts to meet business needs.

Education:

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • College degree, Associate’s or Bachelor’s preferred. 3+ years of customer service work experience considered in lieu of degree.

Training:

  • Required: Demonstrated ability to use technology and follow detailed workflow instructions.

Strongly Preferred:


  • Knowledge of Medicare Advantage, Medi-Cal, or managed care plans preferred.

Essential Physical Functions:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee regularly is required to stand, walk, sit, use hand to finger, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; and reach with hands and arms.
  • The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

Pay Range: $41,600.00 - $57,600.00

Pay range may be based on a number of factors including market location, education, responsibilities, experience, etc.

Alignment Health is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation.

*DISCLAIMER: Please beware of recruitment phishing scams affecting Alignment Health and other employers where individuals receive fraudulent employment-related offers in exchange for money or other sensitive personal information. Please be advised that Alignment Health and its subsidiaries will never ask you for a credit card, send you a check, or ask you for any type of payment as part of consideration for employment with our company. If you feel that you have been the victim of a scam such as this, please report the incident to the Federal Trade Commission at If you would like to verify the legitimacy of an email sent by or on behalf of Alignment Health’s talent acquisition team, please email .

description: Overview • World Business Lenders (WBL) is a privately held portfolio lender specializing in real estate-secured business loans for underserved businesses.
location: Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Guatemala, Pakistan

raw.title: Valuation Quality Control/Review Appraiser
raw.excerpt: Overview • World Business Lenders (WBL) is a privately held portfolio lender specializing in real estate-secured business loans for underserved businesses.
raw.description:
Overview

  • World Business Lenders (WBL) is a privately held portfolio lender specializing in real estate-secured business loans for underserved businesses. WBL operates with a fully remote, multinational workforce and an experienced executive leadership team.
  • Typically, the work schedule is from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, though additional hours may be required based on business needs.

About the Role

  • The Valuation Quality Control/Review Appraiser will serve as a subject matter expert in residential or commercial real estate appraisal. The role is responsible for reviewing appraisals and other valuation reports prepared by internal analysts and third-party providers, identifying material deficiencies, and recommending property values to the appropriate committee.
  • This position is focused on appraisal review, quality control, collateral risk assessment, and communication of clear, supportable valuation recommendations. It also entails producing appraisals from start to finish.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently delivers accurate, timely, and defensible valuation recommendations.
  • Identifies material appraisal deficiencies and effectively communicates collateral risks.
  • Provides clear, well-supported recommendations to credit and investment committees.
  • Maintains high-quality, consistent appraisal review standards and supports junior analysts.

What You'll Be Doing (Core Responsibilities)

    • Review residential or commercial appraisals, evaluations, broker price opinions, automated valuation models, inspections, and related valuation reports.
    • Assess the accuracy, completeness, credibility, and suitability of each report for its intended use.
    • Evaluate property characteristics, highest and best use, zoning, market conditions, comparable selection, adjustments, income assumptions, capitalization rates, cost estimates, and value reconciliation.
    • Identify unsupported assumptions, mathematical errors, stale data, weak comparables, excessive adjustments, material omissions, and other valuation deficiencies.
    • Return deficient reports for correction, clarification, or additional support.
    • Develop an independent recommendation of property value based on the appraisal, supporting market evidence, internal records, inspections, and other available information.
    • Recommend acceptance, modification, rejection, or further investigation of submitted valuation conclusions.
    • Prepare concise written summaries of findings, risks, and recommended values.
    • Present valuation recommendations to Investment Committee, Asset Resolution Committee, Initial Credit Review Committee or other decision-making committees.
    • Explain valuation methodology, assumptions, market evidence, and collateral risks to management and committee members.
    • Recommend additional appraisals, inspections, environmental reports, engineering studies, or other analysis when existing information is insufficient.
    • Review work completed by junior analysts and provide technical guidance on appraisal methodology, comparable analysis, adjustments, and report documentation.

Requirements

  • Education
    • Bachelor’s degree in real estate, finance, accounting, economics, business, or a related field.
  • Required Experience
    • 7+ years of experience in real estate appraisal, appraisal review, collateral valuation, underwriting, credit, asset management, or a related field.
    • Demonstrated experience reviewing both residential and commercial real estate appraisals.
    • Strong knowledge of the sales comparison, income capitalization, and cost approaches.
    • Experience evaluating comparable selection, market adjustments, income and expense assumptions, capitalization rates, highest and best use, and value reconciliation.
    • Experience with distressed, transitional, nonperforming, foreclosed, or complex real estate.
    • Strong analytical, written, verbal, and presentation skills.
    • Ability to exercise independent judgment and challenge unsupported valuation conclusions.
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, public records, property databases, listing platforms, mapping systems, and market research tools.
    • State Certified General Real Estate Appraiser credential.
    • MAI, SRA, AI-GRS, ASA, MRICS, or another recognized appraisal designation.
  • Key Performance Measures
    • Accuracy and defensibility of valuation recommendations
    • Quality and timeliness of appraisal reviews
    • Identification of material appraisal deficiencies
    • Consistency with appraisal review standards
    • Quality of committee presentations and written recommendations
    • Variance between recommended values and subsequent transaction outcomes
  • Remote Work Requirements
    • Stable, reliable internet connection.
    • Professional and dedicated remote working environment.
  • Preferred Background / Industry Experience
    • Real estate appraisal or appraisal review, particularly residential and commercial properties.
    • Commercial real estate lending, mortgage lending, credit underwriting, or collateral risk management.
    • Asset management, special assets, distressed debt, foreclosure, or REO involving complex or transitional real estate.
    • Experience with portfolio lenders, banks, private credit, or other financial institutions.
    • Experience supporting credit/investment committees, loan workouts, property dispositions, or other decisions involving real estate collateral.
  • Key Soft Skills
    • Strong analytical judgment and professional skepticism.
    • Confidence to challenge appraisers, analysts, and internal stakeholders when conclusions are not adequately supported.
    • Ability to make sound decisions when property information is incomplete or conflicting.
    • Clear and concise written and verbal communication.
    • Ability to explain complex valuation issues to non-appraisers and senior executives.
    • Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the overall collateral risk.
    • Comfortable defending a valuation recommendation in a committee environment.
    • Collaborative coaching style when reviewing the work of junior analysts.
    • High degree of independence, integrity, and objectivity
  • Specific Technical Skills Needed
    • Expert understanding of residential and commercial real estate appraisal.
    • Strong command of the Sales Comparison and Income Capitalization approach.
    • Ability to critically evaluate comparable selection and appraisal adjustments.
    • Ability to analyze rents, operating expenses, NOI, capitalization rates, discount rates, and income-based valuations.
    • Strong understanding of highest and best use, zoning, property condition, marketability, and location considerations.
    • Ability to identify appraisal errors, unsupported assumptions, inconsistencies, and material data gaps.
    • Experience reviewing distressed, nonperforming, foreclosed, transitional, or otherwise complex collateral preferred.
    • Working knowledge of USPAP and applicable appraisal independence and regulatory standards.
    • Proficiency with Excel, public property records, MLS/listing information, mapping tools, commercial real estate databases, and other valuation research resources.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Enjoy Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Work from the comfort of your own home – fully remote
  • Compensation paid in USD



Ready to Apply?

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you - submit your CV in English and hit Apply

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

About the Role

We're looking for a Junior Full Stack Engineer, Merchant Tools to help build and improve the applications that Bask Health customers use to manage their telehealth businesses.

Our merchant platform brings together storefront configuration, product management, subscriptions, and business operations. You'll contribute to the tools that help merchants set up their businesses, manage their offerings, and complete everyday tasks.

raw.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

We're looking for the performance marketer who wants to own profitable growth across Google and Microsoft for our Make & Manage Money business, set the plan, and build the campaigns themselves. Our listicles connect people with offers across personal finance, insurance, banking, credit cards, gaming apps, and more, and winning here means understanding how intent, creative, landing pages, offer selection, partner payouts, and lead quality work together. You'll run an eight-figure annual media portfolio with the freedom to put budget wherever it earns, and the trade is that it's yours: you find what's holding growth back, whether it's in the account or not, and you go get it fixed.

Tip: Only apply if you've directly owned and profitably scaled $10M or more a year in paid media for affiliate or consumer lead generation.

Why This Seat

  • Real ownership. You own the portfolio across Google and Microsoft, set the plan, and make the calls. No layers between you and the result.
  • Partners who can move the levers. Yield, account management, and creative work alongside you on payouts, offers, and landing pages, so you're fixing the whole funnel, not just the account.
  • Room to build. Microsoft audience and native inventory, MSN included, is early for us, and budget follows what works.
  • A team that gets better together. We share what works, own what didn't, and turn wins into playbooks the whole paid team uses.
  • An AI-forward stack. Claude is in the daily workflow, with room to automate analysis, concepting, and creative iteration.

What You'll Bring

  • Ownership, Accountability & Strategy. You set the plan, prioritize the tests, and make the call, then bring your manager recommendations, not questions about what to do next.
  • A track record of profitably scaling affiliate or consumer lead gen, with direct ownership of $10M or more in annual media spend.
    • Buying traffic to competitive affiliate listicles, comparison pages, or multi-offer marketplaces.
  • Hands-on depth in Google Ads or Microsoft Ads, and the range to own a portfolio across both. If your strongest experience is in Microsoft Ads, audience buying, or native inventory, we want to hear from you.
    • Scaling across Search, Display, Demand Gen, YouTube, and native placements.
  • A real grasp of affiliate economics: partner payouts, revenue per click, conversion rates, offer mix, traffic quality, ROAS, and margin.
  • A habit of finding the actual constraint. You can tell whether a problem sits in the buying, the creative, the landing page, the offer, the payout, or the measurement, and you go to the team that owns the fix with a clear ask.
  • Clear, direct communication, including short performance updates that say what changed, why it matters, and what you need.

Nice to Have

  • Running across several consumer categories or variable-payout partner programs.
  • Using AI and self-serve creative tools to speed up analysis and asset iteration.
  • Working with competitive intelligence tools and in regulated consumer categories.
  • Building playbooks or mentoring other media buyers.

What You'll Own

  • Strategy and execution across Google Search, Demand Gen, YouTube, and Microsoft audience and native inventory, MSN included.
  • Budget allocation, pacing, forecasting, reporting, and profitability for the portfolio.
  • A prioritized growth plan that names the biggest constraints and the tests most likely to move the business.
  • The case to Sales, Account Management, Yield, Creative, Product, and Analytics for what the campaigns need, and the follow-through until it lands.
  • Campaign architecture, bidding, targeting, conversion signals, exclusions, tracking, and testing discipline.
  • Testing new inventory and platforms with a clear hypothesis and a point where you stop.

What Great Looks Like

  • You run the portfolio on your own and bring your manager recommendations and decisions.
  • Profitable spend and margin grow because of a deliberate, prioritized testing plan.
  • Microsoft grows into a real second source alongside Google.
  • Partner teams know what you need, why it matters, and how their work moves growth, and payouts, offers, or pages change because of the case you made.
  • Your playbooks make the broader paid team better.

This Isn't the Right Seat If You

  • See the ad account as the whole job.
  • Want someone else to set the plan or tell you what to test next.
  • Have mostly managed agencies or reporting rather than building campaigns yourself.
  • Would rather not push other teams for changes you don't control.

Total Compensation

  • Base: $150,000 to $170,000
  • Annual Bonus: profit sharing, based on company and personal performance, set by the level of the role

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

Position Summary...

The Senior Manager, Industrial Engineering leads the design, construction, and program management of logistics centers and large-scale automation projects, ensuring compliance, optimizing processes, and driving project milestones while liaising with cross-functional teams.

What you'll do...

The Senior Manager, Industrial Engineering oversees the development of construction documents and specifications, ensuring compliance with design intent and managing prototypical and historical standards for assigned projects, including and not limited to Distribution Centers. This role involves continuous innovation and development of internal systems and processes, focusing on safety, security, and compliance with relevant building codes and corporate requirements. Coordination with stakeholders, consultants, and construction teams is essential for resolving project-specific design opportunities, directing procurement lead times, reviewing change orders, driving project schedules, and managing construction activities and design costs tracking and forecasting.

Relationships with external partners and cross-functional teams are managed to ensure high-quality project delivery. The Senior Manager also manages a diverse portfolio of onsite construction projects, collaborating with internal business units to minimize operational impact. This includes communication and adjustment of timelines, material procurement coordination, and ensuring construction quality aligns with design specifications.

The role emphasizes continued education for technical skill enhancement and individual development. The Senior Manager acts independently in complex projects, establishes risk levels, trains contractors, and models company culture through effective communication and dispute resolution. Execution of business plans involves identifying operational needs, removing performance barriers, and supporting continuous learning.

Managing program resources includes identifying needs for additional project management, leading selection processes, and providing supervision and development opportunities. The Senior Manager also handles construction budgeting, tracking, and forecasting, partnering with contractors and consultants to ensure accurate pricing and resolving contractor claims.

Qualifications

  • 8 to 10 years experience in industrial engineering, construction management, or related field
  • P.Eng and/or PMP preferred
  • • Experience with distribution center or automation/MHE projects strongly preferred
  • Proficiency with BIM, Revit, AutoCAD, MS Project; Wrike, Procore, or Primavera considered an asset

Leadership Expectations:

Demonstrates and encourages respect for all; builds a high-performing team; seeks, and embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas and experiences; creates a workplace and experiences where all associates feel seen, supported and connected through culture of belonging so associates thrive and perform; drives a positive associate and customer experience for all; identifies, attracts, and retains the best team members.

Creates a discipline and focus around developing talent, through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; promotes an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work; empowers associates and partners to act in the best interest of the customer and company; and regularly recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments.

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively and cross-functionally to achieve objectives; and communicates and listens attentively, with energy and positivity to motivate, influence, and inspire commitment and action.

Acts with Integrity:

Follows the law, our code of conduct and company policies, and sets expectations for others to do the same; promotes an environment where associates feel comfortable sharing concerns and reinforces our culture of non-retaliation; listens to concerns raised by associates. takes action and encourages others to do the same; holds self and others accountable for achieving results in a way that is consistent with our values.

Our secret to leading the way in hospitality? We put our people first!

At Shake Shack, our mission is to Stand For Something Good in all that we do. From our teams to our neighborhoods, we're committed to always doing the right thing. As one of the fastest-growing hospitality brands, we're all about crafting unforgettable experiences for our guests. We offer endless learning opportunities and the chance to make a lasting impact on our business, restaurants, and communities. As a member of the #ShackFam, you’ll have access to hands-on mentorship, training, and growth potential, all in a fun and inclusive environment.

Join us and Be a Part of Something Good.

Job Summary

The Staff Accountant will be responsible forassistingin the accounting of general functions as it relates to License Revenue Accounting, including but not limited to the preparation of journal entries related to accruals, and accounts receivables tasks. This individual will also provide strategic support and analysis as needed. 

The Staff Accountant is a self-motivated, adaptive, eager learner who can manage and prioritize an evolving workload in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate will have an analytical mindset, strong work ethic, heightened attention to detailand a desire for continuous process improvement. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Monthly Close

  • Prepare period-end entries, account reconciliations, and account analyses as it relates to owned areas with appropriate SOX documentation and support when required.

  • Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports for both domestic and international licensing sales.

  • Compile licensing sales data and maintain licensing dashboard.

  • Coordinate with licensing partners to resolve reporting issues as needed.

  • Facilitate period-end closings by ensuring the accurate and timely completion of all responsibilities. 

  • Prepare invoices for licensing partners and process monthly cash receipts.

  • Prepare accounts receivable aging and ensure timely collections.

  • Act as a key member of cross-functional teams to improve the flow of data and reporting. 

2. SOX Compliance 

  • Support compliance with SOX key controls related to owned accounts and processes.

  • Coordinate with internal and external auditors related to owned accounts and processes ensuring complete, timely, and accurate responses to information requests.

  • Continuously evaluate SOX controls in light of changing systems/processes and work with Internal Audit to identify and implement necessary control changes.

3. Process Improvement

  • Review existing processes, structures, and systems to assist in the identification of improvement opportunities with a focus on simplification, standardization, and optimization, especially the reduction of manual, Excel-based activities.

  • Help drive the reduction of the close timeline by assessing and streamlining close-related activities.

  • Assist in assessing the impact from and implement the required changes to systems, processes, policies, and procedures due to new accounting standards, regulatory changes, changes in business strategy, cross-departmental initiatives, and other operational changes. 

  • Support the implementation of on-going process improvement initiatives. 

4. Annual Audit and Quarterly Reviews

  • Support information flow between accounting teams, external auditors, and other internal and external partners.

  • Prepare balance sheet and income statement fluctuation analyses.

  • Provide support to Tax and Financial Reporting and adhere to external reporting timelines.

5. Other

  • Collaborate cross functionally where required and appropriate.

  • Strengthen and maintain relationships with both internal and external parties.

  • Remain current on accounting and regulatory changes.

  • Remain current on Restaurant and Retail industry-specific technologies and emerging trends.

  • Prepare reports/analyses and participate in other projects as needed.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Skilled with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook).

  • Confident, Caring, Team-oriented, Guest-focused, Supportive, Empathetic, Trustworthy.

  • Understanding ofUS GAAP and SOX.

Related Experience

  • 1-3 years of accounting experience in private and/or public accounting.

  • Experience in the restaurant and/or retail industries preferred.

  • Experience at Big 4 public accounting firm a plus.

Education Requirements

Bachelor's Degree

  • BS/BA in Accounting or Finance required.

  • CPA or CPA track preferred.

Benefits at Shake Shack:

A work environment where you can come as you are, share your ideas, have fun, and work collaboratively:

  • Weekly Pay and Performance bonuses

  • Shake Shack Meal Discounts

  • Exclusive corporate discounts for travel, electronics, wellness, leisure activities and more

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance*

  • Employer Paid Life and Disability Insurance*

  • 401k Plan with Company Match*

  • Paid Time Off*

  • Paid Parental Leave*

  • Access to Employee Assistance Program on Day 1

  • Pre-Tax Commuter and Parking Benefits

  • Flexible Spending and Dependent Care Accounts*

  • Development and Growth Opportunities

*Eligibility criteria applies

Pay Range - $67,956.25 - $87,393.75

Click the "Apply" button above to apply for this opening.

About Us

Beginning as a hot dog cart in New York City’s Madison Square Park, Shake Shack was created by Danny Meyer, Founder and CEO of Union Square Hospitality Group and best-selling author of Setting the Table. Shack Fans lined up daily, making the cart a resounding success, and donating all proceeds back to the park beautification efforts. A permanent stand was eventually built…and the rest is Shack history! With our roots in fine dining and giving back to the community, we are committed to high quality food served with a high level of hospitality. Our team members enjoy a positive work environment that is deeply committed to the philosophy that we "Stand for Something Good."

Shake Shack is an Equal Opportunity Employer

raw.description:
If you are ready to take a next step in your accounting career, and you feel that energy industry is where you can find the thrill (we definitely do!), keep reading - and if that's a match, we'll be happy to set you up with our HR crew for an interview.

Location: Spain or Belgium, but remote set up is also possible within European E&C Group Locations

Team: Global Finance Team

💡Why E&C Consultants?

We’re proud to be a Great Place To Work® certified company, where satisfaction, growth, and flexibility are our way of working.

You can read more details here: Becoming an E&Cer, but here’s what makes us stand out:

  • We put people first: employee fulfilment, pride and well-being are balanced and at the heart of everything we do

  • We grow together: as E&C expands, so do your opportunities to develop professionally

  • We work differently: our Teal management means no micromanagement - just empowerment and flat structure

  • We give you time to recharge: enjoy 46 days off per year, no matter where you live or work

About the role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Group Accountant to join our Group Finance Team and support the accurate and timely financial reporting of E&C's entities.

You’ll own key month‑end activities: from posting close entries to balance‑sheet and intercompany reconciliations. Help review the monthly numbers to spot anything that doesn’t add up. You’ll work hand‑in‑hand with our Internal Accountant, Financial Controller and external accounting/tax partners to make sure reporting is accurate, complete and on time. It’s a hands‑on role for someone who knows double‑entry and accrual accounting, enjoys digging into financial data like a number detective, and takes pride in owning and resolving discrepancies.

You’ll start by owning a few specific entities and accounting areas and getting to know the numbers inside out. We’re looking for someone curious and analytical who can read what a balance or transaction really means, flag anything that looks off, and chase it down until it’s fixed. As you settle in, there’s plenty of room to grow: take on more entities, tackle trickier accounting issues, and broaden your role in group financial reporting.

Requirements

🎯Do you already feel like E&C is a place for you? Let's see if this particular role is also what you're good at. As a Group Accountant you will be trusted with:

  • Month-end close: Own the month‑end close for your assigned entities: prepare journal entries and adjustments, review the monthly numbers, spot anything that doesn’t add up, investigate discrepancies and drive them to a clean resolution so reporting is accurate and on time

  • Month-end review: Support the review of monthly financial results for assigned entities and accounting areas, identifying unusual balances, discrepancies or potential accounting errors and investigating items requiring explanation or correction

  • Reconciliations: Prepare monthly balance‑sheet reconciliations (accruals, prepayments, fixed assets, etc.) and run intercompany reconciliations: find mismatches, investigate the causes and work with colleagues to clear items and post any corrective entries

  • Internal and external collaboration: Partner closely with the Internal Accountant, Financial Controller and our external accounting and tax partners to coordinate month‑end tasks and make sure the close and reporting are timely and accurate

  • Information provision: Prepare clear reconciliations, schedules and supporting explanations so the Group Finance Team and external partners have everything they need for reporting and tax work

  • Issue resolution: Investigate accounting discrepancies and outstanding items and work collaboratively with the wider Group Finance Team and external partners to ensure they are appropriately resolved

  • Group-wide consistency: Help ensure that accounting treatments, close procedures and supporting documentation are applied consistently across E&C’s entities

  • Continuous improvement: Help make finance smarter and more efficient. Suggest and implement better processes, controls and close procedures, and spot ways to use systems and tech to save time and reduce errors

🧩 We feel that to be successful & satisfied in this role, it’s good to bring a mix of curiosity, analytical thinking, and a grounded accounting mindset. Ideally, we look for:

  • A good understanding of double-entry accounting and core accounting principles. You understand debits, credits and why they matter

  • Clear understanding of the accruals concept, you recognise income and expenses in the right period so the numbers tell the true story

  • Strong numerical skills and a keen eye for detail

  • A special talent for spotting when balances or postings look wrong, and the persistence to dig in and find the root cause

  • Good organisational skills and the ability to work effectively to deadlines

  • Spreadsheet savvy, you use Excel/Sheets to analyse, reconcile and present tidy supporting workpapers

  • Comfortable collaborating with internal colleagues and external accounting/tax professionals

  • Proactive, adaptable and curious. You enjoy learning new systems and looking for smarter ways to work

  • A strong working level of English, both written and spoken

🌟 These desirable skills will help you shine in the role (but don’t worry if you don’t tick every box):

Relevant accounting experience, including practical involvement in month-end close activities, is highly desirable. Previous experience working in a multi-entity environment would also be beneficial. Experience using the following accounting or ERP packages would be beneficial although not required: Exact Online, QuickBooks Online, Xero, DATEV, Sage and enova365.

You don’t need a professional accounting qualification to apply. We value hands‑on accounting experience and solid technical knowledge above formal certification!

If you are still here and reading, you must be really interested. Great, as E&C is the best place to be! Last but not least then, a sneak peek into our application process:

  • First call with HR or Team Leader - 45min

  • Assessment: online ability tests + personality questionnaire - 45min

  • Final round interview: Business case (can be prepared in advance) & discussion on the online assessment + meeting the team - 90min

Send your application by clicking on the application button. Please send us your CV in English only and include the following statement in your application: "I hereby give consent for my personal data included in my application to be processed for the purposes of the recruitment process under the Personal Data Protection Act as of 29 August 1997, consolidated text: Journal of Laws 2015, item 2135 as amended"

Highlights

Join our Finance Team to provide hands‑on accounting support and manage client accounts.

raw.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD102143

Position Overview

Designers at Autodesk can think across the system, champion design ideas, collaborate with stakeholders, advocate for the customer, and deliver impactful data-driven designs. Our designers use creative and innovative solutions to deliver high-quality experiences that delight our customers.


Help shape how millions of people supervise and trust AI inside the tools they use to design and make the world. As Principal Experience Designer on the team behind the Autodesk Assistant, you'll define how agentic AI behaves in software that people use to design and build real things. When an agent proposes a change to a building model or a part, how does someone see what it did, trust it, and undo it? That's the work.


The Autodesk Assistant is how customers will experience AI across our Design and Make platform, embedded inside Autodesk products. In this position you'll set the design direction for the agentic experiences the Assistant brings to product teams across the portfolio. Our customers are professionals whose work has real cost and safety consequences, and they won't hand control to an AI they can't check. Our team stewards the patterns that let them check it.


At Autodesk we look to hire innovators who reimagine what's possible, those with diverse backgrounds who elevate our thinking, and leaders who help shape the world and our future.


For consideration, candidates must include both a resume + portfolio with password when applying.

Responsibilities

  • Define the agentic interaction patterns that Autodesk product teams adopt when they integrate the Autodesk Assistant, including reasoning visibility, action controls, permissions and consent, and citation and grounding
  • Raise the quality bar for AI experiences in the Autodesk Assistant and advocate for it with partners. Define how we'll know an experience is working, such as task completion and adoption
  • Lead the design of patterns that product teams across Autodesk adopt, so they build on shared patterns rather than point solutions
  • Build working prototypes with real data to test interaction models with customers and to give engineers a clear target
  • Mentor senior and staff designers on the team, and support designers across Autodesk who are shipping Autodesk Assistant capabilities inside their own products
  • Partner with senior stakeholders in Product, Engineering, and AI Research on Autodesk Assistant decisions, and push on frontier-model capabilities when the experience calls for it
  • Partner with Data Scientists and others using data to support driving data informed decisions and experimentation
  • Use data and customer research to decide where agentic experiences need to improve, inform your design decisions and experimentation

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in UX design, product design, or a related field, at principal-level scope: you've shaped design direction beyond your own team
  • A portfolio that shows organizational impact as well as craft
  • You're an expert in human-centered design, and you adapt the process to fit larger, more complex problems
  • A point of view on what makes an AI experience good, and a track record of raising the bar
  • You've designed how people supervise AI that acts on their behalf (reasoning visibility, controls, citations, consent), and other teams adopted those patterns in their own work. You can show how you measured adoption
  • You've shipped generative AI to production and can show what it did for users or the business
  • You choose a direction when the model's behavior, the data, and the requirements are still changing
  • You use AI tools to build working prototypes with real data and to move ideas toward shipped work, without lowering the craft bar. Your portfolio includes work that AI tools helped you make
  • You've mentored senior and staff designers, and you still ship your own work
  • You're a clear communicator and storyteller who works closely across functions
  • Demonstrated partnership with Data Scientists or other related cross-functional partners using data-informed decisions to influence design direction

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing for multi-agent workflows or tool-use orchestration (for example, MCP)
  • Familiarity with frameworks for evaluating AI experience quality, such as Minimum Trustworthiness, Transformative Value, or equivalent quality-gate models
  • Experience designing within organizational AI governance principles (Trusted AI, Responsible AI, or equivalent)
  • Experience designing complex technical software for professional users

Learn More / En savoir plus


About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.


We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.


When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!


À propos d’Autodesk

Bienvenue chez Autodesk ! Nos logiciels créent chaque jour des choses extraordinaires : des bâtiments les plus écologiques aux voitures les plus propres, en passant par les usines les plus intelligentes et les films à succès. Nous aidons les innovateurs à concrétiser leurs idées, transformant non seulement la façon dont les choses sont fabriquées, mais aussi ce qui peut l’être.


Nous sommes très fiers de notre culture chez Autodesk ; elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Notre culture guide notre façon de travailler et de nous comporter les uns envers les autres, influence nos interactions avec nos clients et nos partenaires, et définit notre image au monde.


En tant qu’Autodeskien, vous pouvez accomplir un travail significatif qui contribue à bâtir un monde meilleur, conçu et réalisé pour tous. Prêt à façonner le monde et votre avenir ? Rejoignez-nous !

Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range.   • Own key category metrics (KPIs) for new and existing brands. Monitor and evaluate pricing, costs, and system adjustments to maintain required mark-ups and protect margin performance.
  • Collaborate with Inventory Management and Planning to align on forecasts, inventory turns, vendor performance, and order cycles.
  • Partner with Marketing to develop profitable, high-impact promotional co-op activities.
  • Align regularly with the Director of Merchandising and global teams (requiring occasional availability for US Pacific Time zone meetings).
  • Utilize category reports and data analytics to identify market opportunities, guide commercial decision-making, and support long-term business growth.

The duties and responsibilities described above provide a summary of this position and do not constitute an exhaustive list of all job functions. Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned as business conditions or requirements dictate, with or without prior notice.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Required:

Experience Requirements:

  • Generally requires a minimum of 4 years of progressive experience in buying, category management, merchandising, or a directly related commercial role.

Education Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Merchandising, or a related field (or equivalent practical work experience).

Judgment/Reasoning Ability: Able to identify, troubleshoot and resolve problems quickly using sound judgment, poise and diplomacy. Ability to use judgment and reasoning skills, and determine when to escalate issues, as required, in a timely manner.

title: SEM Specialist
description: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

raw.title: SEM Specialist
raw.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
raw.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

It’s More Than a Career, It’s a Mission.

Our people are the foundation of our success. By joining our growing team at Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI), a subsidiary of McKesson, you will have the opportunity to become part of one of the largest community-based cancer programs to advance oncology treatments and improve outcomes for cancer patients across the globe. We look for mission-driven candidates who have a desire to advance the fight against cancer and make a difference in the lives of patients diagnosed with cancer every day.

Our Mission

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.


Our IT Project Manager is a thought leader in project management, guiding the way projects are managed. The IT Project Manager handles a variety of projects, including:

  • High visibility projects
  • Ambiguous projects
  • Complex projects that span multiple organizations
  • High priority projects with executive oversight
  • Projects that are part of larger programs

Additionally, they identify methods to enhance project management capabilities and processes.


This is a remote position based in the US; relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available.


Duties include but are not limited to:

  • Participates in complex projects often involving cross-functional teams and matrix partners; knows when to leverage cross-functional expertise across the organization.
  • Leads a variety of different types of projects including launch of new products and services, application development, systems integration, operational efficiency improvements, process reengineering, and infrastructure upgrades and deployments.
  • Participates in financial forecasts and provides on-going reconciliation of resources and other related project expenditures.
  • Other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience
  • PMP Certification or Lean Six Sigma Certification preferred
  • Agile Project Management and Scrum Certification strongly preferred
  • 3+ years' work experience in IT Project Management, clinical research, pharmaceutical or healthcare experience strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated, applied experience establishing and delivering complex projects.
  • Proven ability to navigate a highly matrixed organization effectively.
  • Excellent written and oral communication capability and presentation skills; persuasive, encouraging, motivating, and inspiring; the ability to listen and understand.

About Sarah Cannon Research Institute

Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI) is one of the world’s leading oncology research organizations conducting community-based clinical trials. Focused on advancing therapies for patients over the last three decades, SCRI is a leader in drug development. In 2022, SCRI formed a joint venture with former US Oncology Research to expand clinical trial access across the country. It has conducted more than 850 first-in-human clinical trials since its inception and contributed to pivotal research that has led to the majority of new cancer therapies approved by the FDA in the past decade. SCRI’s research network brings together more than 1,300 physicians who are enrolling patients into clinical trials at more than 200 locations in 20+ states across the U.S. Please click here to learn more about our research offerings.

We care about the well-being of the patients and communities we serve, and that starts with caring for our people. That’s why we have a Total Rewards package that includes comprehensive benefits to support physical, mental, and financial well-being. Our Total Rewards offerings serve the different needs of our diverse colleague population and ensure they are the healthiest versions of themselves. For more information regarding benefits through our parent company, McKesson, please click here.

As part of Total Rewards, we are proud to offer a competitive compensation package. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered.

McKesson has become aware of online recruiting-related scams in which individuals who are not affiliated with or authorized by McKesson are using McKesson’s (or affiliated entities, like CoverMyMeds or RxCrossroads) name in fraudulent emails, job postings or social media messages. In light of these scams, please bear the following in mind:

McKesson Talent Advisors will never solicit money or credit card information in connection with a McKesson job application.

McKesson Talent Advisors do not communicate with candidates via online chatrooms or using email accounts such as Gmail or Hotmail. Note that McKesson does rely on a virtual assistant (Gia) for certain recruiting-related communications with candidates.

McKesson job postings are posted on our career site: .

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, AI & Automation to design, build, and deploy AI-powered solutions and automated workflows across Bask Health's platform.

This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, artificial intelligence, and real-world business operations. You'll work closely with engineering, product, and operational teams to identify opportunities where AI and automation can simplify complex processes, improve efficiency, and create better experiences for merchants and internal users.

You'll be responsible for taking AI and automation initiatives from initial discovery through production. That includes understanding existing workflows, evaluating technical approaches, building integrations, developing backend services, and ensuring solutions are reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Unlike a traditional AI research role, this position is focused on applying existing AI technologies to practical engineering problems. You'll integrate large language models, build automated workflows, connect external systems, and develop production-ready software that delivers measurable operational value.

You'll also help establish reusable engineering patterns for AI-powered features, including monitoring, testing, evaluation, error handling, and appropriate human oversight.

We're looking for someone who enjoys working directly with stakeholders, understands how to turn ambiguous business problems into working software, and can balance rapid experimentation with strong production engineering standards.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications and workflow automation solutions across Bask Health.
  • Work directly with product, engineering, and operational stakeholders to understand business processes and identify automation opportunities.
  • Translate complex operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Build production-ready integrations with large language models and external AI services.
  • Develop backend services, APIs, and automation tools using TypeScript, Node.js, or comparable technologies.
  • Integrate AI capabilities into existing platform features and internal operational systems.
  • Build automated workflows that connect multiple applications, APIs, and data sources.
  • Develop AI-assisted tools that help teams complete repetitive or complex tasks more efficiently.
  • Implement structured outputs, tool calling, and function execution within AI-powered applications.
  • Design workflows that combine deterministic business logic with AI-driven capabilities.
  • Build reliable integrations with third-party services using REST APIs, webhooks, and event-driven architectures.
  • Develop systems for processing, transforming, and routing information between connected services.
  • Evaluate opportunities to automate merchant onboarding, operational processes, and administrative workflows.
  • Build reusable components and engineering patterns for future AI and automation initiatives.
  • Implement validation, safeguards, and human-review steps for sensitive or high-impact workflows.
  • Develop evaluation and testing strategies for AI-powered functionality.
  • Monitor AI application performance, reliability, latency, and operational costs.
  • Investigate and resolve issues involving AI outputs, integrations, and automated processes.
  • Implement logging, error handling, retry mechanisms, and monitoring for production workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate AI solutions into existing applications and services.
  • Work with SQL databases and application data to support automation and AI-powered features.
  • Evaluate third-party AI services, automation platforms, and developer tools for practical use cases.
  • Document technical architecture, implementation decisions, and operational requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to convert custom automation solutions into reusable platform capabilities.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices.
  • Mentor other engineers on reliable AI integration and automation development.
  • Take ownership of technical projects from initial discovery through deployment, maintenance, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, or a comparable hands-on technical role.
  • Strong programming experience with JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Experience developing backend applications, APIs, and services using Node.js or comparable technologies.
  • Hands-on experience integrating large language models or AI services into software applications.
  • Experience building automated workflows, system integrations, or operational tooling.
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, and third-party integration patterns.
  • Experience developing and maintaining production software.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications and working solutions.
  • Experience integrating multiple systems, services, or data sources.
  • Familiarity with prompt design, structured outputs, and practical LLM application development.
  • Understanding of error handling, validation, and reliability considerations for AI-powered workflows.
  • Experience working with SQL databases and relational data.
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across application and integration layers.
  • Experience designing maintainable, scalable backend services.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and modern application deployment practices.
  • Understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, and secure data handling.
  • Ability to evaluate technical approaches and make sound architectural decisions.
  • Experience writing tests and maintaining software quality.
  • Ability to investigate and resolve complex production issues.
  • Experience collaborating with product managers, engineers, and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage technical projects independently from discovery through deployment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and comfort working with ambiguous requirements.
  • Ability to balance rapid implementation with long-term maintainability.
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving, remote engineering environment.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, AI Solutions Engineer, or Automation Engineer.
  • Experience building AI agents or multi-step LLM workflows.
  • Familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, or comparable AI model APIs.
  • Experience with function calling, tool use, and structured LLM responses.
  • Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and vector databases.
  • Experience with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph.
  • Experience developing AI evaluation frameworks or automated quality checks.
  • Familiarity with prompt versioning, model selection, and AI cost optimization.
  • Experience implementing human-in-the-loop approval workflows.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and asynchronous processing.
  • Familiarity with AWS Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, or comparable cloud services.
  • Experience with React, Next.js, or full-stack TypeScript applications.
  • Familiarity with tRPC, Prisma, or Drizzle ORM.
  • Experience with workflow automation tools such as n8n, Zapier, or Make.
  • Experience developing internal tools or operational automation platforms.
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS applications.
  • Experience working with merchant-facing software or e-commerce platforms.
  • Experience integrating healthcare, telehealth, or pharmacy-related systems.
  • Understanding of healthcare data privacy and security considerations.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.
