raw.description:
At Mitratech, we are a team of technocrats focused on building world-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions. We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in its diverse and inclusive work culture centered around great people practices, learning opportunities, and having fun! Our culture is the ideal blend of entrepreneurial spirit and enterprise investment, enabling the chance to move at a rapid pace with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.

For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.

As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!

Due to business and compliance requirements, this position is open only to candidates residing in MEXICO. Applications from candidates located outside this region will not be reviewed.

About the role

Product managers at Mitratech are revenue engineers. You own how your products grow revenue and keep customers successful. You choose the capabilities that matter most, either because they help sales and renewals close or because they make customers more successful. You turn those choices into requirements engineering builds from, then work with customers, support, sales and engineering until the results show up in revenue and retention.

You report into the Product Management organization and work with a distributed engineering and design team across several countries.

What you will do

  • Find the revenue opportunity. Talk to customers and admins every week, read usage and satisfaction data, join win-loss and renewal reviews, and write down the problem with the revenue case behind it.
  • Work with sales and customer success to find where a missing capability costs deals or renewals, and decide what to build in response.
  • Keep the roadmap for your area current and explain what is on it, what is not, and the revenue reason for each choice.
  • Define the problem worth solving and the job the customer is trying to get done, with the evidence behind it. Give design and engineering a clear enough picture of the problem and the outcome that they know what to build and can tell when it works.
  • Plan releases with engineering, estimate effort together, and manage scope as the release moves.
  • Represent the customer in engineering, design, support and sales conversations.
  • Demonstrate what you are building to customers and to the wider organization, collect their feedback, and secure agreement from stakeholders before a release goes to market.
  • Give sales, support and customer success what they need to sell and support each release: positioning, demos and answers to the questions customers ask.
  • Define the metrics for your area (revenue, retention, adoption and customer satisfaction), report on them, and check each release against the revenue case you made for it.

What you bring

  • 5 or more years of product management experience, including at least 3 in business-to-business enterprise SaaS.
  • A record of shipping software that real customers use, and the artifacts to show how you worked: requirements, roadmaps, discovery notes, metrics.
  • Experience working with engineering teams across time zones.
  • A record of tying product decisions to revenue, retention or expansion, with the numbers to show it.
  • Comfort with product analytics and with turning data into a decision.
  • Written and spoken English at a professional level. You will write requirements and present in English every day.
  • A bachelor's degree in business, computer science, engineering, information systems, economics or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred

  • Experience in HR technology, such as performance management, learning, applicant tracking, compensation, payroll or HCM.
  • Experience adding AI-assisted features to an enterprise product.
  • An MBA or master's degree.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Jira and Productboard.

How Mitratech will assess the role

Mitratech's product management career path defines the Product Manager level as working independently on problem definition, discovery, release planning, stakeholder alignment, metrics and influence, and as developing the skills of strategy, pricing, negotiation and customer engagement. Interviews assess against those expectations.

We are an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or veteran status.

raw.description:
For People is improving government digital services for the disadvantaged population. We work directly with government agencies to modernize software, systems, and platforms so that they better serve people.

Your Impact

Every month, hundreds of thousands of people go looking for facts about Medicare and Medicaid. They are researchers, reporters, policy staff, and health care providers. When the data is hard to find, a file is too large to post, or a column quietly changes its name between releases, their work slows down or goes wrong.

This project supports the website where the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) publishes that data for the public. It holds a large catalog of datasets, lookup tools, and dashboards from many parts of the agency, available as downloads, interactive tools, and a public API. As Lead Product Manager, you will lead the team that builds and runs it. This is a hands-on role. You’ll facilitate partner meetings, support the team when they are blocked, and get into project details as needed to report clearly on the team’s progress. You’ll work elbow-to-elbow with the project’s technical and product leadership. You will learn about the work enough to identify and help mitigate delivery risks and hold the team accountable for what we promise to government partners.

This position is a full-time position contingent on For People being awarded a federal contract. If awarded, this position’s expected start date is February 2027.

Our Culture

For People is a team of humans. We place a significant amount of emphasis on positive work-life balance, setting healthy expectations, and making sure our loved ones are taken care of first. That means picking a child up from school during the day or going for a mid-day walk is okay!

This position is 100% remote. Our entire team is remote across the United States, from the West Coast to the East Coast. There will never be a return-to-office, as we have none! Occasional travel to CMS headquarters in Baltimore, MD (2-3 times per year) is required. These trips are infrequent and scheduled well in advance.

This full-time position's published base salary range is between $100,000 and $160,000 annually. Salary will be determined based on relevant experience. All positions include generous benefits (e.g., For People pays 100% of Gold-tier employee health insurance premiums) and annual company profit sharing.

Your Opportunities

On this project, you will be the delivery lead on a cross-functional team of about 15 people spanning engineering, design, user research, and support functions. The team may expand to up to 25 members in the future. As the Lead Product Manager, you will:

  • Build a collaborative and trusting team culture across all disciplines in the program
  • Run agile practices including sprints, planning cycles, demos, and retrospectives, all of which include CMS stakeholders
  • Coordinate with CMS offices that publish data on the public portal; share progress transparently and build positive working relationships with partner contracting teams
  • Proactively identify and mitigate risks to project delivery
  • Keep the program in line with contract, security, and accessibility requirements, including Section 508 and the site's Authority to Operate (ATO)
  • Report status and outcomes to CMS and For People leadership, using live dashboards wherever possible and finding efficiency gains through automation
  • Lead the handoff from the current contractor in your first few months, so users see no disruption

You Bring

  • A humble and caring attitude aligning with For People’s values: passion, fun, curiosity, sustainability, humility, and respect
  • Deep knowledge of agile product management principles and open data standards
  • Experience with collaboration and delivery tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Slack, and GitHub
  • Experience developing and evolving a product roadmap that communicates the vision and business value to stakeholders
  • Ability to oversee Task Order management activities, including reporting, sprint planning, product planning, and coordination of delivery activities
  • Ability to analyze complex problems and develop effective solutions involving schedules, technology, methodologies, tools, resources, and solution components
  • Experience facilitating stakeholder engagement across multiple Government components, business owners, and data owners
  • Experience leading Government digital or technology projects of similar size and complexity

It Would Be Great If You Also Have

  • Experience with public websites built on Drupal
  • Familiarity with CMS security processes
  • Experience leading a contract transition from an incumbent team
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in program or project management, including managing government contracts
  • Master's degree in management, public administration, information technology, or a related field
  • 4+ years of experience with open data projects and demonstrated expertise in DCAT-US 1.1, the federal metadata standard for open data
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams, with the ability to lead teams of 15 to 25 people as the contract grows

Some Fine Print

You will be working on a United States government platform, and they have a few basic requirements for contractors like ourselves. All work must be physically performed within the United States at all times. In addition, you must be a United States citizen and be able to pass a government-performed public trust background check.

For People is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, and/or veteran status.

What We're Looking For

raw.description:
We’re looking for someone to own the narrative of CSGORoll - understanding what people currently think about us, where the company is going, and turning that into a coherent story across our content and communication.

This is a creative + strategic + hands-on role. We don't want someone who needs a team of 6 people underneath them to create value. They should be capable themselves, then use internal resources and external contractors where needed.

What you’ll do

  • Understand perception - keep their ear to the ground across customers, the CS2 community, public discussion, customer support feedback, Product and BI. Understand both what people love and what they dislike about us.

  • Build the narrative - work with management and Product to turn where CSGORoll is going into a clear story/message, rather than disconnected promotions and announcements.

  • Keep it coherent - make sure socials, blogs, product communication, community interaction and larger content all fit the same wider narrative, adapted appropriately for different audiences.

  • Create the content plan - decide what stories/content we should actually be putting out and plan ahead around the product roadmap, events, releases and the CS2 scene.

  • Create things people actually want to watch - not just ads. Genuine CS2 content, community content, creative concepts, collaborations, short-form and larger productions that people would watch/share/react to regardless of the advertisement.

  • Get maximum value from production - one collaboration or shoot should create multiple pieces of content where possible, rather than spending heavily for one video.

  • Execute - work directly with our existing designers/editors and bring in copywriters, creators or production teams on a contractor basis when needed. Brief them, direct them, critique the work and own the final output.

  • Stay close to the community - we don't want to only appear when we have an announcement. Communication should feel human, authentic and actually engaged with what's happening.

Requirements

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Extremelyhigh agency and doesn't wait to be prompted.

  • Creative and a genuinely good storyteller.

  • Hands-on - can deliver value without needing a team underneath them.

  • High EQ with a strong understanding of psychology and perception.

  • Curious and willing to actually research what people are saying.

  • A good planner and executor.

  • A strong communicator who can work across management, Product, Customer Relations, BI and creative people.

  • Capable of directing and criticizing creative work.

  • Commercially sensible with production/collaboration costs.

  • Ideally familiar with CS2, esports, gaming and internet culture - or capable of becoming deeply immersed in it very quickly.

What this isn't

Not performance marketing, affiliate management or someone whose job is negotiating influencer deals.

We're also not looking for a corporate PR person or someone who produces strategies for other people to execute.

They need to understand the current narrative, decide what story we should be telling, and actually make that story happen.

Vice President, FP&A – Irth Solutions

Job Type: Full-Time

Location: United States, Preferred Eastern and Central Time Zones

Department: G&A

Reports To: Chief Financial Officer

Company Overview

Irth Solutions is a software product company developing innovative technology platforms designed to set industry benchmarks. With a strong product culture, collaborative work environment, and significant growth potential, Irth offers an exciting opportunity to work with modern, enterprise-scale data platforms.

Position Summary

The VP of FP&A leads all financial planning and analysis at Irth, covering both corporate FP&A and business partnering for Sales, Customer Success, Product/Engineering, Operations, G&A and acquired businesses. You will build the planning engine, modernize the tooling, and turn financial data into decisions that drive ARR growth, margin expansion and cash generation. You will establish efficient FP&A processes that enable continued scaling of the function while focusing on growth, talent development, and strategic insights that drive value creation.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership and Executive Partnership

  • Serve as the CFO's thought partner and a visible member of the finance leadership team, helping shape corporate strategy, the long-range plan and annual operating priorities
  • Own the sponsor's value creation plan, including EBITDA bridges and initiative tracking, and lead the preparation and presentation of financial results and outlook to the executive team, board and PE sponsor.

Corporate FP&A and Planning

  • Own the annual budget, rolling forecast and long-range plan, including ARR, bookings, retention, headcount and margin drivers
  • Build and maintain integrated three-statement models (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) to support board reporting, lender requirements and sponsor reviews
  • Lead scenario and sensitivity planning, including downside and acquisition cases, so the CFO, board and sponsor can see the range of outcomes, the key risks and the options for responding to them
  • Lead monthly and quarterly close-to-forecast cycles, variance analysis and board and sponsor reporting packages
  • Define and track SaaS KPIs and unit economics (ARR, NRR/GRR, CAC payback, LTV, Rule of 40, gross margin by line)

Business Partnering

What You Bring

What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months

raw.description:
Overview

The Analytics Engineer builds and maintains the data assets that power Ferrellgas reporting, self-service analytics, and AI initiatives. This role supports development of the data transformation layer in Snowflake, helping turn raw source data into clean, business-ready data, builds and maintains Power BI semantic models, and automates the manual processes that slow the business down. The Analytics Engineer shares responsibility for the team’s data models and transformation code, providing coverage and continuity across the full data flow from raw data to business-ready data. The ideal candidate has strong data modeling fundamentals, hands-on SQL and Power BI expertise, and a builder’s mindset for replacing manual work with reliable, automated solutions.

At Ferrellgas our corporate roles are fully remote, enabling talented professionals to support our field operations from wherever they are. These positions play a critical role in driving business growth, providing strategic and operational support that empowers our teams in the field to deliver exceptional results.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Ferrellgas, we’re committed to supporting our team with benefits that promote health, financial security, and personal growth:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, vision, accident, and critical illness insurance
  • Income Protection: Company-provided short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D
  • Financial Wellness: 401(k) with company match, Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), and Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Time Off & Family Support: Paid Time Off (PTO), parental leave, and tuition reimbursement
  • Wellness & Assistance Programs: Wellness program, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Medicare support
  • Employee Perks: Referral program, employee discount programs, and propane savings

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Power BI semantic models and support the Snowflake data transformation layer, which together serve as the foundation for reporting, self-service analytics, and AI data agents.
  • Support development of the data transformation layer in Snowflake, helping transform raw data into business-ready data that is structured, performant, and ready for downstream consumption.
  • Design and build transformation logic that applies business rules consistently and aligns with the team’s standards and architecture.
  • Publish and maintain well documented and performant Power BI semantic models that enable reporting and self-service.
  • Identify, prioritize, and automate recurring manual processes such as data refreshes, extracts, and report distribution.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable data models and validate that models answer real business questions.
  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented SQL transformations using dbt, with Git-based version control.
  • Manage data projects end to end, coordinating with IT source system owners, the Data Warehouse team, and business end users from requirements gathering through development, testing, and delivery.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, CI/CD, and documentation practices established by the team.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data quality issues in the transformation and semantic layers.
  • Stay current with Snowflake and reporting platform capabilities and contribute ideas for improving the team’s analytics infrastructure.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Math, Statistics, Analytics, or related field).
  • 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, BI development, or a closely related role.
  • Strong SQL skills, including CTEs, window functions, and query performance tuning.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform (e.g., BigQuery, Databricks).
  • 2+ years building Power BI semantic models, with working knowledge of DAX and M.
  • Understanding of semantic layer concepts, star schema design, and dimensional modeling principles.
  • Experience with data transformation tools such as dbt, including Git-based version control.
  • Experience with AI platforms is a plus, particularly integrating AI tools such as LLMs, Snowflake Cortex, or AI agents with enterprise data.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality and documentation.
  • Collaborative team player who can work effectively with engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders.
  • Passionate about learning new technologies and adapting to changing environments.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen, national, permanent resident, or otherwise authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants must not require visa sponsorship now or in the future

Why Ferrellgas?

At Ferrellgas we’re honored to be part of tight-knit communities across America and thousands of customers’ lives. From our nationwide charitable partnerships with Operation Warm and Operation BBQ Relief to fundraisers for local schools, fire departments, veteran organizations and more, we are always looking for ways to give back to the communities we live in and serve.

Hear from our current employees and discover the people behind Ferrellgas: Employee Testimonials

raw.description:
Leidos is seeking a Network Engineer to support Federal Civil customer in the Washington, DC metropolitan area.


LOCATION: This position is remote; however, prefer candidates that are within driving distance to the Washington, DC area.

CLEARANCE: Must be a U.S. Citizen capable of obtaining and maintaining a Public Trust clearance prior to start.


POSITION SUMMARY:

This role supports the engineering, operation, maintenance, and modernization of secure, mission-critical enterprise networks across geographically distributed environments.

Working alongside the Senior Network Engineer, you’ll implement, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network solutions across on-premises and hybrid cloud infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with engineering, cybersecurity, and service desk teams to keep the network available, high-performing, and secure while supporting modernization efforts. You’ll also contribute to documentation, configuration management, and continuous service improvement.

A strong foundation in networking and the ability to work across multiple network technologies are essential.


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Serve as a Tier 2/3 technical resource for operational and engineering issues affecting mission-critical enterprise infrastructure, escalating complex architectural challenges to the Senior Network Engineer as needed.
  • Assist in the planning, deployment, configuration, and maintenance of network infrastructure solutions across geographically distributed, multi-vendor environments.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot technical network issues involving multiple systems, implementing approved corrective actions to maintain network reliability, performance, and security.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise routing and switching infrastructure, including BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, routing redundancy, and network failover.
  • Administer and support enterprise network security solutions, including Cisco Firepower, Firepower Management Center (FMC), ASA, firewall rule updates, access controls, and security hardening.
  • Implement, monitor, and sustain secure site-to-site and remote-access VPN solutions, including Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect and connectivity with external partners and vendors.
  • Support and maintain hybrid cloud network connectivity integrating on-premises infrastructure with AWS networking services, including VPCs, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, and load balancing.
  • Administer enterprise wireless networking and network access control technologies, including Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE).
  • Support the execution of network infrastructure upgrades, modernization initiatives, lifecycle replacements, and security remediation activities under the technical guidance of senior engineering staff.
  • Monitor network performance, availability, and capacity; assist in gathering metrics and implementing approved improvements to strengthen service delivery and operational resilience.
  • Participate in incident investigations and root cause analysis, gathering diagnostic data and executing corrective and preventive tasks.
  • Collaborate with internal engineering teams, cybersecurity teams, vendors, and service providers to troubleshoot issues, coordinate maintenance windows, and implement technical tasks.
  • Update and maintain network diagrams, configuration records, technical implementation plans, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Execute incident, problem, change, and service request management tickets while ensuring technical accuracy, thorough documentation, and adherence to SLAs.
  • Partner with the Senior Network Engineer to test and implement network automation scripts, configuration templates, and process improvements to increase operational efficiency.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree and 4 years’ experience; additional years of experience accepted in lieu of degree.
  • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, administering, and troubleshooting complex enterprise network infrastructure in production environments.
  • Strong working knowledge and hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise routing and switching technologies, including BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, and network redundancy/failover.
  • Hands-on experience supporting and administering Cisco and/or Juniper enterprise networking platforms (such as Juniper EX/QFX & Junos OS, and Cisco ISR & IOS devices) in multi-vendor environments.
  • Hands-on experience configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise network security infrastructure, including Cisco ASA, Firepower & FMC, access control policies, and remote-access VPN solutions (Cisco AnyConnect/Secure Client).
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot multi-system network issues, assist with root cause analysis (RCA), and implement approved corrective actions.
  • Experience executing network infrastructure changes, device upgrades, and security remediation activities in production environments following established change control procedures.
  • Experience updating and maintaining accurate network diagrams, technical documentation, configuration records, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with experience working alongside senior engineers, cross-functional teams, vendors, and ISPs to resolve operational issues.
  • Familiarity or hands-on experience supporting AWS network infrastructure and hybrid cloud connectivity (e.g., VPCs, Direct Connect, Transit Gateways, load balancers).
  • Experience administering enterprise wireless infrastructure and Network Access Control (NAC) solutions, such as Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE).
  • Exposure to virtual computing platforms (e.g., VMware/vSphere) as they relate to network connectivity, as well as Cisco CUCM/UC voice solutions.
  • Active Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) certification.
  • Ability to obtain a DoD 8140 / IAT Level II baseline certification (e.g., Security+ CE, CySA+, CCNA-Security, GSEC, SSCP).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Cisco Certified CCNP or Juniper JNCIP-ENT.
  • Experience with Cisco Meraki wireless solutions.
  • Experience with Cisco ISE.
  • Experience with Dell switches and OS10.
  • Experience with ServiceNow.
  • Security+ CE certification.

*** Candidates selected for an interview should note that it will be conducted live via video, with cameras on at all times. As part of our identity verification process, a photo will be taken during the interview to confirm your identity and help protect against fraud. At hire, candidates complete formal identity verification.***


If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

November 13, 2026

Pay Range:

Pay Range $73,450.00 - $132,775.00

The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.

The Director of Marketing leads marketing strategy and execution across WorldVia Travel Network and WorldVia.com, with responsibility for driving lead generation, supporting revenue growth, and strengthening brand performance across the company’s key lines of business. This role owns the marketing plans and programs that bring demand into the business, turn attention into action, and help ensure marketing contributes directly to measurable business outcomes.

This person will oversee internal and freelance marketing teams, guide multi-channel campaigns, and ensure marketing efforts support both brand growth and revenue performance. The ideal candidate brings travel agency, host agency, travel brand, or adjacent travel-industry experience, along with the ability to lead teams, manage priorities, and connect marketing activity to growth.

Requirements

Marketing Strategy & Growth

  • Develop and execute integrated marketing strategies for WorldVia Travel Network and WorldVia.com that support lead generation, customer acquisition, member engagement, and revenue growth.
  • Oversee lead generation performance across both brands, including the planning, execution, optimization, and reporting needed to grow qualified demand.
  • Monitor travel industry trends, customer behavior, and competitor activity to identify opportunities for innovation, differentiation, and growth.
  • Establish annual marketing priorities, goals, and performance measures aligned with company and revenue strategies.

Marketing Leadership

  • Lead, develop, and mentor the marketing organization, including internal and freelance marketing contributors across functions such as network marketing, consumer marketing, partner marketing, content, communications, creative, and digital execution.
  • Direct the work of internal staff, freelancers, agencies, and external vendors to ensure alignment with company objectives.
  • Establish clear goals, priorities, accountability measures, and professional development plans for marketing team members.
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance marketing culture focused on results, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Oversee marketing budgets, resource allocation, agency relationships, and departmental planning.

Campaign & Channel Oversight

  • Oversee event marketing efforts across the business, including campaigns that drive awareness, registrations, attendance, follow-up engagement, and business impact for in-person and virtual events.
  • Oversee marketing efforts across digital marketing, email marketing, social media, website marketing, paid media, search, content, and event-related channels.
  • Guide the creation of sales and marketing collateral, promotional materials, presentations, messaging, and campaign assets across brands and audiences.

Revenue Performance

  • Analyze marketing, campaign, event, and channel performance data to evaluate effectiveness, improve results, and inform future investment decisions.

Cross Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the primary marketing leader partnering Partner closely with sales, agency development, partner relations, member development, and executive leadership to ensure marketing supports the company’s broader growth and revenue goals.
  • Represent the marketing function in strategic planning and leadership discussions.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with key internal stakeholders, external partners, agencies, and freelance contributors.

Leadership Scope

The Director of Marketing leads a multi-part marketing function that includes both day-to-day execution oversight and broader planning responsibility across brands and revenue priorities. This role is responsible for helping teams do their best work, keeping initiatives on track, and ensuring campaigns, event marketing, and lead generation programs are aligned with the company’s goals.

This is a hands-on leadership role that requires strong judgment, collaboration, and follow-through. The person in this role should be comfortable leading people, setting direction, reviewing work, and staying close enough to the details to maintain quality and performance.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
  • Progressive marketing experience, including leadership responsibility for multi-channel marketing functions.
  • Demonstrated success developing and leading marketing strategies that contributed to business growth, customer acquisition, engagement, and revenue performance.
  • Experience leading marketing teams, including responsibility for performance management, coaching, prioritization, and resource allocation.
  • Experience owning or significantly contributing to lead generation programs and campaign performance.
  • Experience supporting event marketing, including attendance-driving campaigns and follow-up engagement.
  • Experience managing or coordinating the work of internal teams, freelancers, agencies, or other contributors.
  • Experience in the travel agency, host agency, travel brand, hospitality, or broader travel industry space.
  • Ability to connect marketing activity to business growth and revenue impact.
  • 10-25% travel for attendance at company meetings, team collaboration, industry events, and other business-related activities.

Preferred

  • Experience working across both B2B and B2C brand environments.
  • Experience marketing to independent travel advisors, agency owners, and travel consumers.
  • Experience with website-driven acquisition, digital demand generation, and content-led campaigns.

Competencies

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to lead and manage teams with clarity and accountability.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to guide marketing decisions.
  • Strong understanding of lead generation and performance-oriented marketing.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, contributors, and deadlines at once.
  • Collaborative mindset and strong cross-functional partnership skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 and modern marketing and reporting tools.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Fully-Funded Life Insurance (1x salary) & LTD (Long-Term Disability Insurance)
  • Optional Employee-Paid Vision Insurance and STD (Short-Term Disability Insurance)
  • 401k with up to 4% Company Match
  • Paid Time Off + Company Holidays
  • Additional Time Off for Your Birthday and Work Anniversary
  • Discount Travel Program
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth
  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
  • Collaborative and innovative work environment

Equal Opportunity & E-Verify Statement
WorldVia is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

raw.description:
Job Title: Content Writer / Copywriter

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: U.S. client business hours (with flexibility for deadlines and content calendars)

About the Role:

Our client is seeking a Content Writer / Copywriter to create compelling, high-quality content that informs, engages, and converts. This role involves producing blog posts, landing pages, ad copy, sales collateral, and thought leadership content. The Writer ensures all outputs are on-brand, SEO-friendly, and aligned with marketing and sales objectives.

Responsibilities:

  • Content Creation:
    • Write long-form and short-form content including blogs, case studies, whitepapers, newsletters, and web pages.
    • Produce copy for ads, email campaigns, and sales collateral.
    • Ensure all content aligns with brand voice, style, and tone.
  • SEO & Optimization:
    • Research keywords and incorporate SEO best practices into writing.
    • Collaborate with SEO specialists to optimize for search intent and ranking.
    • Update existing content to maintain freshness and relevance.
  • Research & Subject Expertise:
    • Conduct in-depth research on industry topics, competitors, and trends.
    • Interview subject matter experts (SMEs) for thought leadership content.
    • Translate complex topics into clear, engaging copy.
  • Editing & Quality Assurance:
    • Proofread for grammar, clarity, and consistency.
    • Ensure deliverables are accurate, plagiarism-free, and error-free.
    • Maintain content calendars and deliver work on time.
  • Collaboration:
    • Work with designers, marketers, and sales teams to align copy with visuals and campaigns.
    • Incorporate stakeholder feedback into revisions while maintaining brand integrity.
  • Performance Tracking:
    • Monitor content performance using Google Analytics, HubSpot, or similar tools.
    • Provide recommendations to improve engagement, conversions, and SEO rankings.

What Makes You a Perfect Fit:

  • Strong storyteller with a flair for persuasive and engaging writing.
  • Skilled at tailoring tone and style for different audiences and formats.
  • Organized multitasker who can manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
  • Curious researcher who thrives on learning new industries and topics.

Required Experience & Skills (Minimum):

  • 2+ years professional writing or copywriting experience.
  • Portfolio of content across multiple formats (blogs, web copy, ads, collateral).
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office/Google Workspace.
  • Strong research and editing skills.

Ideal Experience & Skills:

  • Background writing for B2B SaaS, marketing agencies, or professional services.
  • Familiarity with SEO tools (SEMrush, Ahrefs, Clearscope).
  • Experience writing conversion-focused copy (ads, landing pages, email sequences).
  • Knowledge of content management systems (WordPress, HubSpot).

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A Content Writer / Copywriter’s day revolves around producing high-quality, conversion-focused content. You will:

  • Research industry trends and gather insights for upcoming topics.
  • Draft blog posts and long-form content for marketing campaigns.
  • Write ad copy, landing page text, or sales collateral to support lead generation and deals.
  • Collaborate with designers and marketers to align copy with visuals and campaign strategy.
  • Edit and proof content for accuracy and brand consistency.
  • Track content performance and optimize older pieces for better SEO and conversions.

In essence: you ensure content is persuasive, optimized, and impactful, fueling marketing and sales results.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs):

  • Consistent content delivery aligned with deadlines.
  • Growth in organic traffic and engagement from written content.
  • Conversion performance of landing pages and ad copy.
  • SEO rankings and visibility for target keywords.
  • Positive stakeholder feedback on clarity and effectiveness of content.

Interview Process:

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Portfolio Review + Practical Task (e.g., draft a blog intro and ad copy for a sample product)
  4. Client Interview with Marketing Leadership
  5. Offer & Background Verification

Established in 1985, The ALS Association is the only national nonprofit organization fighting ALS on every front. By leading the way in global research, providing assistance for people with ALS through a nationwide network of chapters, coordinating multidisciplinary care through certified clinical care centers, and fostering government partnerships, the Association builds hope and enhances quality of life while aggressively searching for new treatments and a cure

Position Summary
The Sr. Director of PR and Strategic Partnerships provides strategic leadership in elevating the ALS Association’s brand, expanding its influence, and strengthening its reputation through high-impact public relations initiatives and strategic partnerships. This role focuses on building relationships with organizations, institutions, businesses, and influential stakeholders that extend the Association’s reach, increase awareness of its mission, and reinforce its position as a leading voice in the ALS community.

Public relations and strategic partnerships are viewed as core organizational functions that drive brand visibility, strengthen stakeholder trust, identify new opportunities for collaboration, and inform organizational decision-making. The Sr. Director will develop and execute integrated strategies that leverage partnerships to elevate the ALS Association’s brand, amplify its mission, increase engagement, and advance its long-term priorities.
Working closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams, this individual will identify and cultivate partnerships that create meaningful value for the Association, its supporters, and the ALS community while advancing the mission to make ALS a livable disease while working toward a world without ALS.

Strategic Public Relations and Brand Elevation
  • Develop and execute integrated public relations and brand strategies that strengthen the ALS Association’s reputation, visibility, credibility, and influence.
  • Establish strategic partnerships as a key driver of brand awareness, audience growth, community engagement, and organizational impact.
  • Identify opportunities to align the ALS Association with mission-compatible organizations, institutions, businesses, and influential stakeholders to expand its reach and strengthen brand recognition.
  • Build a consistent and compelling public presence that reinforces the Association’s leadership, impact, and commitment to the ALS community.
  • Identify emerging reputational, political, regulatory, and community issues that may affect the Association and recommend proactive strategies.
  • Ensure public relations and partnership initiatives align with organizational priorities, programmatic goals, fundraising objectives, and long-term brand strategy.

Community Engagement and Strategic Partnerships
  • Develop and execute a strategic partnership approach that elevates the ALS Association’s brand and expands its presence across relevant industries, communities, and stakeholder networks.
  • Identify, cultivate, and manage partnerships that increase awareness of ALS, introduce the Association to new audiences, and create opportunities for deeper engagement.
  • Build relationships with healthcare organizations, corporations, advocacy groups, community organizations, and other mission-aligned partners to advance shared objectives.
  • Create collaborative opportunities that leverage partner platforms, resources, expertise, and networks to amplify the Association’s mission and programs.
  • Work cross-functionally to develop partnership initiatives that deliver measurable value, strengthen brand affinity, and support organizational priorities.
  • Ensure partnerships reflect the Association’s values and contribute meaningfully to its reputation, visibility, and impact.
Program and Mission Public Relations
  • Lead public relations strategies that increase awareness and understanding of the Association’s programs, services, initiatives, and impact.
  • Partner with program leaders and cross-functional teams to identify compelling stories, outcomes, and opportunities that demonstrate the value of the Association’s work.
  • Leverage strategic partnerships to amplify program visibility, support launches and expansions, and increase engagement with key initiatives.
  • Develop collaborative opportunities that connect the Association’s programs with external partners, platforms, and audiences to broaden reach and strengthen mission awareness.
  • Translate complex programmatic information into accessible, engaging narratives that resonate with people living with ALS, families, healthcare professionals, partners, donors, and the broader public.
  • Ensure program public relations efforts reinforce the Association’s brand and demonstrate how its work supports people living with ALS and their families.
Executive Counsel and Issues Management
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on brand strategy, public relations, partnership opportunities, stakeholder perceptions, and reputational considerations.
  • Provide strategic guidance on partnership decisions and external opportunities that may affect the Association’s brand, credibility, or mission.
  • Identify emerging opportunities to strengthen the Association’s influence, expand its network, and elevate its position within the nonprofit, healthcare, advocacy, and corporate sectors.
  • Anticipate potential challenges and develop proactive strategies to address issues affecting the organization, its programs, partnerships, or the ALS community.
  • Bring external perspectives and stakeholder insights into strategic discussions and organizational planning.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in public relations, communications, marketing, business, public affairs, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Seven to ten years of progressive experience in public relations, brand strategy, strategic partnerships, business development, or a related field, including senior-level leadership experience.
  • Demonstrated success developing strategies that elevate organizational brands, expand visibility, and strengthen reputation through strategic partnerships.
  • Experience cultivating relationships with corporate, healthcare, nonprofit, advocacy, and other mission-aligned partners.
  • Proven ability to identify and execute partnerships that create shared value, expand audience reach, and advance organizational objectives.
  • Experience advising executive leadership and navigating sensitive issues, complex stakeholder relationships, and reputational risks.
  • Strong strategic judgment, relationship-building skills, written and verbal communication abilities, and cross-functional leadership experience.
  • Experience in nonprofit, healthcare, advocacy, or association environments preferred.
  • A demonstrated commitment to the mission of the ALS Association and the needs of people living with ALS and their families.
Measures of Success
  • Increased recognition, visibility, and positive perception of the ALS Association’s brand.
  • Strategic partnerships that expand the Association’s reach, introduce new audiences to its mission, and strengthen its position as a leading voice in the ALS community.
  • Measurable growth in partner engagement, collaborative initiatives, and opportunities for shared impact.
  • Increased awareness and understanding of the Association’s programs, services, and mission.
  • Stronger stakeholder trust and relationships across the ALS community and key partner networks.
  • Effective integration of public relations and strategic partnerships into organizational planning and priorities.
  • Proactive management of reputational risks and identification of opportunities to strengthen the Association’s influence and brand.
PAY TRANSPARENCY:
The ALS Association’s pay range for this position is $110,000–$125,000 annually.

The ALS Association has compensation ranges for various work locations throughout the United States, allowing us to compensate employees competitively and consistently in diverse geographic markets. The above-listed listed range shows prospective compensation for this role; the appropriate range will be established by what is eventually determined to be the candidate's primary work location. Various factors, including the complexity and significance of the role, job duties/requirements, relevant experience and abilities, and primary work location, determine individual compensation. Compensation ranges are evaluated and typically adjusted on a regular basis. Offers are made within the compensation range that is in effect at the time of the job offer.

The Association may, at its discretion, offer merit-based increases tied to individual performance. The benefits listed may differ depending on employment status with the Association. Healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan with employer match, short-term and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, well-being benefits, paid time off and several paid holidays are available to Association employees, among other benefits.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The ALS Association endeavors to make www.als.org accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please email . This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

The ALS Association highly encourages their employees to be fully vaccinated, as considered per the CDC guidelines, with the COVID-19 vaccination. Requirements to have or obtain a COVID-19 vaccination may be applicable by state, local, and other federal orders or applicable lawful requirements by third-party clinics, vendors, or events attended on ALS Association business. If applicable, proof of vaccination will be required, unless approved for a legally required exemption by The ALS Association.

raw.description:
Shape a SAP architecture designed to scale with InPost

We are looking for an experienced SAP Solution Architect (m/f/n) to take architectural ownership of InPost Group's evolving SAP ecosystem, spanning integration and middleware, systems roadmaps, and the global SAP S/4HANA template.

This is an opportunity to influence technology decisions across a fast-growing international organization. You will connect business priorities, technology capabilities and architectural principles to create a SAP landscape that remains coherent, scalable and maintainable as the organization evolves.

Where you will make an impact

Create a coherent integration architecture

You will shape how SAP connects to InPost's critical business systems, including WMS, TMS, EAM/PAM, InvoiceAggregator, Paycom, Pascom, CRM and billing platforms.

You will:

  • define integration standards based on SAP BTP, Integration Suite, API Management and Event Mesh,
  • establish and evolve the API catalogue, versioning policies and lifecycle management,
  • select appropriate integration patterns across APIs, ESB, event-driven architectures and iPaaS,
  • review integration designs and partner with delivery teams during implementation,
  • establish standards covering REST, OData, SOAP, EDI, RFC/BAPI, IDoc and gRPC.

A central part of your role will be shaping and governing the global SAP S/4HANA system template.

You will establish clear principles around clean core, standard functionality and extension boundaries, while building reusable integration and extension patterns for country rollouts.

Across Poland, Italy, Iberia and Luxembourg, you will evaluate local requirements and help determine whether capabilities belong in the global core or should remain local extensions.

You will thrive in this role if you:

  • have 7+ years of SAP experience, including at least 3 years as an architect or senior technical consultant,
  • have strong hands-on understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, clean core and extensibility,
  • know SAP BTP, especially Integration Suite (CPI/iFlow), API Management, Event Mesh and BAS,
  • understand ABAP Cloud, RAP and CAP,
  • are comfortable working with REST, SOAP, OData, EDI, RFC/BAPI, IDoc and gRPC,
  • understand OpenAPI/Swagger, AsyncAPI and BPMN,
  • have enough functional knowledge of FI/CO, SD, MM, WM/EWM and TM to assess architectural implications,
  • are familiar with TOGAF, SAP EA Framework or an equivalent architecture framework,
  • can communicate architecture through C4, sequence and landscape diagrams,
  • understand Domain-Driven Design and microservices architecture,
  • understand integration security, including OAuth2, SAML, mTLS and encryption in transit and at rest.

What we offer

  • Fulfilling careers with a range of benefits for people and investing in providing training opportunities for their development.
  • You will feel a part of the InPost community that makes an impact on sustainability, convenient deliveries, and the circular economy every day.
  • Excellent environment and flexible hours
  • We offer B2B type of contract

InPost Group is an innovative European out of home deliveries company, revolutionizing the way parcels are delivered to customers. With operations across several countries, our network of intelligent lockers provides customers with a fast, convenient, and secure delivery option. InPost Group is a publicly traded company, with a market capitalization of about $5 billion as of March 2023. With over 10,000 people worldwide, InPost Group is one of the largest out of home delivery providers in Europe, committed to providing sustainable and efficient delivery solutions to meet the evolving needs of customers in today's rapidly changing landscape.

At World Fuel, our employees are the key to our global success. We are industry leaders due to the innumerable talents of our approximately 5000 strong professional team. Our people thrive in an entrepreneurial and culturally-diverse environment, where innovative thinking, collaboration and efficient execution are highly valued. Our high-performance culture is what allows us to drive sustained growth. Stronger together, we promote an environment where individuals can thrive.

Tax Analyst, Indirect Tax (Fuel Excise)

Location: U.S. Remote


About the Role

World Fuel is seeking a detail-oriented Tax Analyst to join our Indirect Tax team. This role is ideal for a tax professional with experience in U.S. fuel excise tax compliance who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and partnering across finance, operations, and compliance teams.

Reporting to the Tax Supervisor and Tax Manager, you will support fuel excise, environmental, and indirect tax compliance activities across a diverse portfolio of businesses. You'll play a key role in ensuring accurate tax reporting, resolving tax notices, supporting audits, and maintaining compliance with federal, state, and local tax requirements.


What You'll Do

  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual fuel excise and environmental tax returns.
  • Reconcile tax liability accounts and supporting schedules using BlackLine.
  • Research federal, state, and local tax requirements to ensure compliance.
  • Maintain exemption certificates, tax records, and supporting documentation.
  • Utilize Avalara and AKORE software for tax reporting and compliance activities.
  • Research and respond to tax notices from taxing authorities.
  • Support motor fuel tax compliance by reviewing state regulations and tax communications.
  • Assist with audit requests and examinations by gathering documentation and conducting tax research.
  • Participate in tax dispute resolution and compliance-related projects.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements and operational efficiencies.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to support ongoing tax compliance requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience preparing and filing U.S. fuel excise tax returns.
  • Experience with indirect tax compliance, including fuel, environmental, sales, or use tax.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and formulas.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines and prioritize work effectively.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with BlackLine, Avalara, AKORE, Oracle, PDI, or OTS.
  • Experience working with fuel distributors, energy companies, convenience retail, transportation, or related industries.
  • Exposure to tax audits, tax notices, or tax controversy matters.

Why Join World Fuel?

  • Fully remote opportunity within the United States
  • Exposure to complex multi-jurisdictional fuel and indirect tax matters
  • Opportunity to work with a collaborative and experienced tax team
  • Broad visibility across a global energy and fuel organization
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package

Credentialing Background: Working knowledge of provider credentialing and payer enrollment processes.

Communication & Autonomy: Strong written and verbal English communication skills, high attention to detail, and the ability to work independently with consistent follow-through.

Schedule Alignment: Availability to work 20 hours per week during Central Time (CT) business hours.

Please note that this is a full-time contractor position (40 hours per week) with a starting pay rate of $6 per hour depending on skillset and experience. This is a part-time opportunity; the schedule is Monday through Friday, 8am-5pm, CST.

raw.description:
Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our Mission is to “Transform mental health by making it more accessible, affordable and effective”.

About the role

The Director of HR Operations owns the systems, analytics, compensation programs, and compliance processes that keep our people function running accurately and at scale. In our outpatient behavioral healthcare setting, that means supporting providers, clinical teams and corporate staff across multiple states, and the business-aligned HR processes that help the People team function as productive, collaborative partners to the business.

This leader oversees HR Systems, project manager, compliance, and analytics and compensation. They partner closely with HR Business Partners, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Credentialing, IT and operational leaders to turn HR strategy into reliable, efficient, and business aligned programs.

This leader is both strategist and hands-on contributor. They set direction for compensation, payroll and HR compliance, and they also build the models, run the analysis and deliver the cycles themselves, in close partnership with Finance.

Reports to: Chief People Officer

Direct reports: HRIS Manager/Team; HR Operations Analyst

Key responsibilities

HR Systems

  • Own the HR systems ecosystem end to end, including core HR functions; hiring, compensation, performance management, absence, time tracking, payroll integrations, recruiting and related modules.
  • Partner with the Workday Manager to configure, test and manage system updates, including feature releases,with documented testing and sign-off for changes that affect pay or compliance.
  • Partner with Workday Manager to design business processes, security roles and data governance to protect data, in line with HIPAA and internal privacy standards.
  • Oversee integrations with payroll, benefits carriers, credentialing, scheduling and timekeeping systems used by staff and clinical teams.
  • Ensure time tracking and pay rules are configured to meet state wage and hour requirements, including overtime, meal and rest breaks, and PTO accrual rules.
  • Manage vendor and implementation partner relationships, including contracts, SLAs and roadmap planning.

Compensation and Performance Management

  • Partner with Finance and executive leadership on compensation strategy, and lead compensation insights for clinical teams and corporate staff, including base pay, productivity, incentive and bonus plans.
  • Partner with Finance to model plan costs, set compensation budgets and forecast labor spend, so pay decisions are tied to the financial plan.
  • Own the salary structures, pay ranges and job architecture (job families, levels and titles), and the job evaluation approach for new and changing roles.
  • Lead and run the full calendar of performance and compensation cycles, working with Finance on budgets, accruals and payout reconciliation, including:
  • Annual performance reviews, calibration and staff merit and market adjustments
  • Monthly or quarterly team incentive and productivity payouts
  • Twice-yearly provider compensation reviews
  • Bonus, retention, one-time, and recurring programs as needed
  • Partner with Payroll and Finance so payouts are accurate, on time and correctly accounted for; oversee program documentation, administration, reporting and audits.
  • Set the standard for plan documents, program guides, manager training and pay communications - oversee the compensation support model, using trends in questions and discrepancies to improve guides, training and plan design.

HR Compliance and Controls

  • Ensure compensation packages and structures are fair, consistent, and compliant with all applicable laws and statutes, including pay transparency.
  • Own FLSA classification for all roles, including exempt and non-exempt determinations and run periodic classification audits as roles and state salary thresholds change.
  • Maintain internal controls across HR systems and payroll, including segregation of duties, approval workflows, audit trails, and support internal and external audits, agency inquiries and accreditation surveys.
  • Partner with Finance and Payroll to support accurate, timely, and compliant payroll and payroll processes, controls, and audits across all pay groups and states.

HR Analytics and Reporting

  • Own HR reporting and analytics, covering headcount, turnover, retention, time-to-fill, labor cost and provider productivity.
  • Lead the build, maintenance and refresh of workforce dashboards and recurring reports for executive and operational leaders.
  • Act as the senior HR data liaison: set metric definitions and data quality standards in HR systems, and manage intake for ad hoc data requests across the business.
  • Own regulatory and accreditation reporting, including EEO-1, state pay data reports, ACA reporting and any workforce requirements of any accrediting group.
  • Serve as the main liaison between Operations, HR and Finance on compensation, workforce planning and position management.

HR Project Management

  • Lead the HR project portfolio, including intake, prioritization, timelines, resourcing and status reporting; own compensation, compliance, payroll, analytics and systems projects from start to finish.
  • Coordinate stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Legal, IT and HR, and keep leaders informed on progress and risks.
  • Apply change management practices so new processes and tools are adopted across provider, clinical and corporate teams.
  • Drive continuous improvement and documented standard operating procedures across HR operations and payroll.

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in HR operations, HRIS, compensation or payroll, including 5+ years leading teams in a combined HR operations leadership role.
  • Hands-on Workday HCM experience, including configuration, business processes, security and reporting.
  • Hands-on experience designing, modeling and running compensation programs, including salary structures, annual merit cycles and productivity or incentive plans, in close partnership with Finance.
  • Working knowledge of FLSA, multi-state wage and hour law, pay equity and pay transparency requirements, ACA employer reporting and data privacy requirements, including HIPAA.
  • Experience designing and maintaining internal controls and supporting internal or external audits.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience building workforce reporting and dashboards.
  • Proven track record leading complex, cross-functional HR projects from planning through adoption.
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Compensation: $170,000 + 25% annual bonus

Estimated earnings:

$170,000.00-$175,000.00

Job Description:

Security Analyst – World Trade Center Health Program (WTCHP TPA)


Overview:
GDIT is seeking a Security Analyst to support day‑to‑day security operations for the World Trade Center Health Program TPA. This role strengthens protection of PHI/PII, ensures compliance with NIST 800‑53/FISMA Moderate and HIPAA, and supports continuous monitoring across cloud and on‑premise environments. You will play a key role in threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management, and security governance.

What You’ll Do:

  • Monitor and triage security alerts across SIEM (Splunk), EDR (CrowdStrike), DLP tools, and cloud telemetry.
    • Lead or support incident response activities: investigation, containment, eradication, and lessons learned.
    • Execute vulnerability management processes including scanning, validation, prioritization, remediation tracking, and reporting.
    • Contribute to POA&Ms, SSP updates, audit responses, and control evidence collection.
    • Support identity and access governance, least‑privilege reviews, and privileged access monitoring.
    • Build or refine detection content, playbooks, and automation for common WTCHP security scenarios.
    • Partner with engineering, infrastructure, and DevOps teams to embed security into change management processes.
    • Maintain runbooks, metrics, and dashboards; report on control health and operational risk.

Required Qualifications:

  • 3–5 years in security operations or blue‑team roles within regulated healthcare or federal environments
    • Hands‑on experience with SIEM (Splunk), EDR (CrowdStrike or similar), vulnerability scanners (Tenable/Nessus), and DLP tools
    • Familiarity with NIST 800‑53, HIPAA, RMF, log management, and cloud environments (AWS/Azure)

CompTIA Security+ (required or must be obtained within 6 months)
• Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills
• Ability to participate in on‑call rotation
• Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust (Moderate Risk) background investigation

Preferred Qualifications:


Additional certifications such as Splunk User/Power User, AWS/Azure security, CySA+, or CEH
• Experience with ServiceNow/Jira, SPL/KQL queries, Python/PowerShell scripting, or DLP tuning
• Exposure to FedRAMP control environments, zero‑trust principles, and PHI governance

The likely salary range for this position is $85,093 - $115,000. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, merchant success is about understanding the businesses behind our customer accounts. We value people who know how online merchants operate, take initiative, communicate clearly, and help entrepreneurs solve practical problems. Our merchant success team plays an important role in helping businesses launch, manage, and grow their operations while building strong customer relationships.

About the Role

We're looking for a Merchant Success Lead to help guide Bask Health's merchant success activities, support important merchant relationships, and improve how we deliver post-sale customer success to entrepreneurs and online businesses.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys working directly with merchants while helping other Customer Success Managers become more effective.

You'll help oversee day-to-day merchant success operations, support team members with complex accounts, and ensure merchants receive proactive, consistent communication.

Our merchants include entrepreneurs, e-commerce operators, online business owners, and healthcare businesses using Bask Health to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth services.

You'll bring a strong understanding of e-commerce businesses, online storefronts, merchant-facing software, and the challenges entrepreneurs face when launching and scaling online operations.

You'll help merchants understand Bask Health's platform and identify practical ways to use its capabilities effectively.

You'll support merchant onboarding, activation, adoption, retention, and ongoing account management.

You'll help ensure new merchants have clear expectations and understand the steps involved in launching and operating their businesses on the platform.

You'll work with Customer Success Managers to identify merchant onboarding challenges and address problems before they affect the customer relationship.

You'll provide day-to-day guidance to team members handling merchant questions, account concerns, and platform-related issues.

You'll help establish consistent expectations for merchant communication, follow-through, and account ownership.

You'll serve as a resource for CSMs who need assistance navigating complex merchant situations.

You'll coach team members on merchant communication, account planning, problem-solving, and managing difficult conversations.

You'll share practical guidance that helps team members become more confident and independent.

You'll help review merchant interactions and identify opportunities to improve service quality and customer outcomes.

You'll support customer success leadership with team performance monitoring and operational planning.

You'll help identify gaps in existing merchant success workflows and recommend improvements.

You'll contribute to merchant success playbooks, internal documentation, and training resources.

You'll help ensure merchant information, account notes, and follow-up commitments are documented accurately.

You'll maintain direct involvement with selected merchant accounts as needed.

You'll build relationships with entrepreneurs, business owners, and other merchant stakeholders.

You'll take time to understand each merchant's business model, goals, operational challenges, and experience with e-commerce software.

You'll help merchants understand how Bask Health's supported capabilities relate to their business needs.

You'll work with merchants who may be unfamiliar with certain aspects of telehealth software, online storefront configuration, or platform workflows.

You'll communicate technical information clearly without overwhelming merchants with unnecessary detail.

You'll help merchants navigate common platform workflows and recognize when specialist assistance is required.

You'll identify merchants who may be experiencing adoption challenges or declining engagement.

You'll work with the team to develop appropriate follow-up plans for at-risk merchant accounts.

You'll help monitor merchant health, platform adoption, retention risks, and recurring support concerns.

You'll support renewal preparation and help identify opportunities for merchants to get additional value from the platform.

You'll recognize appropriate expansion opportunities and coordinate with customer success leadership or sales when needed.

You'll help ensure expansion conversations are based on merchant needs and supported platform capabilities.

You'll participate in merchant business reviews and account planning discussions.

You'll help merchants understand their progress, identify obstacles, and determine useful next steps.

You'll take ownership of important merchant escalations when additional experience or coordination is needed.

You'll work with technical support and customer success engineering teams to investigate platform-related issues.

You'll help ensure merchant-facing teams communicate accurate information while technical issues are being addressed.

You'll follow through on escalations and make sure merchants receive appropriate updates.

You'll identify recurring technical problems and communicate patterns to product and engineering teams.

You'll collaborate with product managers to share merchant feedback and recommend practical improvements.

You'll help identify storefront, onboarding, checkout, or platform usability issues that create unnecessary merchant frustration.

You'll support improvements to merchant education materials and self-service resources.

Bask Health's platform includes merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business capabilities.

You'll develop a strong working knowledge of the platform so you can guide merchants effectively.

You'll understand how different platform capabilities connect to a merchant's day-to-day business operations.

You'll recognize when merchant questions require technical, clinical, pharmacy, or compliance expertise.

You'll coordinate with authorized teams when requests involve regulated healthcare activities.

You'll follow appropriate privacy, security, and customer information-handling procedures.

You'll help establish clear internal escalation practices so issues reach the right teams.

You'll collaborate with customer success leadership on team priorities, workload distribution, and operational improvements.

You'll help identify situations where merchant accounts require additional attention or support.

You'll participate in regular team discussions to review merchant challenges, share knowledge, and improve processes.

You'll help new team members understand merchant success expectations and platform workflows.

You'll contribute to onboarding and training new Customer Success Managers.

You'll help establish a team environment that values initiative, accountability, clear communication, and continuous improvement.

You'll support leadership in reviewing merchant success performance metrics.

You'll help monitor relevant indicators such as onboarding progress, merchant engagement, response times, customer satisfaction, and retention risks.

You'll use merchant feedback and operational information to recommend improvements.

You'll work closely with customer success leadership to identify recurring problems and prioritize practical solutions.

You'll be expected to balance merchant advocacy with operational efficiency and company priorities.

You'll take ownership of assigned work and follow through without needing constant direction.

We're looking for someone with substantial hands-on post-sale customer success experience and a demonstrated ability to guide, coach, or mentor other team members.

You should have recent, meaningful e-commerce experience and understand how merchant-facing SaaS businesses operate.

You'll need to be comfortable handling merchant conversations, troubleshooting problems, coordinating across departments, and helping the team maintain high standards.

Success in this role means helping merchants achieve their goals, strengthening the performance of the customer success team, reducing preventable escalations, and improving the consistency of our merchant success operations.

What You'll Do

  • Support day-to-day merchant success operations and team execution.
  • Provide guidance and coaching to Customer Success Managers.
  • Help establish consistent merchant communication and account management standards.
  • Support merchant onboarding, activation, adoption, and ongoing engagement.
  • Maintain direct involvement with selected merchant accounts.
  • Help merchants understand Bask Health's platform and supported capabilities.
  • Guide team members through complex merchant situations.
  • Serve as an escalation resource for important merchant concerns.
  • Coordinate with technical support and customer success engineering on platform issues.
  • Ensure merchants receive accurate updates and appropriate follow-through.
  • Identify recurring merchant challenges and recommend improvements.
  • Help monitor merchant health, engagement, and retention risks.
  • Support proactive outreach to merchants experiencing adoption difficulties.
  • Assist with merchant business reviews and account planning.
  • Support renewal preparation and appropriate expansion opportunities.

  • Participate in team planning and workload coordination.
