You’ve built experience, now use it where bold ideas meet real impact. At Opella, we’re challenging how self-care works for millions of people and need leaders and experts ready to shape what’s next. As an Senior Sales Analyst, you’ll bring your skill, your curiosity and your drive to make health simpler, smarter and more human.


About the job:

  • Lead initiatives that advance our brands and strengthen our reputation worldwide.
  • Mentor and uplift emerging talent while pushing your own growth and influence.
  • Put purpose into practice — embedding sustainability, access and social impact into every decision.
  • Model the challenger mindset: question complexity, act with integrity and make things radically simple.
  • Help shape a culture that’s ambitious, collaborative and serious about recognition and belonging.
  • Lead customer-level forecasting and business planning by analyzing retailer POS, syndicated, shopper, financial, and sales data to deliver accurate forecasts, actionable insights, and strategic recommendations that drive profitable growth.
  • Partner with the Drug Customer team to identify opportunities and risks, improve forecasting processes, automate reporting, and develop data-driven selling stories that influence assortment, pricing, promotion, distribution, eCommerce, and overall customer strategy decisions.

Main responsibilities:

  • Lead SKU-level forecasting and business planning for the Drug channel, partnering with Sales, Demand Planning, Supply Chain, and Finance to deliver accurate volume and revenue projections.
  • Analyze consumption trends, seasonality, distribution changes, promotions, inventory levels, innovation pipelines, and market dynamics to identify risks, opportunities, and forecast drivers.
  • Own weekly and monthly business analytics, providing insights on sales, POS, shipments, inventory, market share, category trends, pricing, distribution, and competitive performance.
  • Deliver data-driven recommendations that support customer strategy, line reviews, joint business planning, assortment decisions, pricing, promotions, eCommerce growth, and overall sales performance.
  • Conduct strategic analyses and executive reporting, translating complex data into actionable insights that inform business decisions and improve results.
  • Build and enhance dashboards, forecasting models, reporting tools, and automated processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, scalability, and decision-making.
  • Serve as a trusted analytics partner across Sales, Category Management, Finance, Revenue Growth Management, Supply Chain, and Operations, influencing business outcomes through data-driven insights and cross-functional collaboration.

About you:

  • Bachelor’s degree required in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Analytics, Supply Chain, or a related field; MBA preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in CPG sales analytics, forecasting, category management, revenue growth management, customer development, or commercial analytics.
  • Proven ability to build forecasts and leverage POS, syndicated, and customer data to drive business decisions and identify growth opportunities.
  • Strong analytical and technical skills, including advanced Excel, financial modeling, and experience with Circana/IRI, Nielsen, Power BI, and planning systems.
  • Experience within Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Consumer Health, Grocery, Drug, or Mass retail channels strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of SQL, Python, Power Query, automation, and advanced analytics tools to streamline reporting and improve business insights.
  • Demonstrated success influencing business outcomes through accurate forecasting, actionable analytics, customer planning support, process automation, and strong cross-functional partnerships.

This is more than the next step in your career, it’s a chance to lead change and help reinvent self-care for the world. If you’re ready to challenge, inspire and deliver impact that matters, we’re ready for you.


We are challengers. We are Opella.


Opella values diversity in all its forms and is committed to fostering a workplace where everyone can belong and excel. We welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds.


About Us:

Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over The Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.  


Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.


At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.


As a globally certified B Corp company, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at .

Sales Account Executive (DoW)

Team: Go-To-Market

Location: Remote (Washington D.C. Metro Area preferred)

Reports to: Sales Director

Active security clearance (or previously held clearance) or the ability to obtain one

Position Overview

Virtualitics is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Sales Account Executive to join our Federal Sales team and Go-To-Market (GTM) Organization. This individual will be a key driver of our growth within the Department of War(DoW), focusing on Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications that directly impact military readiness. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker, aggressive and outcome oriented, with a proven track record of selling complex AI software solutions into the DoW space and a deep understanding of the challenges facing the Dept. of War in areas of sustainment, logistics, and operational availability. Reporting directly to the Sales Director within GTM Organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Full-Cycle Sales Execution: Drive the entire sales process from initial prospecting and opportunity identification to contract negotiation and closing. Build and manage a robust sales pipeline to meet and exceed annual sales targets & Qtrly deal stage KPI’s.

  • Sales Account Management: Develop and execute comprehensive account strategies to penetrate key DoD agencies and commands. Identify key stakeholders, understand their challenges, and map our solutions to their critical readiness missions.

  • Customer Relationship Building: Establish and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships with decision-makers, influencers, and end-users within the DoW.

  • Solution-Oriented Selling: Act as a trusted advisor to clients by deeply understanding their specific readiness needs across various domains, including:

    • Aircraft, ship, and ground vehicle asset availability and sustainment operations.

    • Medical device and personnel readiness of the total force.

    • Materiel storage, warehousing management, and supply chain logistics for specialized equipment.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with the Virtualitics pre-sales engineering/solutions, marketing, Acct Mgmt, and product teams to create and deliver compelling demonstrations, proposals, and RFI/RFP responses that effectively communicate our value proposition.

  • Market Intelligence: Stay current on DoD trends, procurement processes, and competitive landscape to effectively position Virtualitics' solutions.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Required:

    • 5+ years of successful experience in a quota-carrying Federal Account Executive role, with a strong preference for experience within the DoW..

    • Demonstrated experience selling enterprise software, AI/ML, data analytics, or similar complex technology solutions.

    • Proven ability to develop and execute strategic account plans and manage complex sales cycles. Strong understanding of procurement & contracting for AI software acquisition process.

    • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate a complex value proposition to a technical and non-technical audience.

    • Self-starter with the ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment.

  • Preferred:

    • Existing relationships within DoW logistics, sustainment, or readiness communities (e.g., NAVSUP, MAJCOMS - ACC, AFMC, AMC).

    • Understanding of government contracting and procurement vehicles.

    • Experience with MEDDIC/MEDPIC, Challenger, or other solution-selling methodologies.

    • Active security clearance or the ability to obtain one.

    • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

You will be required to obtain and maintain an interim and/or final security clearance. Failure to obtain and maintain the required level of clearance may result in the withdrawal of a job offer or removal.

Compensation

We offer:

  • Competitive base salary based on experience

  • Lucrative Commission Plan (50/50 sales plan)

  • 100% employer paid health benefit premiums (medical, dental, vision)

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off

  • Paid Time Off for National Holidays

  • Stock options at sign-on

  • 401k plan

  • Company equipment (Mac/PC and iPhone)

  • Remote work from home

About Us

Virtualitics, the Mission AI Company, is focused on readiness applications primarily for defense and national security. We are a rapidly growing small business built on a decade of Caltech research in partnership with NASA/JPL. We transform mission readiness and operational efficiencies at speed and scale by reshaping how to approach complex data environments. Our AI solutions provide essential insights that address critical national security capability gaps within operational readiness: Maintenance, Materiel, Supply Chain, Personnel, Data Modernization and Deep Threat Analysis.

As a Solutions Consultant, you’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor during the sales process, working closely with the sales team and prospects to do discovery, deliver compelling product demonstrations, address technical questions, and provide expert insights into how Seeq’s platform can solve real-world problems in the oil & gas industry. This is an exciting opportunity for a technical professional who enjoys engaging with customers and is eager to make a measurable impact on a rapidly growing SaaS company.

Requirements

The essential functions include, but not limited to the following:

· Deliver tailored product demonstrations and presentations that clearly communicate the value of Seeq’s solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences.

· Partner with account executives to understand prospective customers’ business needs and challenges and align Seeq’s capabilities to their customers’ goals.

· Provide technical guidance during all phases of the sales cycle, including discovery, solution design, and proof-of-value engagements.

· Assist cross-functional teams in developing industry-specific value propositions or solution accelerators using Seeq.

· Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (e.g., engineering, computer science, data science). Preference for candidates with experience in process manufacturing industries, though strong candidates from adjacent domains are also encouraged to apply.

· 2-4 years of experience in an oil and gas technical role or selling B2B to the oil and gas industry (upstream, midstream, downstream).

· Experience conducting software demos and technical consultations with prospective customers.

· Familiarity with sales processes and CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) is a plus.

· Excellent problem-solving, interpersonal, and collaboration skills.

· Self-starter with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

raw.excerpt: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster.
raw.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

This position is open to candidates with existing work authorization in the location where the position is advertised.


Background:

The International Rescue Committee's (IRC) External Relations (ER) department enables the IRC to respond to the world’s worst humanitarian crises and helps people to survive and rebuild their lives. Within ER, the Philanthropy team leads on the organization’s work with High-Net-Worth Individuals and planned giving donors.

Job Overview:

The Officer, Planned Giving, will work with donors and prospects in an assigned geography across the Southern U.S. to support an increased number of legacy gift commitments and a growing and engaged legacy society. They will support the securing and sustaining of planned gifts by working directly with prospects and donors and Philanthropy colleagues to help ensure a healthy financial future for our humanitarian work. This may entail following up on new leads; soliciting donors for planned gifts; building positive relationships to steward legacy donors; carrying out cultivation, solicitation and stewardship strategies, set with the Senior Director, to connect with and inspire planned giving donors and prospects; supporting colleagues on collaborations; and reporting results of efforts.

The Officer will be expected to understand the needs of older donors and prospects, communicate and connect superbly with colleagues and supporters, use knowledge of various gift planning instruments to assist colleagues and donors, continue to learn about IRC programs, and maintain accurate donor records to support the IRC’s donor relationships and prospecting with high wealth individuals and families.

Additionally, the Officer will be expected to work directly with other development officers, ER colleagues, and local area leadership to increase awareness about planned giving, support education opportunities, and support planned giving conversations and asks for appropriate donors across Major and Principal Giving portfolios.

Major Responsibilities:

  • Manage an assigned portfolio of planned gift prospects and donors.
  • Provide timely follow-up to new marketing leads to educate prospects, creating new planned gifts for the IRC.
  • Implement meaningful engagement opportunities for planned giving donors and prospects, in line with the team’s stewardship plan, to deepen their understanding of the mission and the benefits of legacy giving and gifts of complex assets.
  • Execute regional donor trips, with travel plans approved by manager, maximizing geographic clusters of donors and prospects
  • Focus on significant interactions during in person visits, events, and digital and mail communications.
  • Support engagement with the IRC legacy society (Changemakers) to recognize and retain committed donors, including an annual in-person recognition event in NYC and other regional market events.
  • Partner with Major Gifts and Principal Gifts colleagues on planned gift conversations for appropriate prospects within their portfolios, with strategy set by senior staff
  • Contribute to internal education across ER teams and IRC regional office leadership (RAI) on planned giving’s role and process with the organization, using materials developed by the team
  • Successfully meet individual goals for significant interactions, prospect conversions, lead identification, and outright giving, in alignment with overall team goals.
  • Review donor file data (Salesforce) to flag prospects and bring portfolio balance recommendations to manager
  • Timely and accurately input opportunity data into Salesforce to drive pipeline activity, report on progress towards goals, and find areas of improvement.
  • Promote and practice inclusive behavior and demonstrate a willingness to learn about the IRC’s commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion.

Job Requirements:

Work Experience:

  • 3-5 years of experience working with individual donors, preferably in major gifts, annual giving, or planned giving.

Demonstrated Skills and Competencies:

  • Knowledge of or familiarity with planned giving vehicles and benefits preferred;
  • Ability to communicate effectively with older donors about the IRC’s mission and planning tools;
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines, in consultation with manager;
  • Effective collaboration with colleagues at all levels across the organization;
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office; experience with CRM databases such as Salesforce or Raiser’s Edge preferred;
  • Outstanding attention to detail and commitment to timeframes;
  • Commitment to respect and maintain confidentiality of donor information;
  • Work successfully in a sophisticated, fast-paced organization.
  • Driver’s license and ability to travel up to 25% of the time, including overnight travel, is required.

Working Environment: This role is remote and ability to travel to see donors and prospects required. Applicants must have a home or alternate workspace they can effectively complete their work from during regularly scheduled hours.


Compensation: (Pay Rate: $77,600-$93,000/yr). Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements.

Professional Standards: All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

raw.title: Senior Technical Support Engineer
raw.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, technical support plays an important role in helping customers operate their businesses with confidence. We value strong technical judgment, clear communication, thoughtful troubleshooting, and people who take ownership of difficult problems through resolution.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Technical Support Engineer to investigate and resolve complex technical issues affecting customers using Bask Health's software platform.

This role is responsible for advanced troubleshooting, technical escalations, issue investigation, and helping improve the reliability of the customer support experience.

You'll work with customer success managers, customer success engineers, product managers, software engineers, and other internal stakeholders to resolve technical problems efficiently and accurately.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch and operate direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform supports merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business-critical capabilities.

You'll develop a detailed understanding of how these systems interact and how technical issues can affect customer operations.

You'll serve as an escalation point for complex customer-reported problems that require deeper technical investigation.

You'll troubleshoot application behavior, configuration issues, integrations, and unexpected platform errors.

You'll investigate issues affecting storefront functionality, questionnaire behavior, checkout flows, and supported platform workflows.

You'll use available technical tools, logs, browser debugging capabilities, and internal documentation to gather evidence and identify likely causes.

You'll reproduce reported issues whenever possible and document the conditions under which they occur.

You'll distinguish between user configuration errors, integration problems, product defects, and broader platform incidents.

You'll work closely with software engineers when an issue requires code-level investigation, infrastructure expertise, or a product fix.

You'll provide engineering teams with clear reproduction steps, technical evidence, customer impact details, and relevant troubleshooting history.

You'll coordinate with product managers when reported issues involve product behavior, functionality gaps, or unclear requirements.

You'll communicate technical findings and resolution updates to customer-facing teams and, when appropriate, directly to customers.

You'll help ensure that customers receive accurate information about known issues, workarounds, and next steps.

You'll take ownership of assigned technical escalations and maintain clear accountability until they are resolved or appropriately transferred.

You'll prioritize issues based on severity, customer impact, business disruption, and established internal escalation procedures.

You'll participate in incident investigations involving customer-facing platform functionality.

You'll help document incident timelines, observed symptoms, customer impact, and resolution steps.

You'll support follow-up reviews to identify recurring issues and opportunities to prevent similar problems.

You'll help build and maintain technical troubleshooting guides, internal knowledge base articles, and escalation procedures.

You'll identify gaps in existing support documentation and recommend clearer, more effective troubleshooting workflows.

You'll assist with improving how technical issues are categorized, investigated, and routed to the appropriate teams.

You'll collaborate with customer success engineers on integration-related issues that require deeper investigation.

You'll work with customer success managers to understand the business impact of technical problems affecting important accounts.

You'll help support customers through technical changes, configuration updates, and issue resolution when appropriate.

You'll also help validate that customer-reported problems have been addressed after engineering releases a fix.

You'll monitor patterns in support tickets and technical escalations to identify recurring product problems.

You'll share technical findings with product and engineering teams to help inform reliability and usability improvements.

Because Bask Health operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll need to handle customer information carefully and follow applicable internal security and privacy requirements.

You'll recognize when an issue involves clinical, pharmacy, compliance, or patient-related decisions that must be handled by the appropriate authorized team.

You'll avoid making clinical or pharmacy decisions while providing technical support for the software workflows involved.

As a senior team member, you'll help establish effective troubleshooting practices and may provide technical guidance to less-experienced support engineers.

You'll be expected to work independently on complex investigations while knowing when to involve engineering or other specialists.

This is a senior individual-contributor role focused on technical support execution and problem resolution, not formal people management.

We're looking for someone with substantial experience supporting SaaS applications, strong debugging skills, and the ability to communicate clearly under pressure.

You should be comfortable investigating ambiguous technical issues, organizing evidence, and working across teams to drive resolution.

Experience supporting e-commerce platforms, payment workflows, or other transaction-heavy software environments is particularly valuable.

Success in this role means resolving difficult technical issues, improving escalation quality, reducing recurring support problems, and helping customers operate reliably on Bask Health.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as a senior escalation point for complex customer-facing technical issues.
  • Investigate advanced software application and platform problems.
  • Troubleshoot merchant storefronts, questionnaires, checkout flows, and supported workflows.
  • Diagnose configuration errors, integration failures, and unexpected application behavior.
  • Reproduce customer-reported bugs and document technical findings.
  • Use browser developer tools, logs, and available diagnostic systems.
  • Investigate REST API, webhook, and authentication-related problems.
  • Analyze HTTP requests, responses, and relevant error messages.
  • Distinguish product defects from configuration and integration issues.
  • Prioritize technical issues according to customer impact and severity.
  • Own assigned escalations and coordinate them through resolution.
  • Work with engineering teams on issues requiring code-level investigation.
  • Provide detailed reproduction steps and technical evidence to engineers.
  • Collaborate with product managers on product behavior and functionality concerns.
  • Coordinate with customer success teams on high-impact account issues.
  • Communicate technical updates and recommended next steps clearly.
  • Identify and document supported workarounds when appropriate.
  • Help validate customer-facing fixes following engineering releases.
  • Participate in investigations of customer-impacting platform incidents.
  • Document incident symptoms, timelines, and resolution information.
  • Identify recurring technical issues and recommend preventive improvements.
  • Create and maintain internal technical troubleshooting documentation.
  • Improve technical escalation procedures and support workflows.
  • Help develop consistent issue categorization and triage practices.
  • Review technical support trends and recurring customer complaints.
  • Support internal training on troubleshooting tools and procedures.
  • Provide technical guidance to junior support engineers when needed.
  • Maintain accurate support ticket records and investigation notes.
  • Follow security and privacy procedures during technical investigations.
  • Escalate clinical, pharmacy, or compliance concerns to authorized stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with engineering on platform reliability improvements.
  • Take ownership of complex technical problems and follow through on commitments.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in technical support engineering, application support, production support, or a closely related technical role.
  • Strong experience supporting customer-facing SaaS applications.
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and resolve complex software issues.
  • Experience troubleshooting web applications and browser-based platforms.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP methods, status codes, and common integration patterns.
  • Familiarity with JSON, webhooks, and API authentication.
  • Experience using browser developer tools for technical investigation.
  • Ability to analyze logs, error messages, and application behavior.
  • Experience reproducing software defects and documenting reproduction steps.
  • Ability to distinguish configuration problems from application defects.
  • Experience working directly with software engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with technical ticketing and escalation management systems.
  • Experience prioritizing issues based on severity and customer impact.
  • Strong technical documentation skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly.
  • Experience coordinating investigations across multiple internal teams.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills.
  • Ability to manage several technical investigations simultaneously.
  • Understanding of software incident management and escalation procedures.
  • Familiarity with application security and appropriate data-handling practices.
  • Ability to work independently on ambiguous technical problems.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to maintain clear and accurate technical records.
  • Comfortable collaborating with customer success and product teams.
  • Comfortable working in a remote, cross-functional environment.
  • Availability to collaborate during required U.S. Eastern Time working hours.
  • Ability to take ownership of technical escalations through resolution.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting e-commerce SaaS or merchant-facing software.
  • Familiarity with Shopify, BigCommerce, or other online storefront platforms.
  • Experience troubleshooting payment and checkout workflows.
  • Familiarity with Stripe or similar payment processing integrations.
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Experience using Postman or similar API testing tools.
  • Familiarity with SQL and database query fundamentals.
  • Experience with application monitoring or observability platforms.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Datadog, Sentry, New Relic, or similar systems.
  • Understanding of cloud infrastructure and hosted SaaS environments.
  • Experience supporting webhooks and asynchronous processing systems.
  • Familiarity with OAuth, access tokens, and authentication flows.
  • Experience supporting transaction-heavy applications.
  • Experience participating in incident response and post-incident reviews.
  • Familiarity with software release processes and regression testing.
  • Experience building technical support knowledge bases.
  • Experience improving escalation workflows and support processes.
  • Experience mentoring junior technical support professionals.
  • Familiarity with healthcare technology or telehealth platforms.
  • Understanding of HIPAA-related technical considerations.

LexisNexis Reed Tech brings clarity to innovation for businesses worldwide. We are proud to directly support and serve these innovators in their endeavors to better humankind. For more information, please visit 


About the Role
The Sr Program Manager position conducts stakeholder negotiations that span across portfolios by driving and managing numerous large, complex projects. In addition, this position will project-manage cross-functional teams by working closely with all aspects of the product development community: Market Vertical, Product Manager, Engineering, Testing, Legal, and more.



Requirements:

  • Advanced understanding of resource allocation.
    • Experience coordinating team work flow in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
    • Experience partnering with other project stakeholders to resolve issues and to mitigate project impacts.
    • A results-oriented outlook with the ability to prioritize and deliver key initiatives.
    • Exemplary communication skills (written, presentation, meeting management, and documentation).

    • Ability to partner with other project stakeholders to resolve issues and to mitigate project impacts.
    • Experience delivering on projects of various size and duration.
    • Highly adaptable to changing needs within the organization — adapts to rapidly changing priorities.
    • Experience collaborating with others in IT management roles to deliver shared results.
    • Strong professionalism and strong interpersonal skills required.
    • Detail-oriented and the ability to handle multiple concurrent projects and priorities.
    • Strong organization/project planning, time management, and change management skills across multiple functional groups and departments, and strong delegation skills involving prioritizing and reprioritizing projects and managing projects of various size and complexity.
    • Advanced problem-solving experience involving leading teams in identifying, researching, and coordinating the resources necessary to effectively troubleshoot/diagnose complex project issues; prior success extracting/translating findings into alternatives/solutions; and identifying risks/impacts and schedule adjustments to facilitate management decision-making.
    • Advanced communication (verbal and written) and customer service skills. Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills applicable to a wide audience including senior and executive management, customers, etc., including diction/terminology and presenting information in a concise and effective manner to clients, management, and various departments using assorted communication mediums.



    Responsibilities:
    • Depending on scope and complexity, manage up to four highly complex projects and some moderate to simple complexity projects a year.
    • Request demand and review resource allocation for project, program, and/or portfolio.
    • Participate in communicating impacts regarding capacity and demand.
    • Identify and make recommendations for improvement to existing processes and procedures.
    • Manage all phases of the project through the Product Development process.
    • Define key performance parameters and create regular variance reports to track progress.
    • Negotiate with Engineering Resource Managers for project resources.
    • Maintain compliance with corporate and public regulations.
    • Perform data analysis relevant to project tasks.
    • Request resource demand and review resource allocation for projects.
    • Maintain ownership of and accountability for the project schedule.
    • Effectively communicate project status — including schedule variances and mitigation options.
    • Identify and make recommendations for improvement to existing processes and procedures.

    Work in a Way that Works for You
    We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long‑term goals.

Working Pattern
Working flexible hours – flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision‑making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. raw.title: Officer, Planned Giving - South
raw.excerpt: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster.
raw.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

This position is open to candidates with existing work authorization in the location where the position is advertised.


Background:

The International Rescue Committee's (IRC) External Relations (ER) department enables the IRC to respond to the world’s worst humanitarian crises and helps people to survive and rebuild their lives. Within ER, the Philanthropy team leads on the organization’s work with High-Net-Worth Individuals and planned giving donors.

Job Overview:

The Officer, Planned Giving, will work with donors and prospects in an assigned geography across the Southern U.S. to support an increased number of legacy gift commitments and a growing and engaged legacy society. They will support the securing and sustaining of planned gifts by working directly with prospects and donors and Philanthropy colleagues to help ensure a healthy financial future for our humanitarian work. This may entail following up on new leads; soliciting donors for planned gifts; building positive relationships to steward legacy donors; carrying out cultivation, solicitation and stewardship strategies, set with the Senior Director, to connect with and inspire planned giving donors and prospects; supporting colleagues on collaborations; and reporting results of efforts.

The Officer will be expected to understand the needs of older donors and prospects, communicate and connect superbly with colleagues and supporters, use knowledge of various gift planning instruments to assist colleagues and donors, continue to learn about IRC programs, and maintain accurate donor records to support the IRC’s donor relationships and prospecting with high wealth individuals and families.

Additionally, the Officer will be expected to work directly with other development officers, ER colleagues, and local area leadership to increase awareness about planned giving, support education opportunities, and support planned giving conversations and asks for appropriate donors across Major and Principal Giving portfolios.

Major Responsibilities:

  • Manage an assigned portfolio of planned gift prospects and donors.
  • Provide timely follow-up to new marketing leads to educate prospects, creating new planned gifts for the IRC.
  • Implement meaningful engagement opportunities for planned giving donors and prospects, in line with the team’s stewardship plan, to deepen their understanding of the mission and the benefits of legacy giving and gifts of complex assets.
  • Execute regional donor trips, with travel plans approved by manager, maximizing geographic clusters of donors and prospects
  • Focus on significant interactions during in person visits, events, and digital and mail communications.
  • Support engagement with the IRC legacy society (Changemakers) to recognize and retain committed donors, including an annual in-person recognition event in NYC and other regional market events.
  • Partner with Major Gifts and Principal Gifts colleagues on planned gift conversations for appropriate prospects within their portfolios, with strategy set by senior staff
  • Contribute to internal education across ER teams and IRC regional office leadership (RAI) on planned giving’s role and process with the organization, using materials developed by the team
  • Successfully meet individual goals for significant interactions, prospect conversions, lead identification, and outright giving, in alignment with overall team goals.
  • Review donor file data (Salesforce) to flag prospects and bring portfolio balance recommendations to manager
  • Timely and accurately input opportunity data into Salesforce to drive pipeline activity, report on progress towards goals, and find areas of improvement.
  • Promote and practice inclusive behavior and demonstrate a willingness to learn about the IRC’s commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion.

Job Requirements:

Work Experience:

  • 3-5 years of experience working with individual donors, preferably in major gifts, annual giving, or planned giving.

Demonstrated Skills and Competencies:

  • Knowledge of or familiarity with planned giving vehicles and benefits preferred;
  • Ability to communicate effectively with older donors about the IRC’s mission and planning tools;
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines, in consultation with manager;
  • Effective collaboration with colleagues at all levels across the organization;
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office; experience with CRM databases such as Salesforce or Raiser’s Edge preferred;
  • Outstanding attention to detail and commitment to timeframes;
  • Commitment to respect and maintain confidentiality of donor information;
  • Work successfully in a sophisticated, fast-paced organization.
  • Driver’s license and ability to travel up to 25% of the time, including overnight travel, is required.

Working Environment: This role is remote and ability to travel to see donors and prospects required. Applicants must have a home or alternate workspace they can effectively complete their work from during regularly scheduled hours.


Compensation: (Pay Rate: $77,600-$93,000/yr). Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements.

Professional Standards: All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.


Cookies:


Benefits: IRC offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package. Highlights include 10 paid sick leave, 10 U.S. holidays, 20-25 generous paid time off based on role and tenure, medical insurance starting at $163/month, dental starting at $6.50/month, and vision starting at $5/month, flexible spending accounts (healthcare, dependent care, and commuter), a 403(b) retirement savings plan with employer match (immediate vesting) along with a non-elective employer contribution based on age and years of service (3-year vesting), disability and life insurance, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering confidential counseling and support services for employees and their families.


Equal Opportunity Employer: IRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. IRC considers all applicants on the basis of merit without regard to race, sex, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

AI Systems Engineer (Claude-First)

Remote · Türkiye · Paid in USD

Optimum7 is a performance-driven B2B eCommerce growth agency. We engineer outcomes for industrial B2B and SaaS brands that want to scale smarter and faster through custom development and creative marketing strategies.

Build the AI systems that replace manual work.

At Optimum7, AI is how we build. It isn’t a side experiment. More and more of our client work now runs on agents, automations and LLM-powered systems.

We’re hiring an engineer who already works this way. You’ll take a manual process, design the system that replaces it, and ship it in days.

What you’ll build

  • AI agents and workflows that take over real operational work, from data enrichment and content pipelines to internal tools and client-facing features.
  • LLM-powered product features using Claude and OpenAI that run in production for real B2B clients.
  • The backend behind them: APIs (REST and GraphQL), integrations with eCommerce and SaaS platforms, and data layers on PostgreSQL, MySQL and Redis.
  • Production-grade infrastructure: Docker, CI/CD, caching, monitoring, and security done right (OAuth 2.0, JWT, OWASP).
  • The next version of how we work. You’ll help shape our architecture and AI tooling decisions, not just follow them.

How we work

  • Prototypes in hours, features in days, systems in weeks. We mean it, and AI is what makes it possible.
  • Claude Code is our main development interface. You’ll work alongside people who think the same way.
  • Low process, high ownership. You own a problem from idea to production, with no ticket relay and no months-long roadmaps.
  • Zero drama. We’re a team that’s direct, collaborative and focused on results.

You’re a fit if you

  • Use Claude Code (or a similar tool) every day for coding, debugging and system design. You’d find it hard to imagine working without it.
  • Have shipped at least one AI-driven system, agent or automation that people actually use.
  • Have solid backend fundamentals: APIs, databases, cloud and containers.
  • Think in systems. When you see a repetitive task, you start thinking about how to automate it.
  • Care more about shipping and outcomes than about process.

***Bonus: experience with eCommerce platforms (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento), MCP servers, multi-agent orchestration, or evals for LLM systems.

What you get

  • 100% remote, working with a global team
  • Competitive salary paid in USD: [add range, e.g., $X–$Y/month]
  • Full access to a top AI tool stack: Claude, ChatGPT and [others], on us
  • Real ownership and visible impact. What you build ships to clients.
  • Room to grow in a company that’s expanding fast: [mention growth path, e.g., toward lead/architect roles]

How to apply

Skip the cover letter and show us what you’ve built:

  1. GitHub or code samples
  2. One or two AI systems, agents or automations you’ve built. Tell us the problem, what you built, the tools you used, and the result.
  3. Optional but valued: a 5-minute Loom of your AI development workflow. This is often what makes us reach out.

If AI is already at the center of how you build, we’d like to hear from you.

raw.description:
Why TrueAccord?

TrueAccord, a wholly owned subsidiary of TrueML, is a category-defining company. We combine machine learning with a human-based approach to transform debt resolution and to get people on the path towards financial health. Every year, more than 70 million Americans have negative experiences dealing with debt. We are changing this by providing personalized digital experiences that guide lenders and consumers through this challenging financial process.

With a world-class leadership team, passionate team members, and proprietary predictive models trained on years worth of transactional data, TrueAccord is well-positioned to deliver on a huge opportunity: helping millions of consumers to regain and keep their financial footing while lowering the cost of doing business for creditors across many industries.

About This Role:

Join our Implementation team as a Sr. Implementation Specialist, a high-impact, execution-focused role built for a driven coordinator looking to launch a career in Technical Project Management. You will play a dual role: independently leading end-to-end onboarding for our smaller, standardized clients while providing essential organizational support for our largest Enterprise launches. Your ultimate goal is to ensure seamless, accurate client launches and keep complex implementation workflows moving smoothly on schedule.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead Growth Client Launches: Independently manage the end-to-end onboarding for small-scale "Growth CSV" clients, executing fast, accurate, and repeatable short-term workflows.
  • Support Enterprise Implementations: Partner closely with Senior Implementation Managers as their primary support lead, handling the organizational and logistical heavy lifting for complex, large-scale client launches.
  • Own Documentation & Governance: Serve as the team's lead Document Manager by creating and maintaining RAIDS logs, project folders, and central document repositories.
  • Drive Project Momentum & Visibility: Own daily and weekly task lists, escalate potential timeline risks early, orchestrate meetings with clear agendas, and distribute weekly status updates and action items.
  • Facilitate Cross-Functional Alignment: Coordinate syncs and track deliverables across internal teams with sharp attention to detail, enabling senior leaders to stay focused on high-level strategy.

Who You Are:

  • Aspiring Technical Project Manager: Early-to-mid-career coordinator with foundational analytical skills who thrives in structured, repeatable workflows and is eager to grow into complex project management.
  • Detail-Oriented & Tactical: Highly organized and reliable when executing clearly defined project tasks on tight timelines (days to weeks).
  • Strong Communicator & Collaborator: Comfortable leading meetings, writing clear status updates, and aligning stakeholders across internal teams.
  • Coachable & Process-Minded: Works well within established processes and proactively seeks guidance when encountering complex edge cases outside of standard playbooks.
  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. (No formal certifications like a PMP or regulatory background required; exposure to technical environments is a bonus!)

What We Offer (Perks & Benefits)

  • Flexible vacation

  • Medical/dental/vision insurance

  • Traditional/Roth retirement savings options

  • Company-paid disability and life insurance

  • Flexible Spending Account & Limited FSA

  • Family-friendly parental leave, volunteer and voting time off

  • On-demand wellness platform access for you and 5 friends and family

  • PerkSpot discount program for 900+ merchants nationwide

Recruiting Fraud Notice:

We’re aware of fraudulent recruiters posing as TrueAccord or TrueML and contacting job seekers. To protect yourself, here’s how our real hiring process works:

  1. Official channels only. Our recruiters email only from @trueaccord.com [If you’ve received an InMail, you should verify the recruiter’s @ email]
  2. No payments or financial info during hiring. We will never ask you to pay fees, buy equipment, or share banking information during the hiring process.
  3. No text or chat-app interviews. We do not conduct interviews by text message or messaging apps.
  4. No “portals” or access keys. We do not send PDF portals or access keys, or ask for passwords or login credentials.
  5. No resume services. We will never require an “ATS-friendly” resume rewrite or recommend paid resume services.

If someone contacting you on our behalf does any of the above, it is fraud.

Stay safe:

  • Don’t open attachments, click links, or share personal information.
  • Report the message as phishing to your email provider, and report fake profiles to LinkedIn.
  • Not sure? Verify by emailing before responding.

If you’ve already shared information with suspected scammers: Contact your bank, visit identitytheft.gov, and report the fraud at reportfraud.ftc.gov or ic3.gov.

Remote Work, Travel Expectations, & Physical Requirements

This role supports a global, cross-functional business and operates primarily in a Remote-First environment. However, flexibility outside of standard business hours and occasional local or international travel may be necessary for global operations support, company meetings, training, offsites, and collaborative projects.

This position primarily involves computer-based work, requiring extended periods at a computer, participation in virtual meetings, and use of standard office technology. We will consider reasonable accommodations to enable individuals to perform the essential functions of the role.

Maintaining a reliable internet connection and a professional work environment is expected. The ability to protect confidential company, employee, customer, and business information while working outside of a company office is also required.

Personally Identifying Information

We collect personal information for employment purposes. We do not sell personal information. Most of the information we have is provided to us by you and/or collected as part of the employment process. For more details on how we use, share, and delete personal information see our Privacy Policy.

Dedication to Diversity & Inclusion

We are an equal opportunity employer. We promote, value, and thrive with a diverse and inclusive team. Different perspectives contribute to better solutions and this makes us stronger every day. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or other protected characteristics.

Position Overview

Power your future with Qualus in our Engineering department as a Principal Civil Structural Engineer. In this role, the candidate will design and detail mat and pier type foundations for substation structures. Additionally, the candidate will design substation structures ranging from simple equipment supports to overhead line towers. All work will be performed with emphasis on quality and project costs following client’s requirements and internal company’s quality control and quality assurance practices.

The candidate may also complete substation designs, as necessary. Work will include applying applicable codes and client standards to design general arrangements, equipment and electrical layouts, elevation views, grading and fence plans, foundation plan and details, substation rigid bus arrangements, structure details, and bills of material.

This position may be based in Lake Mary, FL; Palm Beach Gardens, FL; Las Vegas, NV, Boise, ID; Raleigh, NC; or Fort Worth, TX offices or remotely in the US or Canada.

Responsibilities

  • Develop overall conceptual design plans in the initial development phase of new projects.
  • Work with renewable energy developers and other clients with support specific to schedules and cost estimates.
  • Design foundations using commercially available software such as LPILE.
  • Develop steel structure models for rigid bus and equipment supports.
  • Perform company’s Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) processes.
  • Establish and maintain professional relationships with our external business partners; Present information and respond to questions from individual or groups of clients.
  • Direct and/or participate in client meetings/job site visits to collect or deliver design and engineering data.
  • Mentor less experienced staff on a wide range of technical and project management skills.
  • Coordinate with other engineering disciplines.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelors of Science or Masters in Civil Engineering from an ABET accredited institution.
  • 15+ years of experience performing civil structural engineering calculations.
  • Proficient with drafting programs such as AutoCAD and MicroStation a plus.
  • Active Professional Engineering (PE) license
  • Experience in transmission, distribution and generating stations is a plus.
  • Must have strong analytical and computer skills. Must be able to identify necessary software to complete needed design work.
  • Experience leading and mentoring a team

Benefits & Compensation

Qualus offers a competitive benefits package for eligible employees, which may include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage, Retirement Savings Plans (including employer matching where applicable), Flexible Spending and/or Health Spending Accounts, Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), Parental Leave, Paid Time Off, and Company Holidays. Benefits offerings may vary based on position, work location, and eligibility requirements. The compensation range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable laws and market practices. The final base salary offered may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, internal equity, performance, and business needs. Compensation ranges are subject to change at the Company's discretion and as permitted by applicable law.

Company Overview

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. The firm has over 2,000 professionals, with offices throughout the U.S. and Canada.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We are committed to providing an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on any grounds protected by applicable human rights legislation across Canada and the US.

We are committed to a secure and transparent hiring process. We do not request payment or sensitive personal information, such as Social Security numbers or banking details, during the application process. Please use caution and verify opportunities through our official channels.

POS-33677

Application Deadline: Monday, November 23rd at 9am ET

Please note: Due to close working relationships with teams in Ireland and the UK, we are only considering candidates who are located in the Eastern time zone (US).

Role Summary

Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better. On the Operations Web Team, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring the systems behind HubSpot’s digital experiences are reliable, scalable, and built to grow with our customers. This is a highly visible team responsible for delivering innovative web platforms and applications that power HubSpot’s global brand and are experienced by millions every day.

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you’ll design and operate the infrastructure that supports high-traffic, data-intensive marketing platforms and systems. You'll also work across our Cloudflare edge platform, including opportunities to lead experiments and initiatives in areas like web personalization as they develop. You’ll partner closely with developers and stakeholders to improve delivery velocity while upholding strong standards for security, performance, and operational excellence. Together, we’re on a mission to build the best web experience in the world, and the reliability of our platforms is foundational to that goal.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and reliable cloud infrastructure for high-traffic, business-critical applications, improving it through automation and observability.
  • Operate and improve our Cloudflare edge platform (CDN, caching, WAF, DNS), and contribute to edge experiments and initiatives - such as traffic routing, staged rollouts, and personalization - as those efforts grow.
  • Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews, ensuring learnings are translated into systemic improvements.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, and establish and evolve infrastructure-as-code standards for consistency, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Use AI-assisted tooling in day-to-day DevOps work and help the team adopt what proves valuable for reliability, delivery velocity, and cost efficiency.
  • Own medium-to-large infrastructure initiatives from design through production, including documentation, runbooks and long-term support.
  • Contribute to sprint planning, backlog refinement, and roadmap planning, helping prioritize infrastructure investments that improve reliability, scalability, and developer velocity.
  • Evaluate technical trade-offs and clearly communicate risks, impact, and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders across Web Development, QA, and Product.
  • Support the growth of less-experienced engineers through informal mentoring, code review, and sharing best practices in DevOps and cloud architecture.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, or infrastructure-focused software engineering roles.
  • Significant experience operating production systems in at least one major public cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Practical experience with infrastructure as code, configuration management, and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Hands-on experience operating Cloudflare in production - CDN and caching, WAF, and DNS.
  • Solid understanding of Linux systems, networking, and distributed systems.
  • Experience with containers and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience operating large-scale, customer-facing, highly distributed systems in production.
  • Strong troubleshooting, prioritization, and communication skills - able to drive complex issues to resolution, manage competing work with minimal oversight, and explain technical concepts clearly.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience designing, running, or measuring controlled changes at the edge (traffic splitting, staged rollouts, A/B testing, or personalization), including production experience with edge compute such as Cloudflare Workers, KV, or R2.
  • Familiarity with web technologies such as TypeScript, JavaScript, and Node.js.
  • Exposure to observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry.
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted engineering or operations tools to improve productivity or system reliability.
  • A collaborative approach to mentoring or supporting other engineers.

Where You’ll Work

  • Location: United States (East Coast)
  • Work location preference eligibility: Remote
  • Travel/Shift: None

Application Requirements

  • Applications must be submitted by: Monday, November 23rd at 9am ET
  • Applications must be submitted in: English
  • Cover letters: Optional

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are tailored to your skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see. Learn more about HubSpot’s compensation philosophy.

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

Annual Cash Compensation Range:
$108,300—$162,500 USD

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Backend Engineer, New Grad to join Bask Health's engineering team and help build the software infrastructure behind our telehealth platform.

This role is designed for recent graduates and early-career engineers who have strong programming fundamentals, enjoy building software, and want to gain hands-on experience developing production backend systems.

You'll work on APIs, databases, backend services, and application logic that support patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and merchant tools.

Our engineering stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, SST, and SQL databases, with technologies such as Prisma and Drizzle used across the platform.

You'll collaborate with experienced engineers, receive feedback through code reviews, and gradually take ownership of more complex features as your technical skills develop.

We're looking for someone who is curious, takes initiative, learns quickly, and enjoys understanding how software works beyond the code they're assigned to write.

You don't need years of professional experience or previous healthcare industry experience. We care about your technical foundation, the projects you've built, your ability to solve problems, and your willingness to learn.

What You'll Do

  • Build, test, and maintain backend features that support Bask's telehealth platform.
  • Develop APIs, application logic, and backend services using TypeScript and Node.js.
  • Work with SQL databases to create, update, and retrieve application data.
  • Help implement backend functionality for patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and merchant tools.
  • Learn how our serverless infrastructure works using AWS, SST, and related technologies.
  • Assist with building and maintaining integrations between internal services and third-party APIs.
  • Write clean, readable, maintainable code that follows established engineering practices.
  • Create automated tests to verify functionality and help prevent regressions.
  • Debug application issues, investigate errors, and work with experienced engineers to resolve problems.
  • Participate in code reviews and learn how to give and receive constructive technical feedback.
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers to understand how APIs connect to user-facing applications.
  • Work with product managers and engineers to understand requirements and break projects into manageable tasks.
  • Learn how to design database schemas, structure backend services, and organize application logic.
  • Help maintain documentation for APIs, backend features, and development workflows.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to explore solutions, understand unfamiliar code, and accelerate development while validating generated code.
  • Learn how to test changes in staging environments before releasing them to production.
  • Assist with monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting backend services.
  • Contribute to improving existing code, reducing technical debt, and simplifying development workflows.
  • Take ownership of smaller features and gradually work toward independently delivering more complex projects.
  • Ask questions, share ideas, and actively participate in technical discussions.
  • Develop an understanding of security, data privacy, and reliability requirements for healthcare applications.
  • Continue building your technical skills through hands-on projects, feedback, and collaboration with the engineering team.

Requirements

  • Recently completed or currently completing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong understanding of programming fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and basic software design principles.
  • Familiarity with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another modern programming language, with an interest in developing backend applications using TypeScript and Node.js.
  • Experience building software through coursework, internships, personal projects, open-source contributions, or professional work.
  • Basic understanding of how APIs, servers, and web applications communicate.

raw.description:
Company Overview

By Light Professional IT Services LLC readies warfighters and federal agencies with technology and systems engineered to connect, protect, and prepare individuals and teams for whatever comes next. Headquartered in McLean, VA, By Light supports defense, civilian, and commercial IT customers worldwide.

Position Overview

By Light is seeking an experienced Senior Solutions Architect to serve as the lead architect for RangeOS, our cyber range and training platform supporting Department of Defense cyberspace operations.

The architect is the strategic and technical bridge between business goals, user needs, and engineering execution. This individual owns the overall structure, components, and integration of RangeOS so the platform remains feasible, scalable, secure, and aligned with product and business objectives.

This is a technically grounded leadership role. The architect leads a team of engineers, works directly with product management, DevSecOps, and engineering leads, and guides architectural decisions from initial design through deployment and sustainment. Customer relationship ownership resides with program leadership; the architect supports those engagements as the senior technical authority on the platform.

Responsibilities

Product Architecture & Technical Framework

  • Define and own the RangeOS technical architecture, including system components, interactions, data flows, and core technologies.
  • Ensure the architecture meets both functional and non-functional requirements, including scalability, reliability, performance, and security.
  • Make forward-looking design decisions so the platform can grow, handle increasing load, and remain maintainable over its lifecycle.
  • Design backend services, microservices, RESTful APIs, and distributed application architectures.
  • Provide technical direction across the full stack, including frontend frameworks, backend services, databases, and system integrations.
  • Evaluate existing components and lead modernization of legacy capabilities into containerized, cloud-native architectures.
  • Technology Selection & Roadmap
  • Select and evaluate tools, frameworks, languages, and platforms based on performance, cost, scalability, security, and team expertise.
  • Build and maintain the RangeOS technical roadmap in partnership with product management, aligned with the product roadmap.
  • Maintain architecture documentation, standards, and decision records so the platform is clear and maintainable as it evolves.
  • Translate business and user requirements into technical specifications, and translate technical constraints back into product terms.

Cloud-Native Architecture & DevSecOps

  • Architect containerized applications using Kubernetes, Docker, and related orchestration technologies.
  • Design solutions for cloud, hybrid cloud, and on-premises deployment environments.
  • Partner with DevSecOps engineers on secure, automated build, test, integration, and deployment pipelines.
  • Guide the use of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, and automated deployment.
  • Incorporate security, observability, fault tolerance, and performance into the architecture from the start.

Risk & Technical Debt Management

  • Identify architectural risks early and drive mitigation before they affect delivery.
  • Track and prioritize technical debt, balancing new capability against long-term maintainability.
  • Lead design reviews and resolve complex integration challenges across teams.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of developers, engineers, and DevOps including hiring input, performance feedback, and career growth.
  • Establish architecture standards, design patterns, and development best practices across the engineering organization.
  • Facilitate technical discussions and engineering decisions across product, engineering, and DevSecOps teams.
  • Serve as the senior technical authority on RangeOS to internal leadership and in support of program-led customer engagements.

RangeOS Technology Environment

RangeOS is deployed across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. The architect will design for and integrate with technologies including:

  • Infrastructure: AWS Cloud, including AWS GovCloud, and Dell server and storage hardware for on-premises deployments
  • Virtualization: VMware vSphere, Proxmox VE, LXD, and KVM/QEMU
  • Containers and orchestration: Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm
  • Network emulation: Open vSwitch and virtual routers and firewalls such as VyOS and pfSense
  • Identity and access: Keycloak, SAML and OpenID Connect single sign-on, LDAP and Active Directory, and CAC/PKI authentication
  • Infrastructure as Code and automation: Terraform, Ansible, and Packer
  • CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD and container registries such as Harbor
  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, and the Elastic Stack
  • Security and compliance: DISA STIGs, the Risk Management Framework (RMF), and HashiCorp Vault for secrets management

Required Experience/Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience in application, solutions, or product architecture.
  • DoD 8140 compliant certification at IAM Level II, or ability to obtain within 6 months of hire.
  • Strong hands-on background in backend development with a comprehensive understanding of full-stack application architecture.
  • Experience designing and building enterprise applications using Java, Python, C#, .NET, Spring Boot, or comparable technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting microservices, RESTful APIs, distributed systems, and complex integrations.
  • Strong experience with Kubernetes, Docker, container orchestration, and cloud-native deployment.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, automated testing, and secure software delivery.
  • Working knowledge of modern frontend frameworks such as React or Angular and their integration with backend services.
  • Experience with relational databases, data modeling, application performance, and data integration.
  • Understanding of AWS, Azure, or comparable cloud platforms and hybrid infrastructure.
  • Experience owning a technical roadmap and architecture documentation for a product or platform.
  • Experience leading or supervising engineers.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments alongside product management.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and technical leadership skills.

Preferred Experience/Qualifications

  • Experience with cyber ranges, cyber training platforms, or distributed training environments.
  • Familiarity with offensive and defensive cyberspace operations and associated mission software.
  • Experience architecting software within DoD or Intelligence Community environments.
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, OpenShift, Helm, or Terraform.
  • Understanding of virtualized infrastructure, network emulation, and enterprise systems integration.
  • Hands-on experience with VMware, Proxmox, or LXD virtualization, and with identity platforms such as Keycloak.
  • Prior experience as a Product Architect, Principal Engineer, Chief Engineer, or Technical Director.

Special Requirements/Security Clearance

  • Active TS/SCI security clearance
  • Up to 10% travel
