raw.description:
Working in the Office of the Chief Medical Officer and reporting to the VP of Point of Care & Risk Stratification, the Senior Director of Strategy & Operations, Point of Care, will lead day-to-day operations, partnerships, go-to-market efforts, and wraparound support services to maximize the impact of Aledade’s value-based care insights to our partner practices.

The team is looking for a high-output generalist with a strong business analyst toolkit, looking to rapidly take ownership of complex content with high visibility, working across multiple stakeholders. Candidates that thrive managing multiple deadlines on tight timelines and learning content quickly are best positioned to succeed; successful team members in the same function primarily have backgrounds in consulting and generalist healthcare strategy & operations roles.

To start, the role will focus on 1) scaling the deployment of our point of care tools and 2) broadening and deepening the insights available in our point of care tools, to maximize the impact of Aledade’s insights on our patients’ health outcomes and partner practices’ success in their value-based care contracts.

At the end of their first year, a successful leader in the role will own end-to-end accountability for 1) proactive identification, development, and execution of Point of Care deployment improvement opportunities, including field, practice, and clinician education, deployment automation and monitoring, and go to market approach and materials, 2) strategic relationship building and partnership with Aledade’s payer partners to advance point of care tool adoption and impact, 3) goal setting, metric identification and development, and impact evaluation for our point of care tools, 4) identification, evaluation, contracting, and cross-functional execution of net new vendor and external partnerships that support insight delivery and impact.

Additionally, this role will 1) provide direction and expert guidance to junior team members owning individual initiatives, including incentive and adoption programs, educational efforts, hotspotting, monitoring, and alerting development, practice and user-level prioritization and triage, and 2) coordinate with cross-functional product, analytics, technology, performance, care programs, and other senior leaders across Aledade to advance point of care tool adoption and impact.

The role is expected to start as a senior individual contributor, but is expected to grow into a people manager in the near term.

Primary Duties:

    In collaboration with cross-functional product, analytics, technology, performance, care programs, and other senior leaders across Aledade:

    1. Own single-threaded accountability for proactive identification, development, and execution of Point of Care deployment improvement opportunities, including field, practice, and clinician education, deployment automation and monitoring, and go to market approach and materials

    2. Lead strategic relationship building and partnership with Aledade’s payer partners to advance point of care tool adoption and impact

    3. Drive goal setting, metric identification and development, and impact evaluation for our point of care tools

    4. In support of maximizing insight delivery and impact, lead the evaluation, contracting, and cross-functional execution of net new vendor and external partnerships

    5. Direct and support other Transformation team members’ ideation and execution of strategic initiatives related to point of care deployment and impact

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in Economics, Business, Healthcare, or a related field

  • 12+ years of progressive professional experience, or 7+ years progressive professional experience with a Master’s Degree, strongly preferred

  • 6+ years of experience in healthcare

  • 2+ years of experience in value-based care

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced exploration of emerging AI tools, with additional preference given to individuals that have demonstrated ability building, scaling, and/or teaching AI tooling to broader teams

  • Expert Excel skills required, including the ability to work with large, complex, & often incomplete data sets; conduct one-off complex analyses quickly; and utilize Index / Match, XLOOKUP, FILTER, and other advanced formulas

  • Advanced PPT skills required, including storyboarding skills, ability to translate complex analyses and concepts into engaging slides, and ability to draft executive-level materials with limited direction

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, as well as the ability to build strong relationships and work with individuals at all levels of the organization, tailoring communication style as appropriate based on audience

  • Excellent project management skills, including proven track record leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in health care operations settings

  • Strong strategic planning and analytical skills

  • Strong “business analyst” toolkit, including abilities to independently prioritize, solve problems via hypothesis-driven analytical methods, manage across multiple responsibilities and projects, execute with attention to detail, and overcome ambiguity

  • Poise, confidence, and maturity interacting with key stakeholders, including senior leaders

  • Commitment to confidentiality and discretion in appropriately handling sensitive information is required

Physical Requirements:

    Sitting for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboard. Occasional walking and lifting may be required.

Who We Are:

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

What Does This Mean for You?

At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.
In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:
Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles
Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners
Robust time-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)
Two paid volunteer days and 11 paid holidays
12 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents
Six weeks paid sabbatical after six years of service
Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program
401(k) with up to 4% match
Stock options
And much more!
At Aledade PBC, we don’t just accept differences, we celebrate them! We strive to attract, develop and retain highly qualified individuals representing the diverse communities where we live and work. Aledade is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Employment policies and decisions at Aledade are based on merit, qualifications, performance and business needs. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth or medical conditions related to pregnancy or childbirth), gender identity or expression, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or sexual orientation.

We are looking for a Data Engineer with 2–5 years of experience to design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines and analytics-ready datasets. The ideal candidate will have strong SQL and Python or PySpark skills, hands-on experience with cloud data platforms, and the ability to troubleshoot data-quality, performance, and production issues independently.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL and ELT pipelines for batch and scheduled data processing.
  • Build and optimize data transformations using SQL, Python, and PySpark.
  • Ingest and integrate data from databases, APIs, files, SharePoint, and cloud storage.
  • Create and maintain curated, analytics-ready datasets for Power BI, Superset, and other reporting platforms.
  • Implement data-quality checks, reconciliation controls, monitoring, logging, and failure alerts.
  • Troubleshoot pipeline failures, schema mismatches, performance bottlenecks, and data discrepancies.
  • Optimize large-scale data processing for runtime, memory, storage, and cost efficiency.
  • Automate recurring workflows and schedule production jobs using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow.
  • Maintain technical documentation, data mappings, business rules, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate with BI analysts, application teams, and business stakeholders to deliver dependable data solutions.

Requirements

Required Skills and Experience

  • 2–5 years of professional experience in data engineering, ETL development, or a similar role.
  • Strong SQL skills, including joins, common table expressions, window functions, data validation, and query optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with Python and/or PySpark for data processing and automation.
  • Practical experience building and supporting ETL or ELT pipelines in production.
  • Experience working with large datasets, incremental loads, upserts, schema changes, and partitioned data.
  • Good understanding of relational databases, dimensional modeling, data warehousing, and file formats such as Parquet, CSV, and JSON.
  • Experience with Git or another version-control system and structured deployment practices.
  • Strong debugging, analytical, documentation, and stakeholder-communication skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with AWS services such as Amazon S3, Athena, EMR, and EMR Serverless.
  • Experience with Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Apache Airflow, Dremio, or Trino-compatible SQL engines.
  • Familiarity with Power BI, Apache Superset, or other downstream reporting tools.
  • Experience with REST APIs, SharePoint integrations, and automated file-delivery workflows.
  • Understanding of data security, access controls, privacy, and production monitoring practices.

raw.description:
Propeller is on a mission to take the guesswork out of moving dirt - reducing wasted fuel, time, and money. We do this through the power of maps.

Our customers use Propeller's integrated hardware and software products to capture accurate 3D versions of their worksites. With over 50,000 worksites worldwide using Propeller's smart survey technology, we empower project teams to map, measure, and manage site activity.

Propeller empowers everyone to approach, own, and solve problems creatively. We're data nerds who care about impact, honesty, and each other. We take pride in being a great place to work and are proud to be recognized as a Fast Company and BuiltIn Best Place to Work. You can learn more about us on Glassdoor.

About the role

There's a big opportunity for Propeller to reach more customers across the UK and EMEA. We're building a stronger direct route to market as we grow, and you'll play an important part in making that happen.

As a Sales Development Representative, you'll own the first stage of our sales journey. You'll identify businesses that could benefit from Propeller, start meaningful conversations, understand the challenges they're facing and turn those conversations into qualified sales opportunities.

You'll help us open new markets, build relationships with potential customers and create momentum for new customer growth. You'll work closely with the UK sales team and our SDR colleagues in the US, partnering with Account Executives to make sure potential customers have a great experience from their very first interaction with Propeller.

You'll have room to take ownership of your market, develop your sales skills and learn what it takes to build a successful sales career.

What you’re accountable for

Building outbound pipeline. Identify businesses and people who could benefit from Propeller and find creative ways to get their attention. Reach out through calls, email and other channels, experiment with different approaches and build a consistent flow of new conversations and opportunities.

Making the most of inbound interest. Connect with people who have already shown an interest in Propeller. Understand what they're looking for, explore whether we're the right fit and help turn that initial interest into meaningful sales conversations.

Understanding your market. Build a strong understanding of the companies, industries and people we should be speaking to across the UK and other EMEA markets. Research potential customers, develop prospect lists and identify new ways to reach the right people.

Creating great customer conversations. Ask thoughtful questions and listen closely to understand how potential customers work, what challenges they're facing and where Propeller could help. Qualify opportunities and work closely with Account Executives to make sure the next steps are relevant, well-informed and valuable for the customer.

Learning and improving. Get to know our product, customers and sales approach inside out. Pay attention to what's working, share what you're learning and look for ways to improve how we reach and engage potential customers. Take feedback on board and keep developing your approach.

Requirements

  • Based in: United Kingdom
  • Fluent English is essential. Speaking another language fluently is a plus.
  • Some experience in a sales environment where you've worked towards targets or built relationships with potential customers. That could be in recruitment, software, a startup or another sales setting.
  • You're comfortable picking up the phone, making cold calls and starting conversations with people who don't know us yet.
  • You communicate clearly, both in writing and in conversation.
  • You're curious about people and their challenges, and know how to listen before jumping into a pitch.
  • You take ownership, follow through and can keep yourself moving when working independently and remotely.
  • You're interested in technology and enjoy learning how products work and explaining their value in a way that makes sense to customers.
  • You're open to feedback, willing to try new things, learn from them and keep improving.
  • Experience in SaaS or an industry we serve, such as construction, civil engineering or mining, is a plus.

Benefits

  • Remote working + 3 team meetups a year in great European cities
  • Employee share options
  • Professional development benefits and leave
  • Monthly telephone and/or internet allowance
  • WFH equipment provided

About Propeller

Propeller is for everyone, so come as you are. We value all types of experience, skill, and ability. If you don't think you meet all the requirements, but still think this role would be a good fit, we'd love to hear from you.

Diversity makes our team more creative, fun, and effective, so bring your whole self to the application process, and we will too!

If you're interested in what life at Propeller is like, check out our employee-owned Medium blog page!

Resumen del puesto

El Process Analyst Low Code e IA Copilot es responsable de analizar, rediseñar y optimizar procesos de negocio mediante el uso de plataformas Low Code y capacidades de Inteligencia Artificial (Copilots), transformando operaciones manuales o ineficientes en flujos automatizados, escalables y orientados a datos.

Su misión es identificar oportunidades de mejora, automatización y generación de valor mediante la combinación de análisis de procesos, automatización inteligente, analítica y herramientas de IA generativa, trabajando de forma colaborativa con equipos de negocio, tecnología, datos y operaciones para impulsar eficiencia, productividad y toma de decisiones basada en información.

Este rol combina pensamiento analítico, automatización, mejora continua, data-driven mindset y adopción de IA aplicada al negocio.

Responsabilidades principales

Analizar procesos actuales (AS-IS) para identificar ineficiencias, cuellos de botella, riesgos y oportunidades de automatización.

Levantar, documentar y modelar procesos de negocio utilizando BPMN, diagramas de flujo y herramientas colaborativas.

Diseñar procesos optimizados (TO-BE) alineados a objetivos de eficiencia, escalabilidad y experiencia del usuario interno/externo.

Identificar oportunidades de automatización mediante herramientas Low Code / No Code y plataformas de IA Copilot.

Configurar y construir automatizaciones, flujos y aplicaciones Low Code para optimizar procesos operativos y administrativos.

Integrar capacidades de IA generativa y copilots para mejorar productividad, análisis de información y soporte a la toma de decisiones.

Definir métricas, KPIs y dashboards que permitan monitorear el desempeño de procesos y automatizaciones implementadas.

Colaborar con equipos de Business Intelligence y Data para asegurar trazabilidad, calidad y explotación de datos generados por los procesos.

Participar en iniciativas de mejora continua, transformación digital y eficiencia operativa.

Capacitar y acompañar a equipos de negocio en la adopción de automatizaciones y herramientas de IA.

Documentar procesos, automatizaciones, aprendizajes y buenas prácticas de optimización y automatización.

Participar activamente en marcos ágiles y de mejora continua (Scrum, Kanban, Lean), aportando visión analítica y de eficiencia operativa.

Promover la adopción de una cultura data-driven, automatización y uso responsable de IA en la organización.

Requisitos

Experiencia mínima de 3 años en análisis, mejora y optimización de procesos de negocio.

Experiencia trabajando con automatización de procesos, transformación digital o iniciativas de eficiencia operativa.

Conocimientos en modelado de procesos (BPMN, diagramas de flujo, SIPOC, VSM).

Experiencia con herramientas Low Code / No Code (Power Platform, AppSheet, OutSystems, Mendix, Zapier u otras).

Experiencia utilizando herramientas de IA generativa o copilots aplicados al trabajo (automatización, análisis, documentación, productividad).

Capacidad para traducir necesidades de negocio en automatizaciones y soluciones tecnológicas simples y escalables.

Conocimiento en análisis de datos y métricas de procesos (KPIs, dashboards, seguimiento de performance).

Experiencia colaborando con equipos de negocio, tecnología y datos.

Habilidad para documentar procesos, crear guías y generar estandarización operativa.

Deseable experiencia en entornos ágiles, proyectos de automatización o transformación digital.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, pensamiento analítico, resolución de problemas y orientación a resultados.

Mentalidad de mejora continua, curiosidad tecnológica y enfoque en eficiencia y automatización.

raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

Edmentum is a dynamic educator and student-focused company dedicated to tech-enabled learning solutions. Our goal is to ensure that all students have access to flexible learning environments and educators have the tools they need to support their students. We are on a mission to create innovative, proven learning technology, partnering with educators to ignite student potential. We are a Remote First organization with a strong commitment to excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction.

This is a fully remote role supporting districts across the Mid-Atlantic and Northeast. Candidates based in the region are strongly preferred. Travel is seasonal and centers on the moments that matter most to customers: implementation kickoffs, customer meetings and onsite visits, and sales conversations. You’ll also travel occasionally for team meetings and our annual sales kickoff.

What You’ll Do
As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll be the trusted advisor guiding educators and administrators to achieve their goals with Edmentum solutions. You’ll own a multimillion-dollar portfolio of 30-40 district partnerships across the Mid-Atlantic and Northeast. You’ll use product data and implementation strategy to help each district get more from Edmentum, and partner closely with Sales to drive strong renewals and new growth.

In this role you will:

  • Champion customer success from onboarding through renewal, guiding a portfolio of district partners through the full customer journey to ensure seamless adoption and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead implementations that set districts up for success, helping them put Edmentum solutions to work effectively in classrooms.
  • Build deep partnerships with district leaders and educators to promote engagement and awareness, serving as their strategic partner.
  • Lead structured customer meetings at the start of implementation, at midyear, and at the end of the school year, with onsite visits to larger districts.
  • Analyze usage and performance data to uncover insights and craft strategies that maximize student learning impact.
  • Proactively identify customer needs, monitor account health, and flag risks early so they can be addressed before renewal.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to secure renewals and identify growth opportunities, partnering with Sales in weekly account reviews and sharing ownership of account health, risk, and renewal conversations.
  • Advocate for customers by sharing feedback that shapes future products and services, including bringing Product teams into customer conversations.
  • Help deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience across the region, so every district partner receives the same level of support from onboarding through renewal.
  • Build expertise across multiple Edmentum solutions so you can guide districts on the full range of what Edmentum offers.

Who You Are

  • You have a bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of customer success experience, including guiding customers through the full journey from onboarding to renewal.
  • Ideally, you bring customer success experience from a K-12 education technology company, along with a strong understanding of curriculum, instruction, and educational trends.
  • You have experience supporting SaaS or software products, and you’re quick to learn and master multiple solutions.
  • You’re proficient in CRM platforms such as Salesforce and use them to track account health and keep sales partners informed.
  • You lead strategic customer conversations and engage proactively, working directly with customers to uncover needs and identify risks before they become problems.
  • You’re skilled at analyzing data and making strategic recommendations that turn insights into action.
  • You have strong communication skills and can engage effectively at all levels of a district.
  • You’re passionate about improving education and driving positive change.
  • You’re proactive and adaptable, and you thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • You’re a natural collaborator who enjoys partnering closely with Sales, Professional Learning, and Product.
  • You’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment for colleagues and customers.
  • You’re willing to take on evolving responsibilities based on business needs.

Application Deadline: Dec 26, 2026

$80,000—$90,000 USD

Actual compensation will be determined based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, relevant experience and skill sets. All compensation decisions are individualized and based on the specific circumstances of each candidate.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your overall well-being and work-life balance. This includes medical, dental, and vision insurance with various plan options, a 401(k) retirement plan with company matching, and a time away program, volunteer time away, and a winter office closure at the end of December. Additionally, we provide resources to promote wellness, ensuring you have the support you need both professionally and personally. Our goal is to provide a benefits package that helps you thrive in all aspects of life.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, product marketing plays an important role in connecting what we build with the businesses that use it. We value clear communication, a strong understanding of our customers, and the ability to turn complex product capabilities into practical value.

About the Role

We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager, Merchant Platform & Growth to help develop product positioning, execute go-to-market initiatives, and drive awareness and adoption of Bask Health's merchant-facing software capabilities.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

As a Product Marketing Manager, you'll help communicate the value of Bask Health's merchant platform to prospective and existing customers.

You'll work closely with product managers, engineers, sales, customer success, growth marketing, and company leadership to translate product capabilities into clear messaging and customer-facing materials.

This role requires someone who understands B2B SaaS products and can explain how software helps entrepreneurs launch, operate, and grow their businesses.

You'll develop messaging for merchant-facing capabilities, including storefront configuration, product catalogs, subscriptions, checkout experiences, and business management tools.

You'll help customers understand how these capabilities fit together and how they support the day-to-day operation of a telehealth business.

You'll support product positioning and messaging projects, contributing customer insights and competitive research to help strengthen Bask Health's market differentiation.

You'll work with product teams to understand upcoming features and identify the customer problems they solve.

You'll help coordinate product launches, develop launch materials, and ensure internal teams have the information they need to communicate new capabilities.

A major part of this role will involve creating practical product marketing content that makes complex software easier for customers to understand.

You'll develop feature overviews, product presentations, sales enablement resources, customer education materials, and website messaging.

You'll partner with sales teams to understand common customer questions, objections, and competitive comparisons.

You'll use that feedback to improve messaging and create materials that support more effective product conversations.

You'll also work with customer success teams to identify opportunities to improve feature adoption and merchant engagement.

You'll conduct customer research to better understand merchant needs, purchasing motivations, onboarding challenges, and product usage patterns.

You'll help analyze how product messaging and launches influence customer acquisition, activation, and adoption.

You'll collaborate with growth marketing stakeholders on campaigns that introduce relevant platform capabilities to prospective customers.

You'll also monitor competing e-commerce SaaS and merchant enablement platforms to identify useful market insights.

You'll help maintain consistent product messaging across customer-facing channels and internal enablement resources.

We're looking for someone who is organized, curious about software products, comfortable working across teams, and able to take ownership of product marketing deliverables from planning through execution.

What You'll Do

  • Develop positioning and messaging for Bask Health's merchant-facing platform capabilities.
  • Translate software features into clear customer benefits.
  • Create product messaging frameworks and value propositions.
  • Support go-to-market planning for new merchant-facing features.
  • Coordinate product launch activities across internal teams.
  • Partner with product managers to understand feature functionality and customer value.
  • Collaborate with engineers to validate technical product information.
  • Develop messaging for storefront configuration and merchant management tools.
  • Support positioning for product catalogs, subscriptions, and checkout capabilities.
  • Create customer-facing product descriptions and feature overviews.
  • Conduct merchant research to identify needs and adoption challenges.
  • Gather customer insights from sales and customer success teams.
  • Research competing e-commerce SaaS and merchant enablement platforms.
  • Maintain competitive positioning and differentiation materials.
  • Develop sales presentations and product enablement resources.
  • Create messaging that addresses common customer objections.
  • Support website and landing page content for merchant-facing products.
  • Partner with growth marketing teams on product-focused campaigns.
  • Collaborate with customer success teams on feature adoption initiatives.
  • Develop customer education materials for new and existing capabilities.
  • Support onboarding and activation messaging.
  • Identify opportunities to improve merchant understanding of the platform.
  • Track product launch deliverables and coordinate stakeholder reviews.
  • Help define and measure product marketing performance indicators.
  • Analyze customer feedback and feature adoption trends.
  • Maintain accurate and consistent product messaging.
  • Recommend improvements to product communications based on research and performance.
  • Present product marketing updates and recommendations to relevant stakeholders.

Requirements

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in product marketing, preferably within B2B SaaS, e-commerce software, or technology companies.
  • Experience developing product positioning and messaging.
  • Familiarity with go-to-market planning and product launches.
  • Strong understanding of B2B SaaS products and customer journeys.
  • Ability to translate technical software functionality into customer benefits.
  • Experience creating product marketing content and sales enablement materials.
  • Strong written communication and storytelling skills.
  • Experience conducting customer or market research.
  • Ability to identify customer needs and purchasing motivations.
  • Familiarity with competitive research and product differentiation.
  • Experience collaborating with product managers.
  • Ability to work effectively with engineering and technical stakeholders.
  • Experience partnering with sales or customer success teams.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deliverables and deadlines.
  • Experience developing customer-facing product materials.
  • Familiarity with customer acquisition and product adoption concepts.
  • Ability to analyze customer feedback and identify messaging improvements.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate product communication.
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating across teams.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with different stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with product marketing performance metrics.
  • Willingness to learn complex software products and customer workflows.
  • Comfortable working in a rapidly evolving software environment.

Nice to Have

  • Product marketing experience at an e-commerce SaaS company.
  • Familiarity with Shopify or other merchant enablement platforms.
  • Experience marketing software to entrepreneurs or small businesses.
  • Understanding of direct-to-consumer business models.
  • Experience supporting SaaS product launches.
  • Familiarity with merchant dashboards or storefront management tools.
  • Understanding of subscription-based SaaS platforms.
  • Experience marketing checkout, commerce, or billing-related capabilities.
  • Familiarity with product-led growth strategies.
  • Experience supporting customer onboarding and activation initiatives.
  • Understanding of conversion and adoption metrics.
  • Experience creating competitive battlecards or sales objection-handling materials.
  • Familiarity with CRM or marketing automation platforms.
  • Experience developing product demonstrations or tutorials.
  • Understanding of customer segmentation and buyer personas.
  • Experience working with growth marketing teams.
  • Familiarity with white-label software platforms.
  • Experience in telehealth technology or healthcare commerce.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered software products.
  • Experience working in a growing technology company.

Are you passionate about solving complex industrial challenges using cutting-edge data analytics? Seeq is seeking a Solutions Consultant to join our growing team and play a key role in helping prospective customers understand the value of our advanced analytics software.

As a Solutions Consultant, you’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor during the sales process, working closely with the sales team and prospects to do discovery, deliver compelling product demonstrations, address technical questions, and provide expert insights into how Seeq’s platform can solve real-world problems in the mining & metals industry. We have a wonderful, kind-hearted, talented team that loves to collaborate, lead by example, and exceed our customers’ expectations. We are certified as a great place to work, an emerging startup, the Technology Fast 500, and Inc. Magazine's Best Places to Work.

    • Vacation bonus program

Seeq provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics.

title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
description: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

raw.title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
raw.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
raw.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Content Designer, Merchant Platform to help create clear, intuitive, and consistent content across Bask Health's merchant-facing software experiences.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform brings together storefront management, patient questionnaires, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities.

As a Content Designer, Merchant Platform, you'll help business owners and their teams understand how to configure, operate, and manage their telehealth businesses through our software.

This is a hands-on product content role combining UX writing, content design, information architecture, and cross-functional collaboration.

You'll work on the language and information structures merchants encounter while setting up their accounts, configuring storefronts, managing products, navigating dashboards, and completing administrative tasks.

Merchant-facing software often includes complex settings, dependencies, and workflows. Your responsibility will be to make these experiences easier to understand without oversimplifying important functionality.

You'll write interface content such as navigation labels, setup instructions, helper text, tooltips, error messages, empty states, confirmations, and system notifications.

You'll also help organize information so merchants can understand which actions are available, what each setting controls, and how changes may affect their business operations.

A major focus of this position will be merchant onboarding and configuration. You'll help create clear guidance for users who may be launching a telehealth business for the first time, while also supporting experienced operators who need efficient access to advanced tools.

You'll collaborate closely with product designers to develop content alongside interface layouts, interaction patterns, and workflow structures.

You'll work with product managers to understand merchant needs, business requirements, and product functionality.

You'll also partner with engineers to ensure content is implemented accurately, particularly in interfaces involving conditional settings, validation rules, and dynamically generated messages.

You'll collaborate with Customer Success and support teams to identify recurring merchant questions, confusing terminology, and areas where better in-product guidance could reduce unnecessary friction.

Because Bask supports healthcare-related businesses, you'll need to distinguish between merchant configuration responsibilities and clinical or pharmacy processes. You'll work with appropriate stakeholders to ensure specialized terminology and workflow descriptions are accurate.

You'll contribute to consistent terminology and reusable content patterns across the platform, helping merchants develop a clear understanding of Bask's tools as their businesses grow.

You'll use merchant feedback, usability research, and available product data to identify opportunities to improve comprehension, task completion, and the overall experience.

We're looking for someone who enjoys simplifying complex business software, understands how content influences usability, and can help merchants confidently navigate a sophisticated SaaS platform.

What You'll Do

  • Design clear, consistent UX content across Bask Health's merchant-facing software.
  • Write interface copy for merchant onboarding and account setup.
  • Develop instructions for storefront creation and configuration.
  • Create clear guidance for product catalog and product management workflows.
  • Write content for merchant dashboards, settings, and administrative interfaces.
  • Improve the clarity of subscription and commerce management experiences.
  • Develop navigation labels, section headings, and interface terminology.
  • Write helper text, tooltips, and contextual guidance for complex settings.
  • Create actionable error messages and validation instructions.
  • Develop confirmation messages and warnings for important merchant actions.
  • Write empty states that explain available actions and next steps.
  • Help merchants understand dependencies between configuration steps.
  • Improve content for multi-step setup and administrative workflows.
  • Collaborate with product designers on information architecture and content hierarchy.
  • Work with product managers to define merchant content requirements.
  • Partner with engineers to ensure interface language accurately reflects product behavior.
  • Review prototypes and implemented interfaces for clarity and consistency.
  • Support content for configurable questionnaires and related merchant management tools.
  • Help explain workflow settings without making unsupported clinical or operational claims.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success teams to identify recurring merchant questions.
  • Incorporate merchant feedback into content improvements.
  • Partner with UX researchers to evaluate merchant comprehension and task completion.
  • Apply plain-language and accessibility principles to business software interfaces.
  • Develop reusable content patterns for merchant-facing workflows.
  • Maintain consistent terminology across different areas of the platform.
  • Contribute to Bask Health's content guidelines and design system.
  • Document content decisions and implementation requirements.
  • Own assigned merchant content design projects from initial discovery through launch and iteration.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in content design, UX writing, product writing, or a closely related field.
  • Portfolio or work samples demonstrating content design for digital products.
  • Strong writing, editing, and information organization skills.
  • Experience designing content for web applications or SaaS products.
  • Understanding of user-centered content design principles.
  • Ability to simplify complex product functionality into clear, actionable language.
  • Experience writing onboarding instructions, helper text, tooltips, and error messages.
  • Familiarity with administrative interfaces and multi-step workflows.
  • Understanding of information architecture and content hierarchy.
  • Experience developing consistent interface terminology.
  • Ability to explain settings, permissions, and configuration options accurately.
  • Familiarity with plain-language writing principles.
  • Understanding of accessibility and inclusive content practices.
  • Experience collaborating closely with product designers.
  • Ability to work effectively with product managers and engineers.
  • Familiarity with Figma or comparable collaborative design tools.
  • Experience reviewing product interfaces and identifying content usability issues.
  • Familiarity with usability testing and user research.
  • Ability to incorporate customer feedback into content improvements.
  • Experience contributing to content guidelines or design systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to communicate content recommendations clearly.
  • Experience working in cross-functional product development teams.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple assignments.
  • Ability to independently deliver high-quality content design work.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing content for B2B SaaS platforms.
  • Familiarity with merchant-facing software and business management tools.
  • Experience working on e-commerce or direct-to-consumer platforms.
  • Understanding of Shopify or comparable merchant ecosystems.
  • Experience writing content for merchant onboarding and business setup.
  • Familiarity with storefront configuration and product catalog management.
  • Understanding of subscription management and recurring commerce workflows.
  • Experience designing content for dashboards and reporting interfaces.
  • Familiarity with billing, payment settings, and transaction-related workflows.
  • Experience writing for complex administrative tools.
  • Understanding of white-label or multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
  • Background in healthcare technology or telehealth software.
  • Familiarity with healthcare-related operational workflows.
  • Experience collaborating with Customer Success or implementation teams.
  • Experience developing reusable terminology libraries.
  • Familiarity with structured content and localization considerations.
  • Understanding of WCAG accessibility guidelines.
  • Experience using product analytics to identify content improvement opportunities.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted product interfaces and responsible AI messaging.
  • Experience working in fast-moving, cross-functional product teams.

raw.description:
About Onit:

We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions.
We’re a team of innovators using AI at the core to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech.
If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.

Position Summary

The Senior Product Designer is a highly skilled, hands-on contributor who plays a key role in shaping intuitive, user-centered digital experiences across one or more products or initiatives. This role balances strong design craft with thoughtful problem-solving, collaborating closely with product management, engineering, and research to translate complex requirements into elegant, effective solutions. We expect you will bring an interest in AI, both as an integral tool for solving customer problems, but also in your everyday work.

As a Senior Product Designer, you will own significant portions of the product experience end-to-end, from discovery through execution, while contributing to broader design strategy and standards. You’ll bring a user-first mindset, leverage data and research, and help raise design quality through collaboration, critique, and example.

This role is ideal for a designer who excels at execution, enjoys solving complex UX challenges, and is ready to influence product direction without requiring broad organizational ownership.

Facebook Ads Specialist

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for a Facebook Ads Specialist to take ownership of Facebook advertising campaigns from strategy and setup through ongoing optimization. You’ll manage campaign performance, audiences, budgets, testing, and reporting while working closely with the marketing team to improve results.

What You’ll Own

Campaign Planning & Strategy

  • Design and build Facebook ad campaigns from the ground up.
  • Align targeting, creative direction, and budget allocation with business objectives.

Ad Execution & Management

  • Set up, launch, and actively manage Facebook campaigns.
  • Monitor delivery, pacing, and performance on an ongoing basis.

Audience Development

  • Research, build, and refine audience segments.
  • Use custom audiences, lookalikes, and interest-based targeting to improve reach and relevance.

Performance Analysis & Reporting

  • Track key metrics across active campaigns.
  • Analyze campaign data and identify trends.
  • Turn findings into clear recommendations for improving performance.

Creative Collaboration

  • Work with the marketing team to brief, review, and iterate on ad creatives and copy.
  • Ensure assets are optimized for their placement and campaign objective.

Budget Management

  • Manage daily and monthly ad spend responsibly.
  • Adjust bids and budgets to meet efficiency targets without overspending.

Testing & Optimization

  • Run structured A/B tests across audiences, creatives, and landing page combinations.
  • Apply learnings systematically across campaigns.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven hands-on experience planning and running Facebook ad campaigns, ideally in a marketing agency or similarly fast-moving environment.
  • Strong command of Meta Ads Manager, including campaign structure, pixel setup, conversion tracking, and attribution settings.
  • Experience managing ad budgets and being accountable for performance results.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and identify trends.
  • Experience with A/B testing and a disciplined approach to applying campaign learnings.
  • Confident communication skills with the ability to present performance updates and recommendations clearly.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of campaign outcomes from launch through optimization.
  • You’re comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • You communicate proactively and flag issues early.
  • You make decisions based on data rather than assumptions or habits.
  • You’re detail-oriented while keeping the broader campaign strategy in focus.

What Success Looks Like

  • Campaigns are launched with clear targeting, creative direction, and budget strategy.
  • Campaign performance is consistently monitored and optimized.
  • Ad spend is managed responsibly against performance targets.
  • A/B testing generates actionable insights that improve campaign results.
  • The marketing team receives clear, useful performance updates and recommendations.

Typical Day

Your day centers on the Focusmediahouse ad accounts. You’ll start by reviewing overnight performance across live campaigns and identifying opportunities for budget adjustments, creative changes, or targeting improvements.

You may then prepare performance reports, brief a designer on a new creative concept, or build the structure for an upcoming campaign. Testing is an ongoing part of the role, including reviewing active experiments, deciding what to scale or cut, and setting up the next round.

Most collaboration happens asynchronously, so strong written communication and clear documentation are important.

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Final Selection

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a User Researcher, Merchant Experience to help Bask Health better understand the entrepreneurs, business owners, and healthcare organizations that use our platform to operate direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Bask Health brings together merchant storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one software platform.

Merchants use these tools to configure their businesses, manage products, build patient experiences, and coordinate operational workflows. Understanding how merchants approach these tasks is essential to making the platform easier to learn, more efficient, and more useful.

As a User Researcher, Merchant Experience, you'll investigate merchant needs, behaviors, challenges, and expectations throughout their experience with Bask Health.

This is a hands-on research role combining qualitative interviews, usability testing, workflow observation, product discovery, and analysis of merchant feedback.

Your work will focus on the merchant journey, from initial onboarding and storefront setup through ongoing business configuration, product management, subscriptions, reporting, and platform operations.

You'll study how merchants understand the platform, which tasks are difficult to complete, where they need additional guidance, and how their needs evolve as their businesses grow.

You'll also research differences between merchant segments. An entrepreneur launching a first telehealth business may have different expectations and challenges than an established healthcare organization managing a more complex operation.

You'll collaborate closely with product managers, product designers, engineers, and Customer Success teams to identify recurring merchant problems and prioritize research opportunities.

You'll conduct merchant interviews, usability studies, concept evaluations, and workflow research to understand how people use the platform in real situations.

You'll also incorporate available product analytics, support feedback, and operational observations to help teams understand the frequency and impact of research findings.

Your work will help inform merchant onboarding improvements, dashboard design, configuration workflows, product management tools, and other merchant-facing capabilities.

Because Bask supports healthcare-related businesses, you'll need to understand the distinction between merchant business operations and clinical or pharmacy workflows, ensuring research accurately reflects users' responsibilities and permissions.

You'll help maintain organized research findings and communicate actionable recommendations to teams across the company.

We're looking for someone who enjoys understanding how businesses use software, is comfortable investigating complex operational workflows, and can turn merchant feedback into meaningful product improvements.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct user research focused on Bask Health's merchant-facing software experiences.
  • Study how entrepreneurs and healthcare businesses launch and manage their operations through the platform.
  • Research the end-to-end merchant journey, from onboarding through ongoing platform use.
  • Conduct interviews with merchants to understand their goals, behaviors, and challenges.
  • Plan and execute usability studies for merchant dashboards and administrative tools.
  • Evaluate storefront configuration and business setup workflows.
  • Research product catalog management and related merchant configuration experiences.
  • Study how merchants interact with subscription and commerce management tools.
  • Investigate merchant navigation, information architecture, and workflow comprehension.
  • Identify recurring friction points in multi-step configuration processes.
  • Research how merchants interpret platform settings, instructions, and system feedback.
  • Evaluate new merchant-facing product concepts and prototypes.
  • Develop research plans, interview guides, and usability testing materials.
  • Recruit and screen appropriate merchant research participants through approved processes.
  • Study differences in needs across merchant segments and business maturity levels.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success teams to identify recurring merchant challenges.
  • Review support feedback and operational observations to inform research priorities.
  • Partner with product managers to define merchant research questions.
  • Work with product designers to improve merchant-facing interactions.
  • Collaborate with content designers to evaluate merchant terminology and instructions.
  • Incorporate available product analytics into research analysis.
  • Develop merchant journey maps and workflow documentation.
  • Analyze research findings to identify patterns and unmet needs.
  • Present actionable recommendations to product, design, engineering, and leadership teams.
  • Support iterative testing of merchant-facing features throughout development.
  • Evaluate post-launch merchant experiences and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Maintain organized research documentation and reusable findings.
  • Independently manage merchant research initiatives from planning through synthesis and presentation.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in user research, UX research, product research, or a closely related field.
  • Portfolio or case studies demonstrating research for digital products.
  • Experience conducting research involving business software or complex user workflows.
  • Strong understanding of qualitative research methods.
  • Experience conducting user interviews and usability testing.
  • Ability to develop research plans and clear study objectives.
  • Experience creating interview guides and usability testing materials.
  • Familiarity with moderated and unmoderated research methods.
  • Ability to understand complex user journeys and operational processes.
  • Experience identifying user pain points and unmet needs.
  • Strong analytical and qualitative synthesis skills.
  • Ability to translate research findings into actionable product recommendations.
  • Experience collaborating with product managers and product designers.
  • Ability to communicate research findings to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with product discovery and iterative development processes.
  • Experience evaluating web applications and administrative interfaces.
  • Understanding of information architecture and interaction design principles.
  • Familiarity with participant recruitment and screening.
  • Understanding of research ethics and informed consent.
  • Experience incorporating customer feedback into research activities.
  • Familiarity with quantitative data and product analytics.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and research quality.
  • Ability to manage multiple research priorities.
  • Ability to independently deliver research projects in a cross-functional environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience researching B2B SaaS platforms.
  • Familiarity with merchant-facing software and business administration tools.
  • Experience conducting research for e-commerce platforms.
  • Understanding of Shopify or comparable commerce ecosystems.
  • Experience researching merchant onboarding and account setup.

  • Understanding of mixed-methods research approaches.
  • Experience combining qualitative research with product analytics.

  • Experience working in fast-moving, cross-functional product teams.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

About the Role

We're looking for an Applied Scientist, Patient Intelligence to develop machine learning models and data-driven capabilities that help Bask Health better understand patient experiences and improve how our platform supports patients throughout their telehealth journeys.

Bask Health provides the technology behind direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses, connecting patient onboarding, questionnaires, clinical workflows, pharmacy coordination, and ongoing patient experiences. These interactions generate operational and behavioral information that can help us identify friction, improve workflows, and develop more intelligent product experiences.

You'll apply machine learning, statistical modeling, experimentation, and data analysis to identify meaningful patterns and build models that support better product decisions and patient experiences.

This is a hands-on applied science role focused on solving practical problems with data. You'll work with structured datasets, event data, application metrics, and approved patient-related information to develop predictive models, segmentation approaches, and intelligent features.

Your work may include understanding onboarding completion, identifying sources of patient drop-off, predicting workflow abandonment, analyzing engagement patterns, and developing models that help product teams improve the patient journey.

You'll collaborate with product managers, data specialists, machine learning engineers, and software engineers to define problems, design experiments, evaluate models, and translate findings into production-ready capabilities.

You'll be responsible for selecting appropriate modeling approaches, establishing reliable evaluation methods, and communicating the limitations of your findings. You'll help distinguish meaningful patterns from misleading correlations and ensure that model performance is assessed using representative data.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, responsible data use is essential. You'll work within approved privacy and security requirements, carefully evaluate potential bias, and ensure that patient intelligence systems support operational and product improvements without independently making clinical decisions.

This role is ideal for an applied scientist who enjoys combining rigorous analysis with practical product development and wants to see their work improve real software experiences.

  • Develop machine learning models that support patient experience and operational intelligence across Bask Health.
  • Analyze patient journey data to identify friction points, behavioral patterns, and opportunities for product improvement.

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to improve data collection and event instrumentation.
  • Document modeling assumptions, evaluation methodologies, and known limitations.
  • Evaluate models for potential bias, inconsistent performance, and unintended consequences.
  • Ensure appropriate handling of sensitive patient and operational information.
  • Support responsible experimentation and controlled deployment of predictive features.
  • Participate in technical discussions, research reviews, and engineering planning.
  • Stay current with relevant advances in applied machine learning and statistical modeling.
  • Own assigned applied science projects from problem definition through experimentation, evaluation, and implementation support.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in applied machine learning, data science, applied research, or a closely related technical field.

  • Experience developing and evaluating machine learning models using real-world datasets.

  • Experience using Python data science and machine learning libraries.

  • Experience cleaning, transforming, and validating data for analysis and modeling.
  • Understanding of feature engineering and model training workflows.

  • Ability to identify overfitting, data leakage, and other common modeling problems.
  • Experience conducting exploratory data analysis.
  • Understanding of statistical significance, confidence intervals, and experimental uncertainty.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing or controlled experimentation.
  • Ability to translate product or business questions into measurable analytical problems.

  • Familiarity with reproducible research and version-controlled development.

  • Ability to collaborate with software engineers on model integration.

  • Ability to recognize limitations in observational data and model predictions.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building propensity models, churn models, or abandonment prediction systems.

raw.description:
As a Software Engineer on the sBTC team at Stacks Labs, you'll help build sBTC — a 1:1 Bitcoin-backed asset that brings BTC into smart contracts, secured by a decentralized network of signers.

You'll operate autonomously in a fully remote role, collaborating with a talented, globally distributed team to design and implement the protocol, signer software, and tooling that move Bitcoin in and out of the Stacks blockchain. This is a hands-on engineering role with real ownership over some of the most critical, security-sensitive infrastructure in the Stacks ecosystem.

Outcomes You'll Drive

  • A secure, correct peg between Bitcoin and Stacks
    Deposits and withdrawals move real Bitcoin reliably and safely, backed by threshold-signing coordination that holds up under adversarial and edge-case conditions, not just the happy path.
  • Signer software that performs under real-world conditions
    The sBTC signer network stays healthy, observable, and resilient in the presence of faults, network partitions, and delays — because it's securing real Bitcoin, not test funds.
  • Tooling that makes sBTC easier to build on, monitor, and debug
    CLI clients, monitoring utilities, and benchmarking tools give internal teams and external partners clear visibility into signer health and peg operations, reducing the time it takes to diagnose and resolve issues.
  • A codebase built for scale and change
    Strong engineering fundamentals — scalable architecture, disciplined refactoring, thorough testing — mean the sBTC protocol can absorb new features and integrations without accumulating risk.

What You'll Do

Core sBTC Protocol Engineering

  • Contribute to developing, maintaining, and testing the sBTC protocol and its signer software.
  • Design and implement core peg mechanics — deposits and withdrawals — and the threshold-signing coordination that secures the sBTC wallet.
  • Implement rigorous and thorough monitoring and testing to meet the stringent security and performance requirements of a system safeguarding real Bitcoin.
  • Design and implement supporting tools and utilities, such as CLI clients, applications that support moving sBTC on or off the Stacks blockchain, and utilities for monitoring signer health, benchmarking, or debugging.
  • Collaborate with other teams on new product features across the Stacks blockchain, including applications that support moving sBTC on or off the Stacks blockchain and protocol integrations.
  • Work closely with internal teams and external partners, communicating design decisions and trade-offs clearly as sBTC integrates with new products and partner systems.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience building and shipping products.
  • Strong, demonstrated engineering fundamentals, including scalability, architecture, refactoring, algorithms, and testing.
  • Experience building and operating security- or reliability-critical backend systems.
