description: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

raw.title: Google Ads Media Buyer
raw.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
raw.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Administrative Assistant – Patient Support Programs

Job Summary

The Administrative Assistant is a critical operational role within Patient Support Programs (PSPs), responsible for managing high-volume intake, triaging communications, and ensuring the accurate flow of information across the program. Acting as the central coordination point for incoming documentation and requests, this role supports timely patient access and continuity of care.

Working closely with frontline staff, the Administrative Assistant enables efficient, compliant, and well-coordinated program operations. This role requires strong organizational skills, sound judgment, and the ability to prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Intake, Triage & Workflow Coordination

  • Receive, review, and triage high volumes of incoming communications, including emails, faxes, and electronic documentation from patients, healthcare providers, and clinics.
  • Assess incoming materials for completeness and urgency, and route to the appropriate team members for action.
  • Monitor shared inboxes and intake channels to ensure timely processing and follow-up.
  • Track and prioritize outstanding items to support service level expectations and minimize delays in patient access.

Program & Administrative Support

  • Create, maintain, and update patient records, ensuring accurate and timely data entry within CRM systems.
  • Manage document intake, indexing, and filing in accordance with program workflows and compliance requirements.
  • Support day-to-day PSP operations by maintaining organized administrative processes and documentation standards.
  • Assist with reporting, data quality initiatives, and administrative projects as required.

Communication & Coordination

  • Coordinate information flow between external stakeholders (clinics, physicians, patients) and internal PSP team members to ensure timely follow-up.
  • Support outbound communication as needed to clarify documentation or obtain missing information.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and adherence to privacy regulations when handling patient information.
  • Adhere to the highest standards of entering accurate patient information into the CRM.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner closely with PSP team members to ensure seamless coordination of patient support activities.
  • Identify inefficiencies in intake and administrative workflows and recommend improvements.
  • Contribute to SOP updates, training initiatives, and process enhancements based on day-to-day operational insights.

Qualifications

  • Bilingualism (French/English) is an asset
  • Ability to work between the hours of 8AM-8PM EST required.
  • Post-secondary education in Medical Office Administration, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred). New grads welcome!
  • Experience managing high-volume administrative workflows, ideally in a healthcare or PSP environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams) and CRM/database systems.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with high attention to detail.
  • Ability to assess urgency and make sound decisions in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively within a team-based environment.

Please note: The Company does not use artificial intelligence in the screening, assessment, or selection of applicants for this position. This job posting relates to an existing vacancy.

Salary: $50000 - $55000

Strategics Analytics Manager (Marketing Measurement Partner)

Job Details

Role: Strategic Analytics Manager (Marketing Measurement Partner)
Department: Data & Measurement
Job Location: Remote (Canada)

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Role

Joining Thrive’s Data & Measurement department as Strategic Analytics Manager, you’ll own Strategic Analytics / Marketing Measurement workflows that drive growth across our clients marketing programs. You’ll partner with internal media teams and client marketing teams by providing measurement consultation and delivering technical insights that inform business decisions. You’ll be a core part of our lift experimentation program, leading client lift tests from design through execution to final presentation. You’ll also support clients and media teams with broader data and measurement capabilities, including measurement reporting, customer or event-level analysis, or media mix modelling, and help shape the evolution of Thrive’s strategic marketing measurement service.

Your focus will of responsibilities will be:

  • Domain: Own marketing measurement outcomes through strategic and technical lenses, from scoping client objectives, to executing analysis and presenting insights. This will involve designing and executing geo lift tests, building analyses and insights reporting, and consulting client and internal teams on the right measurement approaches.
  • Client: Be the measurement lead across client partnerships, working with paid media teams to turn data into insights and decisions that clients can act on.
  • People: Serve as a strategic translator between data and marketing teams, supporting product feedback loops, identifying gaps, and driving integrated project success. Contribute to Thrive’s knowledge across marketing measurement and strategic analytics by educating non-technical stakeholders.
  • Company: Build Thrive's capacity to lead marketing measurement strategy by refining playbooks, sharing knowledge, and strengthening cross-department roadmaps and systems. Support our Data & Measurement department’s broader service and product evolution to drive stronger marketing analytics insights, tools and strategy across our client roster.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:

  • In your first 30 days you’ll focus on learning Thrive’s systems, building relationships with your team, and understanding our current operating model. You’ll immerse yourself in existing or onboarding client workflows and begin to get acquainted with our in-house measurement solutions across lift experimentation and media mix modelling.
  • In your first 60 days you’ll begin to support Strategic Analytics / Measurement client workflows across geo lift experimentation, custom reporting and analysis, and measurement consultation.
  • In your first 90 days you’ll begin to own Strategic Analytics / Measurement client workflows to advance insights and measurement outcomes. You’ll collaborate with the Data & Measurement team on priority initiatives across measurement service evolution and incoming client partnerships.

Qualifications

  • Marketing Measurement Expertise: You’ve directly supported geo lift experimentation programs through both consultation and execution. You’ve explored the nuances of other measurement approaches, including media attribution and/or media mix modelling, and have a strong understanding of the advertising privacy landscape.
  • Growth Marketing Acumen: You're fluent in marketing metrics and unit economics across ecommerce and/or B2B demand generation (e.g., ROAS, CPA, CPM, CAC, LTV, ROI, brand lift, MQL/SQL) and apply them in your analysis and consulting.
  • Technical Data Rigour: You use data to uncover root causes and challenge assumptions, leveraging SQL, Python, and LLMs to troubleshoot discrepancies and build custom analyses and reporting.
  • Consultative Influence: You have a proven track record of influencing marketing executives, gaining buy-in on complex measurement approaches, and translating data into actionable business decisions.
  • Curiosity & Adaptability: You thrive in fast-moving environments, embrace evolving methods and services, and see change as an opportunity to grow.

---

Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

raw.title: Google Ads Media Buyer
raw.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
raw.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Administrative Assistant – Patient Support Programs

Job Summary

The Administrative Assistant is a critical operational role within Patient Support Programs (PSPs), responsible for managing high-volume intake, triaging communications, and ensuring the accurate flow of information across the program. Acting as the central coordination point for incoming documentation and requests, this role supports timely patient access and continuity of care.

Working closely with frontline staff, the Administrative Assistant enables efficient, compliant, and well-coordinated program operations. This role requires strong organizational skills, sound judgment, and the ability to prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Intake, Triage & Workflow Coordination

  • Receive, review, and triage high volumes of incoming communications, including emails, faxes, and electronic documentation from patients, healthcare providers, and clinics.
  • Assess incoming materials for completeness and urgency, and route to the appropriate team members for action.
  • Monitor shared inboxes and intake channels to ensure timely processing and follow-up.
  • Track and prioritize outstanding items to support service level expectations and minimize delays in patient access.

Program & Administrative Support

  • Create, maintain, and update patient records, ensuring accurate and timely data entry within CRM systems.
  • Manage document intake, indexing, and filing in accordance with program workflows and compliance requirements.
  • Support day-to-day PSP operations by maintaining organized administrative processes and documentation standards.
  • Assist with reporting, data quality initiatives, and administrative projects as required.

Communication & Coordination

  • Coordinate information flow between external stakeholders (clinics, physicians, patients) and internal PSP team members to ensure timely follow-up.
  • Support outbound communication as needed to clarify documentation or obtain missing information.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and adherence to privacy regulations when handling patient information.
  • Adhere to the highest standards of entering accurate patient information into the CRM.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner closely with PSP team members to ensure seamless coordination of patient support activities.
  • Identify inefficiencies in intake and administrative workflows and recommend improvements.
  • Contribute to SOP updates, training initiatives, and process enhancements based on day-to-day operational insights.

Qualifications

  • Bilingualism (French/English) is an asset
  • Ability to work between the hours of 8AM-8PM EST required.
  • Post-secondary education in Medical Office Administration, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred). New grads welcome!
  • Experience managing high-volume administrative workflows, ideally in a healthcare or PSP environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams) and CRM/database systems.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with high attention to detail.
  • Ability to assess urgency and make sound decisions in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively within a team-based environment.

Please note: The Company does not use artificial intelligence in the screening, assessment, or selection of applicants for this position. This job posting relates to an existing vacancy.

Salary: $50000 - $55000

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Role

Joining Thrive’s Data & Measurement department as Strategic Analytics Manager, you’ll own Strategic Analytics / Marketing Measurement workflows that drive growth across our clients marketing programs. You’ll partner with internal media teams and client marketing teams by providing measurement consultation and delivering technical insights that inform business decisions. You’ll be a core part of our lift experimentation program, leading client lift tests from design through execution to final presentation. You’ll also support clients and media teams with broader data and measurement capabilities, including measurement reporting, customer or event-level analysis, or media mix modelling, and help shape the evolution of Thrive’s strategic marketing measurement service.

Your focus will of responsibilities will be:

  • Domain: Own marketing measurement outcomes through strategic and technical lenses, from scoping client objectives, to executing analysis and presenting insights. This will involve designing and executing geo lift tests, building analyses and insights reporting, and consulting client and internal teams on the right measurement approaches.
  • Client: Be the measurement lead across client partnerships, working with paid media teams to turn data into insights and decisions that clients can act on.
  • People: Serve as a strategic translator between data and marketing teams, supporting product feedback loops, identifying gaps, and driving integrated project success. Contribute to Thrive’s knowledge across marketing measurement and strategic analytics by educating non-technical stakeholders.
  • Company: Build Thrive's capacity to lead marketing measurement strategy by refining playbooks, sharing knowledge, and strengthening cross-department roadmaps and systems. Support our Data & Measurement department’s broader service and product evolution to drive stronger marketing analytics insights, tools and strategy across our client roster.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:

  • In your first 30 days you’ll focus on learning Thrive’s systems, building relationships with your team, and understanding our current operating model. You’ll immerse yourself in existing or onboarding client workflows and begin to get acquainted with our in-house measurement solutions across lift experimentation and media mix modelling.
  • In your first 60 days you’ll begin to support Strategic Analytics / Measurement client workflows across geo lift experimentation, custom reporting and analysis, and measurement consultation.
  • In your first 90 days you’ll begin to own Strategic Analytics / Measurement client workflows to advance insights and measurement outcomes. You’ll collaborate with the Data & Measurement team on priority initiatives across measurement service evolution and incoming client partnerships.

Qualifications

  • Marketing Measurement Expertise: You’ve directly supported geo lift experimentation programs through both consultation and execution. You’ve explored the nuances of other measurement approaches, including media attribution and/or media mix modelling, and have a strong understanding of the advertising privacy landscape.
  • Growth Marketing Acumen: You're fluent in marketing metrics and unit economics across ecommerce and/or B2B demand generation (e.g., ROAS, CPA, CPM, CAC, LTV, ROI, brand lift, MQL/SQL) and apply them in your analysis and consulting.
  • Technical Data Rigour: You use data to uncover root causes and challenge assumptions, leveraging SQL, Python, and LLMs to troubleshoot discrepancies and build custom analyses and reporting.
  • Consultative Influence: You have a proven track record of influencing marketing executives, gaining buy-in on complex measurement approaches, and translating data into actionable business decisions.
  • Curiosity & Adaptability: You thrive in fast-moving environments, embrace evolving methods and services, and see change as an opportunity to grow.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

raw.description:
Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv.

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Business Intelligence & Analytics Advisor

What does a great Manager, Business Intelligence & Analytics do?

As a Manager, Business Intelligence & Analytics, you will serve as a dedicated analytical leader supporting one of Fiserv's largest strategic client relationships. You will be responsible for delivering data-driven insights, executive reporting, performance analytics, and business intelligence solutions that help internal and external stakeholders make informed decisions.

You will partner closely with client stakeholders, relationship management, operations, finance, compliance, product, and technology teams to transform complex data into actionable business insights. This role is responsible for establishing reporting standards, governing key business metrics, supporting strategic decision-making, and driving continuous improvement through analytics.

As a trusted advisor, you will provide visibility into program performance, identify emerging trends and opportunities, and ensure the delivery of accurate, timely, and meaningful reporting that supports client satisfaction and business growth.

What you will do:

  • Lead reporting and business intelligence activities supporting strategic client programs.
  • Develop and maintain executive dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and performance management reporting.
  • Deliver weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual business reviews and performance analysis.
  • Partner with client stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and translate business needs into analytical solutions.
  • Analyze operational, financial, compliance, servicing, and transaction data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Establish and maintain metric definitions, reporting governance, and data quality standards.
  • Conduct ad hoc analysis and investigations related to business performance, operational incidents, and emerging issues.
  • Partner with Operations, Finance, Compliance, Product, Technology, and Relationship Management teams to drive data-informed decisions.
  • Present analytical findings and business recommendations to senior leadership and client stakeholders.
  • Support forecasting, business planning, capacity analysis, and performance measurement initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities for reporting automation, process improvement, and enhanced self-service analytics.
  • Document reporting methodologies, business logic, analytical assumptions, and governance processes.
  • Manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced client-focused environment.
  • Influence the development and enhancement of reporting tools, dashboards, and business intelligence capabilities.
  • Support audit, risk, regulatory, and compliance reporting requirements as needed.

Basic Qualifications for Consideration

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, reporting, financial analysis, consulting, or related disciplines.
  • Experience developing executive reporting and performance management dashboards.
  • Advanced SQL skills with the ability to analyze and interpret large datasets.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Experience presenting complex information to business and executive audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional initiatives and stakeholder relationships.

Preferred Qualifications for Consideration

  • Payments, banking, fintech, financial services, or card program experience.
  • Experience supporting large enterprise clients or strategic partnerships.
  • Experience with Snowflake, Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar business intelligence platforms.
  • Experience working with transaction, operational, or financial datasets.
  • Knowledge of KPI development, reporting governance, and data quality practices.
  • Experience with Python or advanced analytical tools.
  • MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • Experience leading or mentoring analysts and business intelligence professionals.

You are the kind of person who:

  • Thrives in a highly collaborative and client-facing environment.
  • Can turn complex business questions into meaningful analytical insights.
  • Possesses strong business acumen and a passion for data-driven decision making.
  • Communicates effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Builds strong relationships and credibility across all levels of the organization.
  • Balances strategic thinking with operational execution.
  • Takes ownership of results and continuously seeks opportunities to improve processes and outcomes.

Salary Range

$78,000.00 - $138,000.00

These pay ranges apply to employees in New Jersey and New York. Pay ranges for employees in other states may differ.

It is unlawful to discriminate against a prospective employee due to the individual's status as a veteran.

For incentive eligible associates, the successful candidate is eligible for an annual incentive opportunity which may be delivered as a mix of cash bonus and equity awards in the Company’s sole discretion.

Thank you for considering employment with Fiserv. Please:

  • Apply using your legal name
  • Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

Our commitment to Equal Opportunity:

Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.

If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation in completing a job application or otherwise participating in the overall hiring process, please contact . Please note our AskHR representatives do not have visibility to your application status. Current associates who require a workplace accommodation should refer to Fiserv’s Disability Accommodation Policy for additional information.

Note to agencies:

Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.

Warning about fake job posts:

Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

raw.description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our team full-time in Brazil.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. You will work for an American partner known for selling and distributing tickets for various events. One of the leading providers of booking and ticketing services in the arts and entertainment industry, operating on a global scale.

Responsibilities:

  • Build production AI agents: develop TypeScript services on AWS (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, Bedrock) using Strands or LangGraph and AI SDKs
  • Design agent behavior: define what the model investigates and what code enforces
  • Sandbox agents: build read-only runtimes, scoped tool access, worktree-contained reads, and budget/timeout guards against model misbehavior
  • Evaluate AI features: build golden sets and production replays, calibrate judges, gate changes on recall, precision and false-positive rate, and compare models and effort levels before release
  • Ensure observability: emit reason-coded metrics and structured logs, alert on failures, and investigate production misses in Splunk and VictoriaMetrics
  • Run infrastructure: maintain Terraform roots across environments under tagging and permission-boundary rules; improve GitLab CI/CD for build, test, deploy and quality gates
  • Build integrations resilient to retries, rate limits, permanent failures and stale state
  • Use AI to write/review code; keep agent context current
  • Review AI-written changes for security, correctness and maintainability, catching issues tests miss
  • Enable teams: configure assistants, skills, hooks and MCP servers; pair with engineers and share proven practices
  • Build agent-facing tools: React and APIs for summaries, dashboards and internal tooling, with outputs readable by agents, CLIs and Slack
  • Document systems with architecture/sequence diagrams, runbooks and decision records

Requirements:

Full Stack & Versatility: Broad technical perspective with an emphasis on adaptability across modern software stacks and architectures, favoring breadth and quick ramp-up over narrow specialization.

  • Frontend &TypeScript: Strong production experience with modern React and TypeScript (including Node.js, async patterns, testing, and monorepo tooling)
  • Backend & Scripting: Working proficiency with Python for backend services, evaluations, analysis, and automation tooling
  • AWS Beyond Serverless: Practical hands-on experience across the AWS ecosystem—extending beyond serverless (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, Bedrock) to broader architectural components such as containers (ECS/EKS), networking, compute, and IAM
  • LLM features in production: Has shipped features leveraging LLM APIs (prompts, tool calling, structured output, long context) and can describe the eval that gated release, what failed, and what changed
  • AI Champion Mindset: Enthusiastic, proactive embrace of AI-assisted engineering tools in daily workflows (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, LLM APIs) combined with the drive to champion AI-first practices and productivity across the team
  • Infrastructure as Code: Able to read and safely modify Terraform configurations across environments
  • Data: Hands-on experience with both NoSQL and SQL stores, including schema changes and live-system migrations
  • Observability: Able to design metrics, logs, and alarms for non-deterministic systems, and effectively debug production issues from them
  • CI/CD: Proficiency with modern CI/CD pipelines, ideally GitLab CI/CD
  • Communication: Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to articulate trade- offs clearly and align team members around technical decisions

Desirable:

  • Multi-agent systems, MCP servers, or evaluation frameworks
  • LLM cost control: model routing, prompt caching, token budgets
  • Prompt-injection defense and agent security
  • GraphQL for internal APIs and tooling
  • Code intelligence or retrieval work (indexing, symbol search, knowledge bundles)
  • Kubernetes, AWS AppSync, and EventBridge
  • Playwright/Cucumber test automation
  • Claude Certified Developer or Claude Certified Architect (Anthropic)

What’s in it for you?

  • Care: your mental and physical health is our priority. We ensure comprehensive company-paid medical insurance and mental health programs, 5 undocumented sick-leave days per year
  • Tailored education path: boost your skills and knowledge with our regular internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy license, language courses and company-paid certifications
  • Growth environment: share your experience and level up your expertise with a community of skilled professionals, locally and globally
  • Long-term employment with 20 working-days paid vacation and local bank holidays
  • Flexibility: 100% remote work mode
  • Opportunities: we value our specialists and always find the best options for them. Our Internal Mobility Program helps change a project if needed to help you grow, excel professionally and fulfill your potential
  • Global impact: work on large-scale projects that redefine industries with international and fast-growing clients
  • Welcoming environment: feel empowered with a friendly team, open-door policy, informal atmosphere within the company and regular team-building events

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

As we expand into Latin America, every Ciklumer is helping to shape our story. Collaborate with seasoned experts and make a global impact backed by two decades of industry leadership.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

raw.description:
The Senior Staff Accountant of Accounts Payable reviews bills for coding accuracy above an established materiality threshold, serves as the final layer of review for PO-backed bills (matching bills to POs so a secondary AP reviewer is not required), and approves vendor profiles added or updated by Staff Accountants, including checking the vendor master file for duplicates. This role also supports inbox management, prepares AP payment runs, supports cash forecasting with Treasury, backs up the Practice Payment function of AP, and helps train and mentor Staff Accountants by reviewing errors and building processes to reduce them going forward. The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, prioritizes quality over speed, thinks independently, and is comfortable using AI tools (such as Claude) to improve processes.
We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office.

Primary Duties:

  • Review bills coded by Staff Accountants for coding accuracy above an established materiality threshold, including proper treatment of prepaid vs. current expenses, amortization schedules, and service periods.
  • Serve as the final layer of review for PO-backed bills, matching bills to POs and catching missing fields the PO did not carry over (e.g., prepaid coding, amortization schedules), so a secondary AP reviewer is not required.
  • Review and approve new or updated vendor payee profiles, checking the vendor master file for duplicates and carefully distinguishing vendors from partner practices before approval.
  • Prepare AP payment runs, support cash forecasting with the Treasury team, and support or resolve vendor statement reconciliations escalated by Staff Accountants.
  • Help manage the P2P inbox, back up the Practice Payment function of AP, mentor Staff Accountants by reviewing errors and building processes to reduce them going forward, and support testing of scenarios during the Tipalti-to-Zip migration.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Able to work core East Coast business hours (company hours are 8:00 AM-5:00 PM Eastern); available no later than 10:00 AM Eastern.
  • 2-3+ years of full-time accounting experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
  • Strong accounting foundation, including solid understanding of prepaid vs. current expenses and amortization schedules.
  • Strong understanding of distinguishing operating expenses (OpEx) from cost of service (COS) expenses.
  • Highly detail-oriented; prioritizes quality and accuracy over speed.
  • Able to think independently while knowing when to escalate; comfortable serving as the final say on coding once familiar with the company's cost centers and chart of accounts.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills; able to manage competing priorities using a due-date-driven approach.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to handle sensitive vendor and practice communications professionally.
  • Willing and able to use AI tools (e.g., Claude) to improve processes and automation.

Preferred knowledge, skills, and/or abilities:

  • Healthcare industry experience is a plus.
  • Comfortable training and supporting more junior team members.
  • Experience administering T&E tools such as Navan or Expensify.
  • Experience in a post-PO AP environment, matching POs to bills.
  • Proficiency with spreadsheets (Excel and/or Google Sheets); comfortable working in a Google-heavy organization.
  • Prior experience training, mentoring, or reviewing the work of others

Physical Requirements:

    Primarily sedentary, remote desk-based work involving extended periods of sitting and computer/keyboard use. No unusual physical demands.

Who We Are:

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

What Does This Mean for You?

At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.
In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:
Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles
Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners
Robust time-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)
Two paid volunteer days and 11 paid holidays
12 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents
Six weeks paid sabbatical after six years of service
Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program
401(k) with up to 4% match
Stock options
And much more!
At Aledade PBC, we don’t just accept differences, we celebrate them! We strive to attract, develop and retain highly qualified individuals representing the diverse communities where we live and work. Aledade is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Employment policies and decisions at Aledade are based on merit, qualifications, performance and business needs. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth or medical conditions related to pregnancy or childbirth), gender identity or expression, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or sexual orientation.

Our employees bring deep expertise in Machine Learning, Data Science, and AI. Our business value and leadership has been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner.

We are looking for top-notch talent as we continue to build the best global analytics consulting team in the world.

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer who thrives at the intersection of client problem-solving and hands-on AI engineering. You'll partner directly with clients and engineering teams to turn complex business challenges into production-grade GenAI and Agentic AI solutions — owning the journey from first conversation to live deployment.

Role :

We are seeking an experienced, client-facing Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) with deep expertise in the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform to partner closely with enterprise clients and Databricks account teams. In this role, you will embed directly into customer environments to architect, build, and deploy high-impact data engineering, analytics, and AI/GenAI solutions—turning complex, ambiguous business problems into production-ready outcomes at speed

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the primary technical bridge between Tiger Analytics delivery teams, client stakeholders, and Databricks field engineering teams to drive adoption and expand platform capabilities.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Applied AI/ML Engineering,
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with deep hands-on mastery of Apache Spark (performance tuning, query optimization, cluster sizing, and memory management).
  • Proven experience implementing Lakehouse architectures, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog (governance, lineage, access control), and Databricks Workflows.
  • Practical experience building and deploying AI/GenAI solutions on Databricks (e.g., Databricks AI/BI Genie, Mosaic AI, Vector Search, LLM integration, or MLflow).
  • Experience migrating enterprise data workloads or modernizing legacy BI/data warehouses onto cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Exceptional communication and consultative skills, with a demonstrated track record of operating effectively in fast-paced, client-facing environments.

The FDE Mindset

  • Strong customer-facing communication and sharp problem-solving instincts.
  • Comfortable operating independently, navigating ambiguity, and moving fast from problem → solution → production.
  • Equally at home with business and technical stakeholders.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Deployment Engineer, Merchant Solutions to help merchants successfully implement, configure, and launch technical solutions using Bask Health's platform.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to operate direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, questionnaires, clinical workflows, pharmacy coordination, and commerce tools.

As merchants launch and expand their businesses, they may need technical assistance connecting systems, configuring workflows, resolving implementation challenges, and ensuring their solutions operate correctly in production.

You'll work at the intersection of engineering, product, and merchant operations to help turn merchant requirements into reliable technical implementations.

This is a hands-on engineering role that combines application development, API integrations, technical troubleshooting, and deployment support. You'll work with backend services, frontend applications, configuration tools, and third-party integrations to help merchants launch and maintain their solutions.

Your work may include implementing merchant-specific configurations, developing integration components, troubleshooting API issues, validating application workflows, and creating reusable tools that make future deployments easier.

You'll collaborate with software engineers, product managers, Customer Success Managers, and merchant-facing teams to understand implementation requirements, identify technical constraints, and resolve problems efficiently.

You'll also help improve Bask's deployment processes by identifying recurring implementation challenges and developing automation, documentation, and reusable engineering solutions.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, merchant deployments must respect appropriate data privacy, access controls, and operational safeguards. You'll ensure that technical implementations follow approved platform capabilities and do not introduce unauthorized clinical or pharmacy functionality.

We're looking for an engineer who enjoys solving practical technical problems, communicates clearly with technical and nontechnical stakeholders, and takes ownership of getting software solutions working reliably for real customers.

What You'll Do

  • Support technical implementation and deployment of Bask Health solutions for merchants.

  • Assist with troubleshooting payment, checkout, and commerce-related integrations.

  • Collaborate with backend engineers to resolve complex platform issues.
  • Communicate implementation status, technical risks, and blockers to relevant stakeholders.
  • Participate in technical discovery and solution planning for merchant requirements.
  • Help improve deployment reliability through testing and standardized procedures.
  • Identify recurring merchant technical problems and recommend product or engineering improvements.

raw.description:
HICX is a leading worldwide provider of enterprise SaaS solutions for digital supplier management. Learn more about HICX. HICX helps Global 5000 companies to organize and manage their supplier data.

The HICX Supplier Management platform enables businesses with thousands of suppliers to efficiently on-board and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of all suppliers, and to find, re-use and maintain supplier data and information across any spreadsheet, app or system. High quality supplier data is essential to digital transformation and the key to becoming customer of choice for all suppliers. Some of the world’s largest companies, in a wide range of industries, trust HICX for the management of their supplier data; these include Unilever, Lenovo, Mars, Mondelez, Baker Hughes and EDF Energy.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled QA Analyst to join our Product QA function to be based in Bucharest, Romania. This team is activated at the end of the development phase, validating new functionality before it moves into the Release QA cycle.

As a QA Analyst, you will perform initial functional testing, end-to-end validation, and API tests for new stories, new product features, and bug fixes delivered by both the Product Engineering and Support Engineering teams.

Your primary focus will be to:

1. Build comprehensive test plans

Test scenarios, expected outcomes, edge cases, functional flows, dependencies, and data requirements.

2. Design and build automated tests from scratch

Functional UI tests, end-to-end journeys, and API-level automation that will be:

  • Executed during your QA cycle
  • Handed over to Release Management to include in full regression test suites

You will sit between Developers and the Release Management team, acting as the quality gatekeeper that ensures only thoroughly validated changes enter the formal release pipeline.

This is a hands-on, technical QA role with significant influence on long-term product quality and test automation maturity.

Requirements

Functional & End-to-End Testing (First QA Phase)

  • Perform initial validation of all stories, enhancements, UI changes, workflow logic, and bug fixes.
  • Execute functional, end-to-end, smoke, and exploratory testing as soon as development work is complete.
  • Validate business rules, data flows, integrations, and expected behaviors across the platform.

Test Planning & Scenario Design

  • Create detailed test plans capturing:
    • Expected outcomes
    • Test scenarios & flows
    • Edge cases
    • Integration points
    • Dependencies & data needs
  • Ensure all requirements and acceptance criteria are covered and testable.

Test Automation

  • Build reusable automated test cases using AI.
  • Create functional, end-to-end, and API automated tests to support your QA cycle.
  • Ensure all new automated tests are clean, maintainable, and aligned with long-term regression strategy.
  • Deliver automated test suites to the Release QA team for inclusion in regression cycles.

Quality Gatekeeping Between Dev & Release

  • Serve as the primary QA checkpoint before changes enter Release QA.
  • Ensure all validated artifacts meet quality, stability, and functional expectations.
  • Collaborate closely with developers to clarify requirements, resolve issues, and retest fixes.

Defect Identification & Root-Cause Support

  • Identify, log, and clearly document defects with reproducible steps and supporting evidence.
  • Collaborate with engineering on root-cause analysis, retesting, and quality sign-off.

Continuous Improvement & Coverage Growth

  • Identify gaps in functional or automation coverage from a “first QA phase” perspective.
  • Recommend improvements to testing methods, automation patterns, and tooling.
  • Contribute to building a scalable QA foundation for future product growth.

Requirements:

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years in a QA Analyst role within a SaaS or PaaS environment.
  • Strong experience performing story-level and feature-level functional testing.
  • Demonstrated ability to create high-quality test plans and comprehensive test scenarios.
  • Hands-on experience building automated test cases from scratch (functional, end-to-end, or API).
  • Experience with test automation tools (Utilising AI Tools)).
  • Solid understanding of QA methodologies, test coverage strategies, and risk-based testing.
  • Strong analytical ability to interpret business requirements and translate them into effective tests.
  • Excellent communication skills (English) and stakeholder collaboration.
  • Comfortable working remotely in a structured, self-managed role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Postman, Swagger, or other API testing tools.

Benefits

Front Row isn't a traditional agency. We're a connected growth engine, combining strategy, creative, media, and Amazon performance to scale beauty, wellness, and consumer brands. Our difference is in what we connect, and the results it drives: faster growth, stronger conversion, and full-funnel efficiency across every platform.

Born from the unification of five commerce-first agencies, Front Row's Amazon Marketplace Growth division operates at the intersection of brand and performance to help emerging and established brands scale strategically on Amazon.

About Front Row Amazon Marketplace Growth

Front Row's Amazon Marketplace Growth division is purpose-built to help brands scale profitably and strategically on Amazon. We support every stage of the Amazon journey, from early-stage channel entry to enterprise-level expansion, through a connected service model that spans 3P Management, 1P Management, and 3P Distribution.

What sets us apart is our ability to match business models to business moments across a brand's Amazon lifecycle. Whether we're helping a brand take control of its presence through 3P Management, streamline vendor operations via 1P, or unlocking new revenue through our owned retail Distribution model, we operate with agility, transparency, and a relentless focus on performance.

Our team blends deep Amazon fluency with category-specific expertise across CPG, offering tailored strategies, full-funnel optimization, and executional excellence.

As part of Front Row's broader connected commerce offering, we bring Amazon into alignment with a brand's DTC, retail, and marketing ecosystem, ensuring that success on-platform fuels momentum off-platform, too.

The Role

For many brands, the biggest limit on marketplace growth sits upstream. It might be a distribution gap, a pricing conflict, weak brand awareness, or a retail plan pulling in another direction. To grow a brand on marketplaces, you have to understand the whole business.

As Enterprise Director, CPG, you'll be the connected commerce partner to Front Row's premier CPG brands. You'll support each brand's omnichannel strategy so what we learn off-channel sharpens what we do on marketplace. You'll lead Front Row's work directly and partner with the brand's other agency and retail partners where Front Row isn't running the work.

This is an analytical strategy role that requires hands-on experience leading enterprise CPG brands. You're as comfortable identifying strengths and weaknesses within a business, reading a marketing mix model, or presenting a strategic guidance plan. You'll lead strategy, own revenue growth across your portfolio, and build a team of omnichannel leaders to better guide holistic CPG growth across a complex retail system.

Your Impact at Front Row

Lead Brand Growth Strategy

  • Shape each brand's annual growth plan, turning revenue, margin, and share targets into a clear strategy and the execution to deliver it.

  • Diagnose what's holding growth back, whether it's brand awareness and demand generation, pricing and promotion, product-market fit, or retail performance, and trace how each constraint affects marketplace results.

  • Balance long-term brand building against near-term demand capture, and show how that balance affects growth, MER, and margin.

  • Define the role of each sales outlet (DTC, marketplaces, specialty and mass retail), and where growth in one lifts or cannibalizes another.

  • Apply category context specific to CPG.

  • Help brands earn visibility in AI-driven discovery through AEO/GEO, with LLM citations a core Front Row focus in the years ahead.

  • Give strategic direction to Front Row's Amazon team, who own day-to-day activation on marketplace.

Guide Decisions with Data and Modeling

  • Set the measurement agenda for each enterprise client in partnership with Front Row Analytics [and our MMM partner], and turn what works across your portfolio into Front Row's standard for enterprise brands.

  • Make MER each brand's headline efficiency measure, and use MMM to explain what drives it: each lever's contribution, saturation point, and marginal return.

  • Measure brand building as rigorously as performance, tracking awareness, consideration, and branded search demand alongside MMM's long-term effects.

  • Combine MMM, lift and geo holdout tests, and attribution into one measurement approach, and model the payoff of different spend levels in P&L terms a CFO recognizes.

  • Bring DTC, marketplace, retail POS, and SPINS or Circana data into a single MER-anchored scoreboard for brand leadership, using Front Row's proprietary tools, including Catapult, to move faster.

Own Portfolio Growth

  • Own your portfolio's revenue and growth targets, and report on both directly to Front Row leadership.

  • Expand each relationship by solving the brand's next growth problem, bringing in Front Row's strategy, creative, content, media, affiliate, and Distribution teams.

  • Build the strategy and measurement case at the center of enterprise CPG pitches, and be a visible voice for Front Row in the category.

Build the Team

  • Lead Front Row's CPG client pods, developing Client Partners and Account Directors into data-fluent strategists whose recommendations are backed by evidence.

  • Bring Front Row's strategy, analytics, creative, content, and media leads together around each brand as one connected team.

Your First Year

First 90 days: Build relationships with leadership at our top CPG partners and with your team. Assess each brand's growth levers, constraints, and measurement maturity, then deliver a growth point of view for your largest accounts with a MER target attached.

By six months: Every enterprise brand in your portfolio has a connected commerce plan tied to a total-business MER target, plus a measurement roadmap built with Front Row Analytics.

By twelve months: You've led at least one MMM-guided budget shift that improved MER and delivered incremental growth, hit your portfolio revenue targets, and expanded Front Row's role with several top partners. Your team is known across Front Row for its strategic and analytical depth.

The Experience We're Looking For

Must-haves

  • 7+ years in growth strategy, marketing strategy, or analytics, much of it leading omnichannel work for enterprise CPG brands.

  • Experience as the strategic leader on enterprise CPG brands, with a clear view of how retail, pricing, brand building, and advertising work together to drive growth.

  • Experience setting real budgets with MER targets, marketing mix models, and lift tests, and knowing which assumptions to question.

  • An analytical mind that finds the insight that matters in messy data and presents it so leadership acts.

  • Ownership of revenue targets for a client portfolio or brand P&L, with a record of growing both.

  • Experience building teams and leading other managers.

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Strong additions

  • Highly preferred: Hands-on AEO/GEO experience, especially earning brand citations and visibility in LLM answers.

  • Experience rebuilding a brand's measurement around MER, MMM, and brand health tracking, and moving leadership away from platform-reported ROAS.

  • Comfort pairing DTC and marketplace results with category share and retail POS data.

  • A brand-side, founder, operator, or strategy consulting chapter in your career.

  • Experience spanning prestige and mass Beauty, or specialty and mass VMS, plus an active presence in the CPG community.

How We'll Know It's Working

  • Portfolio revenue: retention and growth against annual targets, and the breadth of Front Row services each brand uses

  • Brand growth: profitable revenue and share gains across retail, DTC, and marketplaces

  • Evidence-led budgets: MER improvement and MMM-guided budget shifts that delivered incremental revenue, with every enterprise brand running a unified measurement plan

  • Brand strength: growth in awareness, consideration, and branded search demand

  • AI discovery: growth in brand citations and visibility across LLM answers

  • Team strength: stronger strategists on your team, promotions from within, and top performers who stay

Benefits

  • Health, dental, and vision

  • PTO

  • Summer Fridays

  • Wellness and commuter benefits

  • Work with a fun, consultative team of experts

  • Location – Ideally Hybrid in NYC - Open to fully remote

SALARY: $150,000 - $180,000 + Bonus
