raw.excerpt: About UsSuper Organics is a portfolio of fast-growing wellness and supplement brands built on quality, transparency, and a real commitment to the people we serve.
raw.description:
About Us

Super Organics is a portfolio of fast-growing wellness and supplement brands built on quality, transparency, and a real commitment to the people we serve. Our brands range from botanical supplements to creatine blends, and each has its own voice and audience. We move quickly, care about craft, and email is one of our most important channels for reaching customers. We are base in Fort Lauderdale, FL and have been in the supplement business for over 10 years.

The Role

We’re looking for a hands-on Email Marketing Assistant who knows Klaviyo inside and out. You’ll build and run campaigns and flows across several brands, fix technical problems when they come up, and keep our email calendar on schedule. That means writing copy and briefing designers yourself so nothing waits on someone else.

Most importantly, we want someone who wants to grow with us long-term. Our brands are scaling, our team is tight-knit, and we invest in people who invest back.

This isn’t a “push send” role. One day you’ll troubleshoot a broken flow trigger, the next you’ll write a promo email and brief our designer on the creative, and the day after you’ll rebuild a segment that’s been pulling the wrong people.

What You’ll Do

  • Build, launch, and optimize automated flows in Klaviyo: welcome series, abandoned cart and checkout, browse abandonment, post-purchase, replenishment, winback, and sunset flows. Also manage subscription-related flows like failed payments, cancel-winbacks, upcoming billing reminders and more.
  • Set up and schedule campaigns across multiple brands, including segmentation, A/B tests, send-time strategy, and QA before every send
  • Handle technical fixes and troubleshooting: broken triggers, flow filters, conditional splits, dynamic content and template tags, custom properties and metrics, and Shopify and subscription-app integrations
  • Code and edit email templates with HTML/CSS when the drag-and-drop editor isn’t enough
  • Write email copy (subject lines, preview text, and body) that fits each brand’s voice and our compliance guidelines
  • Brief graphic designers on new campaigns and emails: write clear creative briefs, assign tasks, manage turnaround, and review final assets
  • Keep the list healthy and deliverability strong: list hygiene, suppression, engagement-based segmentation, and monitoring inbox placement
  • Report on campaign and flow performance (revenue, conversion, click rate, unsubscribes) and recommend what to test next
  • Work closely with our Retention & Lifecycle Manager to carry out the monthly promo calendar and product launches

Requirements

  • Fluency in English, written and spoken
  • Available during business hours, 8 AM to 5 PM EST
  • 3+ years of hands-on Klaviyo experience, ideally for DTC e-commerce, CPG, or supplement brands
  • Deep technical Klaviyo knowledge: flow logic, conditional splits, segment building, dynamic content and template tags, custom properties, and integration troubleshooting
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for email
  • Experience with Klaviyo and Shopify integrations; experience with subscription apps is a plus
  • Strong copywriting skills, with the ability to write in several brand voices
  • Experience briefing and managing designers or creative contributors
  • Solid understanding of deliverability basics (SPF/DKIM/DMARC, list hygiene, engagement-based sending)
  • Comfortable reading performance data and turning it into next steps
  • Organized and self-directed, able to manage several brands and deadlines at once
  • Nice to have: Klaviyo SMS experience, Klaviyo certification, or experience in a regulated or compliance-heavy product category. Experience in the kratom niche is a plus.

Benefits

  • Full-time, remote role
  • Weekly pay, direct deposit
  • Yearly raise (based on performance)
  • Real ownership: your flows and campaigns go live, get tested, and drive revenue you can point to
  • Variety every week across brands and audiences
  • A collaborative team that values craft and moves fast

At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

​

Job Overview

Are you passionate about environmental protection, sustainability, and continuous improvement? Do you enjoy working across teams to solve environmental and sustainability challenges, develop practical solutions, and drive measurable improvements? This position offers an opportunity to support TE Connectivity's global environmental compliance, sustainability, and remediation programs.

As part of TE Connectivity's Corporate Environmental Sustainability team, you will work with environmental professionals, manufacturing sites, business units, and external partners to support the implementation and continuous improvement of TE's environmental programs.

Reporting to the Environmental Sustainability Manager, you will play an important role in developing environmental standards and training, coordinating environmental compliance initiatives, advancing waste sustainability programs, and supporting the management of environmental remediation projects.

This position offers broad exposure to corporate environmental programs and the opportunity to take ownership of defined projects and initiatives while developing technical expertise and professional capabilities within a global organization.

Job Requirements

  • Support the implementation and continuous improvement of TE's global environmental compliance, sustainability, and remediation programs.
  • Develop and maintain environmental standards, standard operating procedures (SOPs), training materials, and program guidance.
  • Coordinate cross-functional working groups, stakeholder reviews, and implementation of environmental initiatives across business units and manufacturing sites.
  • Analyze environmental compliance, sustainability, and remediation data to monitor performance, identify trends, and recommend improvements.
  • Maintain environmental program tracking tools, management systems, metrics, and reporting, including Benchmark.
  • Support waste sustainability initiatives focused on waste prevention, reduction, reuse, recycling, and progress toward Zero Waste to Landfill objectives.
  • Support environmental remediation program activities, including consultant deliverables, schedules, budgets, documentation, and financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, engineering teams, and external partners to advance environmental projects and resolve operational challenges.
  • Independently manage assigned activities and projects, proactively tracking progress and escalating significant technical, regulatory, or financial issues as appropriate.

What your background should look like

  • Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Geology, Chemistry, or a related technical discipline.
  • Approximately 1-3 years of immediate related professional experience in environmental compliance, environmental remediation, environmental sustainability, or a related field, preferably at a manufacturing facility. Overall years of experience may vary.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. federal and state environmental regulations, preferably with experience in one or more areas such as hazardous waste, air emissions, wastewater, stormwater, or environmental management systems.
  • Ability to research and interpret environmental regulations, permits, and technical requirements and translate information into practical procedures and guidance.
  • Strong technical writing skills, including the ability to prepare procedures, training materials, technical summaries, and reports.
  • Strong analytical and data-management skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other business applications.
  • Demonstrated project coordination and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple assignments, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate with stakeholders across different functions and organizational levels.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and capable of independently executing defined assignments while recognizing when technical or regulatory matters require escalation.
  • Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional environment.

Technical Competencies

  • Environmental Technical Knowledge: Applies environmental regulatory and sustainability knowledge to support effective program implementation and continuous improvement.
  • Project Management: Organizes and advances multiple projects, tracks deliverables, and proactively communicates progress and potential issues.
  • Analytical Thinking: Uses environmental data and technical information to identify trends, evaluate problems, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Communication and Technical Writing: Develops clear, accurate, and practical procedures, training materials, reports, and communications.
  • Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Builds productive working relationships across sites, business units, corporate functions, and external partners.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identifies opportunities to improve processes, reduce administrative burden, strengthen compliance, and advance environmental sustainability.
  • Digital Aptitude: Effectively uses environmental management systems, data tools, and emerging technologies to improve efficiency and decision-making.

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat,Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

BENEFITS

EOE, Including Disability/Vets

raw.description:
All Together, Extraordinary

Aduna is the Connector of networks, bringing together leading telecom operators and technology partners to simplify global access to Network APIs. Through a single, unified platform, we enable businesses and developers to build more secure, seamless and innovative digital services.

We are looking for a Developer Advocate to become Aduna's public-facing voice within the global developer community as part of our Demand Generation team.

As Aduna’s voice in the developer community, you’ll bring network APIs closer to developers and turn awareness into real adoption. You’ll grow and engage developer audiences across AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud and independent communities including GitHub, Stack Overflow, YouTube and Discord, using technical content, events, demos and hands-on engagement to take developers from curiosity to their first successful API call.

What You'll Do

  • Grow an engaged developer audience for network APIs across your own and Aduna's channels: technical videos, livestreams, blog posts, social media and newsletters.
  • Speak at developer conferences, meetups and hackathons, with live coding and live demos on the Aduna sandbox as your signature format.
  • Build and publish sample apps, starter kits and tutorials on GitHub that developers actually use and star.
  • Run community programmes: hackathons, workshops, office hours and developer challenges, in your region and beyond.
  • Feed what developers tell you back to Product and Engineering, and work with our use-case experts to keep content technically accurate.
  • Own and report your numbers: audience growth, content reach and engagement, sandbox sign-ups, time to first API call and active developers.

What You bring:

  • A proven public developer audience. For example, a substantial following on LinkedIn, X, YouTube or GitHub, a blog or newsletter with regular readers, or an active community you run or co-lead. Please include links and numbers in your application.
  • A track record as a speaker at developer conferences or meetups, with recordings we can watch, and confidence doing live demos in front of a technical audience.
  • 4+ years in developer relations, technical evangelism or hands-on engineering with public-facing work.
  • The ability to write and ship working code (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python or Java), not just describe it.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) and REST APIs.
  • A results mindset: you set goals for reach and adoption, measure them and adjust.
  • Plus: experience with CPaaS, telecom APIs, identity, authentication or fraud prevention, and existing ties to developer communities in India or Central and Eastern Europe

Why Join Aduna?

  • Be the public voice of a company shaping the future of programmable connectivity.
  • Build a Developer Advocacy function from the ground up and have a direct impact on strategy.
  • Work at the intersection of telecommunications, cloud platforms, APIs, and developer ecosystems.
  • Collaborate with global technology leaders, hyperscalers, and innovative partners.
  • Gain visibility across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and executive leadership.
  • Help define how developers interact with one of the most exciting new technology categories in the market.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Opportunity to work with a globally distributed team of industry experts.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Professional development and conference participation opportunities.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge technologies and global-scale initiatives.
  • The chance to shape a rapidly growing company and make a visible impact from day one.

How to apply:

Please include links to your public profiles (GitHub, LinkedIn, YouTube or blog) and at least one recording of a talk or live demo. Applications without public references won't be considered. Shortlisted candidates will give a 10-minute live demo in the interview.

Aduna is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds who are passionate about driving the next wave of innovation in telecommunications.

Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives.

Labcorp is seeking a remote Data Manager to join our team!

Work Schedule

Monday – Friday, 8am – 5pm EST

Job Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary data management contact for assigned clinical studies, partnering with clients from study start-up through database lock and study completion.
  • Lead study start-up activities, including review of study requirements, establishment of documentation, and development of data transfer strategies.
  • Collaborate with clients to define, develop, and finalize Data Transfer Specifications (DTS), ensuring accurate and efficient data integration.
  • Provide expert guidance and recommendations to optimize data quality, reporting, and data transfer processes.
  • Serve as a key liaison between Clinical Data Management and cross-functional teams including Project Management, Medical Affairs, Specimen Management, and other operational groups.
  • Design, develop, test, and maintain data transfer formats and processes in accordance with client requirements, internal standards, and regulatory expectations.
  • Oversee the delivery and validation of data transfers, ensuring quality, accuracy, and timely execution.
  • Provide ongoing study support, including troubleshooting data issues, managing change requests, addressing client queries, and implementing study modifications.
  • Coordinate data management activities supporting end-to-end data lock processes and study milestones.
  • Participate in client meetings, audits, inspections, bid defenses, and other customer-facing activities as a Clinical Data Management representative.
  • Support the evaluation and implementation of new client services, process improvements, and operational efficiencies.
  • Maintain complete and audit-ready study documentation, records, and metrics in compliance with applicable procedures and regulatory requirements.
  • Track study portfolios, workload, and productivity metrics to ensure effective delivery across assigned projects.
  • Contribute to a collaborative team environment by sharing expertise, supporting colleagues, and providing backup coverage when needed.
  • Continuously develop technical and industry knowledge through corporate, departmental, and sponsor-specific training programs.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma
  • 2 or more years experience in data management with client facing responsibility

Preferred Qualifications

  • BS/BA four-year degree/equivalent and 2-year equivalent Data Management experience or 2-year Associate degree/equivalent with 4 years Data Management experience and/or Leadership experience

Additional Job Standards

  • Strong organizational, planning and critical-thinking skills.
  • Well-polished, inclusive, and engaging communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Strong negotiation skills to facilitate, guide, influence, and produce a unified approach within a global, cross-functional environment.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks in a timely and professional manner under demanding conditions.
  • Ability to use standard Microsoft suite of software products.
  • Conversant with databases and database terminology.
  • Strong technical aptitude.
  • Customer Service experience.
  • Data Management and/or Clinical Trials experience.

Application Window: November 13, 2026 – November 20, 2026

Pay Range: $65,000 - $72,000

All job offers will be based on a candidate’s skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data.

Administrative Assistant

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for an organized, proactive, and customer-focused Administrative Assistant to support lead intake, customer outreach, appointment scheduling, and CRM management.

This role is highly focused on keeping the lead pipeline organized and moving. You’ll communicate with prospective customers, schedule appointments for the sales representative, maintain accurate CRM records, and help ensure leadership has a clear view of pipeline performance.

What You’ll Own

Lead Intake & Management

  • Receive and accurately log incoming leads.
  • Ensure every new inquiry is captured in the CRM promptly and without gaps.
  • Maintain complete and accurate lead records.

Lead Outreach & Scheduling

  • Call prospective customers to understand and qualify their needs.
  • Answer initial questions and introduce the company professionally.
  • Book appointments for the sales representative to visit customers and present estimates.

CRM Workflow Management

  • Move leads through each stage of the pipeline consistently.
  • Keep lead statuses current and accurate.
  • Maintain CRM data so the team can track set rate, close rate, and other key metrics in real time.

Customer Communication

  • Serve as a professional and knowledgeable first point of contact.
  • Answer customer questions and set appropriate expectations.
  • Represent the company positively on every call.

Reporting Support

  • Keep records clean, organized, and up to date.
  • Support leadership in pulling accurate pipeline data.
  • Help identify where leads are converting or falling off.

Process Adherence

  • Learn and consistently follow the company's established workflow.
  • Identify and flag bottlenecks in the process.
  • Help maintain consistency across daily operations.

Required Experience & Skills

  • At least 1–2 years of experience in an administrative, customer-facing, or operations support role.
  • Familiarity with CRM software and managing contacts, deal stages, and records.
  • Experience in painting, residential or commercial construction, or another home service trade is a strong plus.
  • Clear and confident spoken English.
  • Comfortable communicating with homeowners and prospective customers by phone.
  • Strong organizational habits and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple active leads simultaneously.
  • Ability to learn new workflows quickly and apply them consistently without close supervision.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of your pipeline and proactively follow up when leads go cold.
  • You communicate proactively when something is unclear or a process breaks down.
  • You are comfortable on the phone and can adapt your communication style to different customers.
  • You bring structure to a busy day and can prioritize a full call list effectively.
  • You keep CRM records organized and consistently up to date.
  • You can work independently while staying reachable for important questions and decisions.

What Success Looks Like

  • Every incoming lead is captured accurately and promptly.
  • Prospective customers are contacted and qualified consistently.
  • Appointments are booked efficiently for the sales representative.
  • CRM stages accurately reflect the current status of every lead.
  • Follow-ups happen consistently without leads being overlooked.
  • Leadership has reliable pipeline data for tracking set rates, close rates, and lead conversion.
  • Processes are followed consistently and bottlenecks are identified early.
  • Customers receive a professional and positive experience throughout the initial interaction.

Typical Day

Your day starts by reviewing new leads that came in overnight and making sure each one is properly logged.

You’ll work through a call list, reaching out to prospective customers to introduce the company, answer initial questions, qualify their needs, and schedule appointments for the sales representative.

Throughout the day, you’ll update the CRM as each lead progresses, ensuring stages reflect reality and the pipeline data remains accurate.

You’ll also check on leads that are pending follow-up, re-engage where needed, and keep the schedule organized.

Most of your work is async and self-directed, but you’ll stay reachable for quick questions and proactively flag anything that requires a decision from leadership.

  1. Recruiter Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Final Selection

raw.description:
Salvo Software is a global technology company specializing in custom software development and advanced engineering solutions. With distributed teams across the US, LATAM, and India, we partner with clients to build high-performance, scalable systems that solve complex technical challenges. Our culture values innovation, ownership, and engineering excellence. We’re growing our AI department and are looking for a Senior MLOps Engineer to build the platform that takes our models and LLM systems reliably into production.

Role OverviewWe are looking for a Senior MLOps Engineer to design, build, and own the infrastructure and workflows behind our machine learning and LLM-powered systems. Your core work will be creating a reliable path from experimentation to production: training and fine-tuning pipelines, model registries, automated deployment, scalable inference, and monitoring for models running in cloud, on-prem, and air-gapped environments.

This is a senior, hands-on role. You’ll define MLOps standards and platform architecture, make key decisions on reliability, scalability, and cost, and provide technical guidance to AI Developers and RAG Engineers on the team. You’ll work closely with engineering, product, and client stakeholders to make sure AI features are reproducible, observable, secure, and ready to scale.

Key Responsibilities

MLOps Platform & Engineering (core focus)

  • Design, deploy, and operate MLOps platform infrastructure, cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), and LLM inference pipelines (Ollama, vLLM).
  • Build automated CI/CD pipelines, IaC, and monitoring/alerting systems to support RAG applications, AI agents, and production deployments.
  • Manage Linux servers, networking, security endpoints, and troubleshoot production issues alongside AI engineering teams.

Technical Leadership

  • Establish department-wide MLOps/DevOps standards, best practices, and reusable infrastructure templates.
  • Partner with AI Developers and RAG Engineers to guide architecture, deployment strategies, tool selection, and production readiness.
  • Translate feature requirements into reliable, secure, cost-effective infrastructure and maintain comprehensive system documentation.

Infrastructure & Operations

  • Provision containerized workloads, Linux servers, and infrastructure using IaC (Terraform, Ansible) across cloud and on-prem environments.
  • Manage CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana), secure networking, and GPU-enabled hardware.
  • Troubleshoot platform incidents, perform root cause analysis, and maintain operational resilience.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of senior-level experience in DevOps/SRE/platform engineering with at least 1 year deploying ML models and LLM inference engines (Ollama, vLLM) in production.
  • Proficiency with Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, virtualization (Proxmox, VMware), GPU infrastructure (CUDA/NVIDIA), and major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Hands-on expertise with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible), CI/CD platforms (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), Bash, and Python scripting.
  • Solid background in core networking (DNS, TLS, firewalls, VPNs), monitoring/logging, and security/authentication (OAuth2/OIDC, API gateways, Zero Trust/SOC 2).
  • Familiarity with ML tooling (MLflow, Kubeflow), vector DBs, RAG/agent frameworks (MCP), workflow orchestration (Airflow/Kafka), and model optimization/quantization.

Overview

Due to growth, we are adding a Sr. Director, Product Operations & Governance to our team!

We are seeking a strategic yet hands-on leader with PBM or related healthcare industry experience and a strong background in product operations, process improvement, and organizational transformation.

The Sr. Director, Product Operations & Governance will play a critical role in transforming how products are developed, approved, launched, and managed across the enterprise. This highly operational leadership position is responsible for building, implementing, and sustaining a scalable product governance framework that brings structure, accountability, and consistency to the end-to-end product lifecycle while enabling innovation and business growth.

The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, excels at building processes and frameworks from the ground up, and has the ability to lead both the initial transformation and long-term operational execution. Experience applying Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, or similar continuous improvement methodologies will be valuable in driving sustainable change.

Success in this role requires exceptional relationship-building, change management, and influencing skills. Working across Navitus and its affiliated business lines, including Archimedes, Clarventa, and Lumicera, this leader will partner with Product, Operations, Technology, Compliance, Finance, and Commercial stakeholders to establish effective governance, align priorities, and drive accountability across functions without direct reporting authority.

This is an opportunity for a builder and change leader who can navigate complexity, challenge existing practices, and create the operational foundation needed to support disciplined product decisions, regulatory compliance, and measurable business outcomes.

Is this you? Find out more below!

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

  • Define, implement, and continuously improve the enterprise product governance model, including roles, responsibilities, decision rights, approval thresholds, escalation paths, and governance forums.
  • Own lifecycle governance across ideation, intake, business case development, design, build, launch, distribution, monitoring, optimization, and retirement.
  • Establish stage-gate criteria and required artifacts for product approval, including product briefs, business cases, risk assessments, launch readiness materials, roadmap updates, and performance scorecards.
  • Lead cross-functional product intake and prioritization processes to align investments with enterprise strategy, customer needs, market opportunities, regulatory requirements, and expected business value.
  • Create a consistent governance process for evaluating business cases, expected value, implementation readiness, risk exposure, resource needs, and capacity tradeoffs.
  • Partner with Legal, Compliance, Security, Clinical, Finance, Technology, Operations, and Commercial teams to ensure decisions meet policy, regulatory, operational, financial, and customer requirements.
  • Maintain a governed enterprise view of the product portfolio, including active products, pipeline opportunities, dependencies, risks, investment priorities, lifecycle status, and performance health.
  • Own the enterprise product governance cadence, including agenda design, decision preparation, leadership readouts, action tracking, and follow-through.
  • Ensure product decisions are documented, communicated, and tied to accountable owners, timelines, measures, risks, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
  • Oversee integrated product roadmaps across business and technology teams and ensure roadmap decisions reflect customer needs, market intelligence, regulatory considerations, enterprise priorities, and delivery capacity.
  • Monitor delivery against approved commitments and drive resolution of risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and decision escalations.
  • Establish product performance monitoring standards, including KPIs tied to growth, adoption, margin, client and member outcomes, operational efficiency, compliance, and value realization.
  • Lead regular product health reviews and use data, stakeholder feedback, customer insights, and operational performance to inform continuation, optimization, investment, or retirement decisions.
  • Drive adoption of consistent tools, templates, documentation standards, and governance dashboards that improve transparency and decision quality.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

What our team expects from you?

  • PBM or related healthcare industry experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare administration, technology, product management, or a related field required. Master’s degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in product governance, product operations, product management, portfolio management, risk management, compliance, or enterprise program leadership required.
  • 5+ years of progressive leadership experience, which may include leading individual contributors or teams, required.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing governance models, decision rights, stage-gate processes, portfolio routines, and product lifecycle controls required.
  • Knowledge of product lifecycle management, agile delivery, enterprise systems, regulatory considerations, privacy, security, and operational readiness required.
  • Experience translating business strategy, customer needs, market intelligence, and risk considerations into product roadmaps, approval decisions, and execution plans required.
  • Demonstrated ability to use data, metrics, feedback, and financial analysis to assess product health, prioritize investments, and mitigate risk required.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders, align cross-functional stakeholders, and lead change across complex matrixed teams required.
  • Participate in, adhere to, and support compliance program objectives.
  • The ability to consistently interact cooperatively and respectfully with other employees.

What can you expect from Navitus?

  • Top of the industry benefits for Health, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • 20 days paid time off
  • 4 weeks paid parental leave
  • 9 paid holidays
  • 401K company match of up to 5% - No vesting requirement
  • Adoption Assistance Program
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Educational Assistance Plan and Professional Membership assistance
  • Referral Bonus Program – up to $750!

Appunite is moving from selling engineering hours to owning outcomes. Platform Delivery Team (PDT) is the service behind that shift: we take responsibility for a defined result, like an internal platform for a client, scoped up front and delivered in fixed-price milestones. It’s built on lessons from real client projects and it’s the top priority of our Service Team. We need someone to own it as a product.

This is a product role, not a coordination role. You’ll define what success looks like, run discovery with clients and internal teams, test hypotheses and shape every next version. Selling outcomes changes how we scope, sell, staff and deliver, so you’ll also own the backlog of processes, tools and docs that make v1 real.

You’ll make sure what Sales promises is what Delivery delivers, working with GTM, Client Success, Service Delivery, designers and engineers - none of whom report to you. You’ll report to our CEO, work side by side with him at first, then take over full ownership.

Note: this role doesn’t cover our AI Implementation service.

What we offer

  • Salary: 16 000 - 22 000 PLN net/month B2B - depending on your experience

  • Remote first approach

  • Ownership of the service Appunite is building its core offer around

  • A ~1.5-2 year path to v1, with room to shape v2 and v3

  • Fast onboarding - a few pages of docs and you’re on real topics within a week

  • Design support from a dedicated consultant

Job requirements

  • You’ve owned a product or service from an early stage - defined success, set metrics and decided what goes into the next version.

  • You’ve run discovery yourself and separated the real problem from a premature solution.

  • You’ve aligned multiple departments through influence, not hierarchy.

  • You start from the actual state, not the plan, and challenge assumptions constructively.

  • Strong delivery skills: backlog, prioritization, getting things over the line.

  • You keep your pace when validation is slow and change course when data says so.

Job Description

HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Manager, Global Web Ecosystem Governance Lead (Privacy, Legal, GEO, Accessibility)


WHAT YOU WILL DO

The Manager, Global Web Ecosystem Governance Lead (Privacy, Legal, GEO, Accessibility) coordinates the integration of privacy, legal, GEO and accessibility requirements across Amgen’s global web experiences. The role translates approved standards and expert guidance into practical requirements, reusable capabilities, risk-based readiness practices, and ongoing monitoring throughout the digital lifecycle. It partners with Privacy, Legal, GEO, Accessibility, business, and technology teams; formal legal interpretations and policy decisions remain with the appropriate subject matter owners.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Privacy, Legal, GEO and Accessibility Standards: Coordinate the application of global privacy regulations, consent requirements, GEO playbook, accessibility standards, legal content, disclosures, and data collection and retention policies across digital properties and markets.
  • Requirements across the Lifecycle: Work with business, design, and technology teams to incorporate privacy, legal, GEO and accessibility requirements into strategy, experience design, requirements, development acceptance criteria, platform components, templates, and forms.
  • Consent, Data, and Third-Party Governance: Support cookie and tracker governance, consent and preference experiences, data minimization, transparent collection and use, retention requirements, vendor privacy compliance, and data-processing obligations.
  • Risk-Based Readiness and Remediation: Coordinate practical, risk-based readiness reviews across web experiences. Identify gaps and affected markets or properties, document accountable owners and timelines, and track remediation without treating governance as a final approval checkpoint.
  • Monitoring, Audit, and Regulatory Change: Support compliance and consent monitoring, audit evidence, regulatory change management, issue escalation, and remediation in partnership with Privacy, Legal, Accessibility, and technology stakeholders.
  • Lifecycle Controls and Measures: Coordinate privacy and legal controls through ongoing changes and retirement, including data retention or deletion, tracker removal, vendor termination, and regulatory records. Track compliance health, exceptions, remediation aging, privacy incidents, and consent effectiveness.

WHAT WE EXPECT OF YOU

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. For the Manager, Global Web Ecosystem Governance Lead (Privacy, Legal, GEO, Accessibility), we seek a professional with these qualifications.


Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree

OR

Master’s degree and 2 years of digital governance, web ecosystem, privacy, legal, GEO, accessibility, cybersecurity, identity and access management, or related digital technology experience

Or

Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of digital governance, web ecosystem, privacy, legal, GEO, accessibility, cybersecurity, identity and access management, or related digital technology experience

Or

Associate’s degree and 8 years of digital governance, web ecosystem, privacy, legal, GEO, accessibility, cybersecurity, identity and access management, or related digital technology experience

Or

High school diploma / GED and 10 years of digital governance, web ecosystem, privacy, legal, GEO, accessibility, cybersecurity, identity and access management, or related digital technology experience


Preferred Experience:

  • Privacy, GEO and Consent Governance: Experience supporting privacy operations, consent management, cookie, and GEO governance, data minimization, retention, and global digital experiences.
  • Accessibility and Legal Content: Experience coordinating accessibility requirements and legal content such as privacy notices, disclosures, and terms across websites or digital products.
  • Digital Delivery Integration: Success incorporating governance requirements into user experience, requirements, development, reusable components, forms, launch readiness, and ongoing operations.
  • Regulatory and Vendor Readiness: Experience supporting regulatory change management, audit readiness, third-party privacy reviews, data-processing requirements, and remediation in a regulated environment.
  • Cross-Functional Communication: Ability to work effectively with Privacy, Legal, Accessibility, GEO, business, vendor, and technology teams and explain requirements in clear, actionable language.
  • Monitoring and Improvement: Experience tracking compliance health, exceptions, remediation, incidents, or consent performance and using findings to improve processes.

Preferred Competencies:

  • Leadership and Collaboration: Builds productive relationships across global and local teams and helps partners resolve issues with clear ownership.
  • Problem-Solving and Quality Focus: Applies care and sound judgment when identifying gaps, documenting evidence, and coordinating practical remediation.
  • Adaptability and Growth Mindset: Responds constructively to evolving regulations, GEO, accessibility needs, technologies, and business priorities.

Thrive

raw.description:
Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare clinic setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.

We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi’s technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

As a Senior Product Designer on our Patient Journey team, you’ll own the patient-facing flows that turn first-time visitors into patients who start and stay in treatment. Your design decisions show up directly in our conversion and retention numbers, not just in the mockups.

You’ll be the dedicated designer for the Patient Journey squad, partnering daily with a product manager, frontend and backend engineers, QA, and a data analyst, and reporting to our Director of Product. You own patient-facing flows end to end, from early prototype through validation to a shipped, measurable result in a HIPAA-regulated, AI-first environment where both speed and clarity matter.

Responsibilities

  • Own patient-facing conversion flows end to end, from framing the problem through prototyping, validation, and shipped design.
  • Design flows that clearly communicate MEDvidi’s care model and move patients toward the next step, anticipating their real questions and objections.
  • Partner closely with product and engineering to break “too hard / too long” down into shippable tests that launch in weeks.
  • Dig into product analytics and user research yourself to tie every design decision to a concrete metric: conversion, activation, or retention.
  • Use AI tools to prototype quickly, iterate with your PM, and validate ideas against real users before anything goes to build.

This role is not for you if

  • You need a detailed brief before starting work. Requirements here are gathered by you, not handed to you, there is no PM or BA writing specs for AI Track.
  • You prefer managing people over hands-on design. This is an IC role with no direct reports; the impact comes from the quality of your own design decisions.
  • You design exclusively in Figma and hand off static specs. Prototyping at MEDvidi happens in code on the real codebase using AI agents, comfort with a code editor is a daily requirement, not a nice-to-have.

Requirements

  • Senior-level product design experience (5+ years) with a strong track record of owning user-facing B2C conversion flows.
  • Demonstrable conversion ownership: you can point to a specific flow where you owned a metric, know the before/after numbers, and can explain your own contribution versus seasonality or marketing.
  • Outcome-driven: comfortable pulling your own data (Amplitude, GA, Metabase, or similar) and running or reading research, rather than waiting for hand-offs.
  • Ownership mindset: you break engineering constraints down to the atoms, negotiate scope, and ship meaningful tests fast.
  • AI as a working tool: fluent with at least one prototyping/AI tool (Lovable, v0, Bolt, Cursor, Claude, or similar) and clear-eyed about where AI should and shouldn’t be used.
  • Fluent Russian and solid working English (B2+)

Would be a plus

  • Experience with regulated or healthcare/telehealth products (HIPAA, NIST).

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
  • Career development: Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
  • Time off: 19 paid vacation days annually, 4 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.

AECOM is seeking an experienced and accomplished Remediation Construction Deputy Practice Director to support the strategic direction, growth, and operational leadership of its Remediation Construction Practice. This senior leadership position will partner with the Director to advance business strategy, expand client relationships, strengthen project delivery capabilities, and drive operational excellence across a portfolio of complex environmental remediation and construction programs.

This is a remote role that may be based anywhere within the U.S. Out of state travel will be required for this role.

The Deputy Director will provide leadership across project execution, business development, financial performance, workforce development, and technical quality. This role requires a strong understanding of environmental remediation and construction delivery, including contaminated site cleanup, soil and groundwater remediation, hazardous materials management, treatment system implementation, and regulatory compliance. The successful candidate will bring the ability to lead through project and department managers, establish consistent operational practices, manage business risks, and align technical resources with client and market demands.

Working collaboratively with AECOM’s Environment, Construction Management, Engineering, and Program Management teams, the Deputy Director will help position the business for continued growth while ensuring the successful delivery of safe, high-quality, and financially sound projects. This is an opportunity for a strategic, commercially minded leader to influence business performance, develop future leaders, strengthen key client partnerships, and advance AECOM’s position in the environmental remediation market.

  • Partner with the Director to establish and execute the strategic direction, business objectives, and growth plans for the remedial construction practice.
  • Provide senior-level operational leadership across a portfolio of environmental remediation and construction projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives, client commitments, and AECOM standards.
  • Oversee the performance of project and department managers, establishing expectations for project controls, financial management, schedule performance, risk mitigation, quality, and client satisfaction.

raw.title: Geospatial Engineer – Cloud & DevOps
raw.excerpt: Job DescriptionDewberry is seeking a Geospatial Engineer with experience in cloud-based workflows, software development, and DevOps to join our Resilience Solutions team.
raw.description:
Job Description

Dewberry is seeking a Geospatial Engineer with experience in cloud-based workflows, software development, and DevOps to join our Resilience Solutions team. This position will support the development of modern geospatial applications, data pipelines, and analytical workflows used for flood risk, water resources, and resilience projects.

The ideal candidate combines strong geospatial fundamentals with hands-on programming and cloud experience. They will work alongside geospatial professionals, engineers, scientists, and software developers to move geospatial workflows from desktop or manual processes toward automated, reproducible, cloud-based solutions.

This is a remote position with flexibility to work anywhere in the US.

Dewberry is a leading, market-facing professional services firm with more than 60 locations and 2,500 professionals nationwide. What sets us apart from our competitors are our people. At Dewberry, we seek out exceptional talent and strive to deliver the highest quality of services to our clients. Whether you’re an experienced professional or a new graduate, you’ll have the chance to collaborate with the best and brightest and work on innovative and complex projects at the forefront of the industry. Our commitment to excellence stems from our personal integrity and from other defining attributes, which we call “Dewberry at Work,” that have inspired our employees to be successful for more than a half-century.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, automate, and maintain open-source geospatial data-processing and analytical workflows using Python and modern geospatial libraries and tools.
  • Design workflows for large raster, vector, and multidimensional geospatial datasets using both traditional GIS and cloud-native approaches.
  • Develop and maintain cloud-based geospatial processing environments using AWS and/or Azure.
  • Build reproducible deployment and processing workflows using Docker, infrastructure as code, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and version control.
  • Develop data pipelines that support ingestion, transformation, validation, analysis, cataloging, and delivery of geospatial information.
  • Develop and integrate geospatial databases, APIs, services, and application components.
  • Support scalable processing using containerized and parallel or distributed computing approaches.
  • Implement testing, logging, monitoring, documentation, and quality-control practices for production geospatial workflows.
  • Optimize cloud storage, compute, and data-access patterns for performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Apply appropriate security practices, including identity and access management, least-privilege access, secrets management, encryption, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Collaborate with engineers, scientists, data scientists, and software developers to translate analytical requirements into maintainable operational workflows.
  • Evaluate emerging geospatial and cloud technologies and help transition successful pilots into project and production environments.
  • Document architectures, workflows, code, and operational procedures and share knowledge across project teams.

Required Skills & Required Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Geography, Geographic Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Environmental Science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Three or more years of relevant professional experience in geospatial development, data engineering, software development, cloud computing, or a related area.
  • Strong proficiency with Python for geospatial processing, automation, and data manipulation.
  • Experience with common geospatial technologies such as QGIS, GDAL, GeoPandas, Rasterio, PostGIS, or similar tools.
  • Experience working with geospatial raster and vector data and spatial databases.
  • Working experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud services.
  • Experience with Git and modern collaborative software-development practices.
  • Experience developing repeatable data-processing or analytical workflows.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary technical teams.
  • Strong technical communication and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Docker and containerized geospatial processing.
  • Experience with Terraform, AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK), AWS CloudFormation, or other infrastructure-as-code technologies.
  • Experience developing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with cloud storage, compute, and orchestration technologies such as Amazon S3, Amazon ECS or Fargate, AWS Batch, AWS Lambda, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Functions, or Kubernetes.
  • Experience with cloud-native geospatial formats and technologies such as Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF, GeoParquet or Parquet, Zarr, SpatioTemporal Asset Catalogs (STAC), or similar approaches.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL/PostGIS and geospatial database design and optimization.
  • Experience developing or consuming REST APIs or Open Geospatial Consortium APIs.
  • Experience with automated testing, logging, monitoring, and software quality practices.
  • Familiarity with security concepts including identity and access management, role-based access control, encryption, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with flood risk, water resources, environmental modeling, transportation, or other infrastructure-related geospatial applications.
  • Experience supporting FEMA, USACE, NOAA, USGS, state agencies, or similar public-sector clients.

*At this time, Dewberry will not sponsor a new applicant for work authorization.

*Dewberry is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or sexual orientation.

*Only recipients of an offer of employment from Dewberry, will be required to submit to a background screening which may include, but is not limited to, employment verification, educational and other credential verification, driving record check, criminal background check, and an investigative consumer report. These screenings will be conducted by Dewberry’s background vendor of choice and will be conducted in compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local law.

Salary Range

The projected range for this position is $116,000-$156,000 annually in our Fairfax, VA office. Depending upon other factors, i.e., skills, experience, location, market conditions, the range may vary slightly.

Job Description Summary

The Revenue Cycle Medical Records Case Manager will support documentation of medical necessity by facilitating medical records (MR) collection and client outreach, by offering expert review and interpretation on a case by case basis, and by maintaining collaborative and productive relationships within the organization relating to Revenue Cycle Management.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Successfully obtain necessary medical documentation by collaborating with and serving as a primary liaison between in-house billing operations, customer experience groups and clinic medical records departments
  • Have a thorough understanding and knowledge of applicable CMS, state, and insurer medical policy and coverage guidelines (in particular LCD & NCD Coverage Criteria)
  • Ability to navigate and extract data from multiple versions of electronic medical records, including EPIC
  • Serve as a source of knowledge for medical records (MR) review and interpretation, including in-depth review of provider progress notes and charts with the ability to identify critical data points highlighting why patient criteria meets medical necessity and summarizing in a succinct manner for health insurance companies
  • An in-depth knowledge and understanding of oncology and organ health terminology (including chemotherapy treatments and well as immunotherapy treatments)
  • Develop and cultivate ongoing working relationships with other departments impacting revenue cycle performance
  • Participate in weekly meetings, daily discussions, case reviews and continuing education to review key metrics, workflows, trends, and performance improvement opportunities
  • Prioritize performance initiatives and ensure productivity goals are achieved within a timely manner while maintaining the highest quality of work standards for Q/A
  • Follow department procedures and ensure all activities are documented and conducted within compliance standards with applicable business process requirements and regulatory requirements
  • This role requires access to Patient Health Information (PHI) both in paper and electronic form. Therefore, employees must complete training relating to HIPAA & PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training and security training as a requirement of the job

Qualifications:

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience, including but not limited to: health care administration, case management, nursing, oncology/transplant clinic, medical billing/coding, appeals and denials management and/or insurance collections
  • Bachelor's Degree (BS, LPN, RN, BSN, BSHA)
  • Healthcare related field of study or equivalent experience (Clinical Case Managers)

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of medical billing systems, medical terminology and abbreviations, basic procedure coding knowledge and health care nomenclature and systems
  • Proficiency with G-Suite products, including Google Calendar and G-Sheets, and strong analytic skills with ability to interpret, evaluate and act on clinical information
  • Previous experience working in an Oncology or Transplant clinical setting strongly preferred
  • Excellent organizational, time management and problem solving skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills as well as the ability to work with a variety of internal and external colleagues from all levels of an organization
  • Ability to work in a high performing, fast paced team environment that requires flexibility
  • Ability to navigate across multiple customer demands and balance competing priorities successfully
  • Ability to analyze, identify and articulate/report trends succinctly in a clear and concise manner
  • Ability to solve problems using critical thinking skills
  • Maintains confidentiality of sensitive PHI information
The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$32—$38 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit .

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Junior Full Stack Engineer to join Bask Health's engineering team and help build and improve the applications that power our telehealth platform.

You'll work across frontend and backend development, contributing to user-facing features, APIs, databases, and integrations. Depending on the project, you may help develop merchant tools, patient experiences, internal applications, or shared platform functionality.

This role is designed for an early-career engineer who has experience building web applications through coursework, internships, personal projects, or professional work and wants to continue developing their full-stack engineering skills.

You'll collaborate with experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to deliver reliable, maintainable software. You'll receive technical guidance while gradually taking on more ownership of features and implementation decisions.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, takes initiative, and is excited to grow into an engineer who can build and maintain features across the entire application stack.

What You'll Do

  • Build and improve full-stack features across Bask's web applications.
  • Develop frontend interfaces using JavaScript, TypeScript, and React.
  • Contribute to applications built with Next.js.
  • Help implement backend functionality using Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Build and integrate APIs connecting frontend applications with backend services.
  • Work with SQL databases to retrieve, update, and manage application data.
  • Contribute to merchant-facing and patient-facing application features.
  • Help develop internal tools and operational workflows.
  • Implement reusable frontend components and application functionality.
  • Collaborate with product managers and designers to understand feature requirements.
  • Translate technical specifications into working software.
  • Assist with third-party API integrations.
  • Help improve application responsiveness, usability, and accessibility.
  • Investigate and resolve bugs across frontend and backend systems.
  • Write readable, maintainable, and well-tested code.
  • Participate in code reviews and incorporate technical feedback.
  • Learn and apply best practices for authentication, authorization, and data security.
  • Contribute to automated testing and quality assurance.
  • Work with experienced engineers to understand application architecture.
  • Help document technical changes and development processes.
  • Participate in engineering planning and implementation discussions.
  • Learn about cloud-based applications and deployment workflows.
  • Use Git and collaborative development tools.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools while understanding and validating generated code.
  • Take increasing ownership of assigned engineering features and improvements.

Requirements

  • Foundational software engineering experience gained through coursework, internships, personal projects, freelance work, or professional roles.
  • Experience building web applications with both frontend and backend functionality.
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Familiarity with React or another modern frontend framework.
  • Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and responsive web development.
  • Familiarity with Node.js or another backend development environment.
  • Understanding of REST APIs and frontend-to-backend communication.
  • Basic knowledge of SQL databases or relational data.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous programming concepts.
  • Understanding of reusable frontend components and application state.
  • Ability to read, understand, and modify existing application code.
  • Familiarity with Git and version control.
  • Basic debugging and troubleshooting skills.
  • Understanding of common software development and testing practices.
  • Willingness to learn authentication, authorization, and application security principles.
  • Ability to follow technical documentation and implementation guidance.
  • Interest in building and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to communicate technical questions, progress, and challenges clearly.
  • Willingness to collaborate with engineers, designers, and product managers.
  • Openness to feedback, mentorship, and continuous learning.
  • Ability to work independently on clearly defined tasks in a remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Previous software engineering internship or junior development experience.
  • Experience with TypeScript, React, and Next.js.
  • Experience building backend applications with Node.js.
  • Familiarity with SQL databases and ORM tools.
  • Experience with Prisma or Drizzle ORM.
  • Familiarity with tRPC or typed API frameworks.
  • Exposure to AWS or another cloud platform.
  • Familiarity with serverless application development.
  • Experience using AWS Lambda or other cloud functions.
  • Familiarity with SST or similar infrastructure frameworks.
  • Experience with automated frontend or backend testing.
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and application deployment.
  • Experience building SaaS applications or internal business tools.
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant application concepts.
  • Experience working in a TypeScript monorepo.
  • Interest in e-commerce, merchant platforms, or subscription software.
  • Interest in healthcare or telehealth technology.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.
  • A GitHub profile or portfolio demonstrating full-stack application projects.

raw.description:
What you’ll be part of

Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.

The result is a rare “win win” — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can.

About the role:

We are looking for a dedicated Concierge Associate to join our member-facing team.In this role, you will serve as the front line of support for our members, acting as a trusted guide in helping them understand and navigate their healthcare benefits. You’ll engage directly with members through phone, chat, and email to help them access the highest-quality care at the lowest possible cost. Your work will be a key part of delivering on Garner’s mission.

This role requires more than just excellent service — we’re looking for someone who can thrive in an evolving environment and is comfortable with complexity. You’ll need to balance professionalism and empathy with strong attention to detail and the ability to interpret nuanced benefit and claims information. As the voice of Garner, you’ll play a vital role in creating a supportive and empowering experience for each member you connect with. You would be scheduled between 8 AM and 10 PM ET, with shift preferences considered but not guaranteed. Preferences will be collected during the interview process and finalized schedules will be provided after a five-week training period.

Where you will work:

This is a U.S. based fully remote position.

What you will do:

  • Deliver exceptional member support via phone, chat, and email
  • Educate members on their healthcare benefits and claims, including how to maximize their Garner benefit
  • Help steer members to find the best care available to them
  • Handle complex and sensitive conversations with professionalism, empathy, and patience
  • Deescalate members who are experiencing friction with their benefit
  • Work with other departments to address cross-departmental issues
  • Identify and escalate feedback from member interactions to internal teams
  • Stay up to date on evolving procedures
  • Protect member privacy and maintain compliance with HIPAA and data security protocols

The ideal candidate has:

  • Minimum 2 years of call center/customer service experience
  • Healthcare experience preferred
  • Clear and confident verbal and written communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail
  • A proactive and curious problem-solving mindset
  • An openness to feedback and a commitment to doing better every day
  • Technical proficiency with customer service platforms, such as Zendesk
  • A desire to be a part of a high-performing, mission-driven team that operates with intense urgency, a strong sense of individual accountability, and a commitment to authentic feedback

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing company in a transformative role, helping shape the future of healthcare.

Please note: we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

What you'll get here

You’ll work on problems that matter, at a company working to change healthcare at scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI and systemic healthcare reform, where the problems we solve are as interesting and compelling as the mission.

At Garner, you’ll take on real, ambitious problems with real ownership and autonomy, alongside exceptional, principles-based people who genuinely want you to win. It’s demanding by design. You’ll be challenged to stretch beyond what you thought possible and receive consistent coaching to help you grow and do the best work of your career. This isn't the right fit for everyone, and that's intentional. The people here are driven by what's at stake for real people, and that's what gives our intensity its purpose.

Application Process:

Here’s what you can expect in this process:

  1. Apply - you are here!
  2. Intro Call (15 minutes)
  3. Work Experience Interview (30 minutes)
  4. Role-Based Case Study (45 minutes)
  5. Job Offer

Compensation Transparency:

The base compensation for this position is: $22/hour. This position will also include a $0.50 additional hourly bump for English/Spanish bilingual candidates. Individual compensation for this role will depend on a variety of factors including qualifications, skills and applicable laws.

Fraud and Security Notice:

Please be aware of recent job scam attempts. Our recruiters use and email domains exclusively. If you have been contacted by someone claiming to be a Garner recruiter or a hiring manager from a different domain about a potential job, please report it to law enforcement here and to .

Garner Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. Travel: 10%-15%
Position Type: Full-Time
Employee Type: FTE
Compensation Range: $120K Annually + $200K OTE


Company Overview:

Virtual Technologies Group, LLC is a leading innovator in the technology sector, specializing in the development and implementation of advanced virtual solutions. Our mission is to empower businesses with cutting-edge technology that enhances efficiency, productivity, and connectivity. With a team of highly skilled professionals, we deliver customized solutions tailored to meet the unique needs of our clients across various industries. Our commitment to excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction drives us to continuously push the boundaries of what is possible. At Virtual Technologies Group, LLC, we are dedicated to shaping the future of technology and making a positive impact on the world.

Position Overview
You will open and grow VTG's private equity channel: sponsors, operating partners and their portfolio companies. You sell recurring managed services and professional services that make portfolio companies easier to integrate, secure and scale, from diligence through exit. This is a hunter role for an experienced seller who is comfortable opening new sponsor relationships and driving expansion and growth across the portfolio. It is measured on net-new bookings at margin, weighted toward recurring revenue, with an expectation of $2M in net new bookings over the first full 12 months in role following ramp. We are looking for a seller who brings established relationships and know-how in the private capital market; direct experience working with private equity sponsors and privately backed companies is key.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver $2M in net new bookings over the first full 12 months in role following ramp.
  • Build relationships with private equity operating partners, deal teams and portfolio CIOs and CFOs across a defined target list of sponsors.
  • Self-source the majority of pipeline through direct outreach to sponsors, operating partners and portfolio executives, and maintain the coverage required to deliver the annual target.
  • Position VTG for IT due diligence, 100-day plans, carve-outs, platform integrations and add-on onboarding.
  • Convert project work into recurring managed services and cybersecurity agreements, and expand each sponsor win into additional portfolio companies.
  • Run full-cycle sales: prospecting, discovery, solution scoping with delivery leaders, proposals, pricing and close.
  • Partner with SDRs and marketing on sponsor-focused campaigns, events and referrals.
  • Keep every opportunity current in Salesforce: stage, next step, close date, amount, Lead Source and product category.

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years selling IT services or managed services, with a record of closing new logos at $100K+ annual value.
  • Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding $2M+ annual net-new bookings quotas in a hunter role.
  • Direct experience selling to and working with private equity sponsors, operating partners and privately backed (private equity, growth equity or family office) companies.
  • Established relationships across sponsors, operating partners and portfolio company executives that you can activate from day one.
  • Comfort selling multi-entity, multi-year programs and presenting to CFO and board-level buyers.
  • Strong executive presence and ability to communicate complex IT concepts to non-technical financial stakeholders.
  • Excellent negotiation, objection-handling, and contract-closing skills for long-cycle sales.
  • Disciplined CRM habits and forecasting accuracy.
  • Ability to travel up to 40% to meet with private equity firms and portfolio leadership.

Preferred Requirements

  • Working knowledge of M&A IT workstreams: diligence, integration, carve-out, TSA exit, cybersecurity remediation.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, IT, or a related field (MBA is a plus).
  • Prior experience working directly within a Private Equity firm, as an operating partner, or in a PE-backed portfolio company.
  • Familiarity with major cloud platforms and cybersecurity frameworks often evaluated during IT due diligence.

Why Join Us?
At Virtual Technologies Group we provide more than just IT solutions; we offer a dynamic environment where you can learn, grow, and expand your skillset. As a leading managed services, cybersecurity, and IT consulting firm, we support a diverse range of customers, giving you the opportunity to tackle unique challenges and stay ahead in a rapidly evolving industry.
Join a team that values innovation, collaboration, and professional development. Whether you're looking to sharpen your technical expertise, work with cutting-edge technology, or make a real impact, we’re committed to helping you build a rewarding career.

VTG offers a comprehensive benefits package to meet the needs of our employees and their families. Benefits include medical insurance plans, dental insurance, vision insurance, health savings accounts (HSA), flexible spending accounts (FSA), life insurance, short and long-term disability insurance, paid time off and holidays, and a 401(k) with employer match.
