raw.description:
Product Manager — Virtualisation & Cloud Infrastructure

Location: Remote in Europe / EMEA

Department: Product Management

Employment type: Contractor friendly

Virtuozzo is a provider of infrastructure software for AI and the cloud, helping cloud service providers, SaaS companies, and enterprises build and operate efficient, scalable infrastructure. We combine an optimized operating system with orchestration, management, automation, and protection to deliver mainframe-like efficiency, performance, reliability, versatility, and security—while reducing overall cost and complexity.

Our Virtuozzo Infrastructure System (V/IS) brings together compute, storage, and networking to support traditional applications, cloud-native workloads, and AI services. We help organisations modernise their infrastructure, make better use of their hardware, and bring new cloud- and GPU-powered services to market on their own infrastructure and under their own brand.

Our technology serves more than 100,000 companies in over 100 countries. With deep engineering roots, we pioneered container-based virtualisation and continue to contribute to foundational open-source projects, including OpenVZ, the Linux kernel, Kubernetes, CRIU, KVM, and OpenStack.

The Role:

We are looking for a Product Manager for V/IS to help shape the future of the Virtuozzo product suite, including virtualisation, cloud management platforms, and infrastructure solutions for CSP, MSP, and SME markets.

This is a high-impact role for someone who combines strong product judgement, technical depth, market awareness, and customer empathy. You will work closely with engineering, sales, marketing, support, and customer-facing teams to define what we build, why we build it, how we position it, and how it creates measurable value for customers.

This is not a pure backlog-management role. We are looking for someone who can think strategically, engage deeply with technical customers, understand infrastructure markets, make clear prioritisation decisions, and turn product direction into execution.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Drive product strategy for the Virtuozzo product suite, including virtualisation, cloud management platforms, and infrastructure solutions for CSP, MSP, and SME markets.
  • Develop a comprehensive product roadmap that aligns with company business objectives, customer needs, market opportunities, and Virtuozzo’s broader platform direction.
  • Engage with key customers and stakeholders to gather insights, validate product hypotheses, and refine strategies to address market demands.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales, and support teams to ensure successful execution of product launches, feature iterations, and market positioning.
  • Lead market analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive threats, ensuring Virtuozzo is positioned to capitalise on new technologies and shifts in the market.
  • Define and implement pricing models and value propositions that drive customer adoption and revenue growth while maintaining a competitive edge in the market.
  • Work on cross-product initiatives to create a seamless experience across the Virtuozzo ecosystem, including integrations with third-party tools and emerging technologies.
  • You will also help connect product strategy to real customer outcomes: faster cloud service launches, lower infrastructure cost, better operational efficiency, improved monetisation for service providers, and a simpler experience across the Virtuozzo platform.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience in cloud infrastructure, virtualisation, cloud management platforms, infrastructure software, hosting, telco cloud, MSP/CSP platforms, or adjacent technical domains.
  • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure technologies such as virtualisation, KVM, OpenStack, Kubernetes, software-defined storage, networking, orchestration, automation, or cloud management platforms.
  • Experience building product strategy and roadmaps for technical B2B products used by infrastructure teams, service providers, managed service providers, enterprises, or SaaS companies.
  • Ability to work closely with engineering teams and engage in technical discussions with architects, developers, solution architects, support engineers, and customer operations teams.
  • Strong customer-discovery skills, with the ability to translate technical and commercial pain points into clear product priorities.
  • Experience with market analysis, competitor research, pricing, packaging, value propositions, and product positioning.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear product narratives, roadmap updates, business cases, and launch materials.
  • A structured, analytical approach to prioritization, with comfort using customer input, market data, usage data, commercial impact, and technical feasibility to make product decisions.
  • Confidence working across distributed, international teams.

Nice to Have

  • CSP, MSP, hosting, telco, or cloud service provider environments.
  • VMware alternatives, OpenStack-based platforms, KVM-based virtualisation, Kubernetes orchestration, or infrastructure automation.
  • Product ownership for cloud control panels, cloud management platforms, portals, billing integrations, self-service platforms, or infrastructure operations tooling.
  • Pricing and packaging for infrastructure software, subscription models, usage-based models, or service-provider commercial models.
  • Familiarity with AI infrastructure, GPU infrastructure, edge infrastructure, hybrid cloud, or multi-cloud management.

What We Offer

  • Remote work from Europe / EMEA.
  • Flexible working hours and a distributed international team.
  • High ownership and visibility within the Product organisation.
  • The opportunity to influence product and R&D direction from day one.
  • A technical, engineering-driven culture with practical decision-making and minimal bureaucracy.
  • Work on meaningful infrastructure products used by cloud providers, MSPs, SaaS companies, and enterprises.
  • Private medical insurance support, depending on location and employment setup.
  • Additional benefits depending on country, location, and preferred employment method.

description: The Senior UX/UI Designer is the team's strongest executor and a rising strategic voice — someone who takes the Manager's direction and vision and turns it into exceptional, well-reasoned design outcomes.

raw.title: Senior Product Designer
raw.excerpt: The Senior UX/UI Designer is the team's strongest executor and a rising strategic voice — someone who takes the Manager's direction and vision and turns it into exceptional, well-reasoned design outcomes.
raw.description:
The Senior UX/UI Designer is the team's strongest executor and a rising strategic voice — someone who takes the Manager's direction and vision and turns it into exceptional, well-reasoned design outcomes. While the Manager owns strategy and prioritization, the Senior Designer owns the craft: leading complex projects with confidence, raising the quality bar for the whole team, and proactively identifying opportunities to improve the digital experience. This role applies AI-assisted methods to complex product-design challenges and helps explore AI-enabled experiences through rapid, testable prototypes. At a growing company like Brightspeed, this person is a force multiplier — someone who elevates every designer around them simply by how they work.

IMPACT

Execution & Craft

  • Own complex UX/UI design projects end-to-end, from discovery and wireframing through high-fidelity delivery and developer handoff, across the website, eCommerce experience, and customer account platform.

  • Set the quality standard for the team's output, demonstrating what excellent design looks like at every level of fidelity.

  • Make well-reasoned trade-offs between speed, quality, and scope, and communicate those decisions clearly to the Manager and stakeholders.

  • Produce meticulous, well-organized Figma files that are easy for the team to build on and maintain.

Strategic Contribution

  • Translate the Manager's strategic direction into concrete design approaches, proactively filling in the gaps between high-level goals and execution details.

  • Identify appropriate opportunities for AI-enabled experiences and use AI-assisted or agent-building tools to create and evaluate prototypes in partnership with product, content, and engineering.

  • Bring forward well-developed, data-informed design recommendations, not just solutions, but the reasoning behind them.

  • Partner with analysts, product owners, and strategists to interpret data, identify experience gaps, and propose design-led improvements.

  • Stay ahead of industry trends in UX, UI, and eCommerce design, and introduce relevant ideas to the team.

Team Elevation

  • Actively raise the craft of the team through thoughtful critique, generous knowledge-sharing, and modeling strong design thinking.

  • Provide clear, constructive feedback to junior designers, helping them grow without undermining their ownership.

  • Contribute to a team culture where curiosity, quality, and collaboration are the norm.

Research & Validation

  • Plan and facilitate usability testing, design reviews, and research sessions, synthesizing findings into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Champion user-centered decision-making across the team and with cross-functional partners.

May perform other duties as assigned.

YOU WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

  • Hold a bachelor’s degree in design, UX, HCI, or a related field.

  • Bring 5+ years of experience in UX/UI design, with a portfolio that demonstrates both strategic thinking and exceptional craft across complex digital products.

  • Have demonstrated experience using AI in a professional product-design process and can discuss at least one substantial example involving design exploration, prototyping, workflow improvement, or an AI-enabled experience.

  • Are an expert Figma user, comfortable working within and contributing to established design systems.

  • Excel at independent execution — you can take a brief, ask the right questions, and deliver without needing constant direction.

  • Think critically about problems before jumping to solutions and can articulate your design rationale clearly and confidently.

  • Are genuinely invested in the growth of the people around you and bring a collaborative, low-ego energy to the team.

A PLUS IF YOU HAVE

  • Experience in eCommerce, telecommunications, or other high-volume digital consumer products.

  • Familiarity with front-end development workflows and developer handoff best practices.

  • Hands-on experience with user research platforms (e.g., UserTesting, Maze, or Lookback).

  • Background in conversion rate optimization or data-driven design experimentation.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

English required. Bilingual (Spanish) a plus.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Work is primarily sedentary, performed indoors from a home or company office while operating a computer and standard office productivity tools. Occasional additional hours may be required to meet project deadlines.

WHY JOIN US?

We aspire to contemporary ways of working.

Recognized as a Top Workplace by the Charlotte Observer, Brightspeed HQ is located on the 7th floor of the new Vantage South End - East Tower in Charlotte, NC. We prioritize hiring talent in the Charlotte area, whenever possible, to make it a truly vibrant destination for our hybrid workforce. At Brightspeed, we have roles that are designated as remote, hybrid, office or field-based, depending on the position, business needs and individual circumstances. We also invest in technology that enables our entire team to stay connected. Why? Because Brightspeed recognizes the value of finding the best talent for the job, wherever they may be.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.

Our benefits and paid time off programs reflect our underlying belief in promoting overall wellness through physical, emotional and financial health. Brightspeed offers a comprehensive benefit program, including competitive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance; an employee assistance program; a 401K plan with company match and a host of voluntary benefits.

Inclusion and belonging are at the center of our grounding belief in Being Real.

When we bring our authentic selves to work, everyone is better as a result. A diverse team helps us be fierce advocates for more accessible, inclusive and high-quality internet, because we believe doing so promotes equity in the communities we serve.

Brightspeed is an Equal Opportunity Employer that is committed to inclusion of all qualified individuals, including individuals with a disability/veterans. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact to initiate the accommodations process.

For all applicants, please take a moment to review our Privacy Notices:

  • Brightspeed’s Privacy Notice for California Residents
  • Brightspeed’s Privacy Notice

At Brightspeed, we are reimagining how people live, work, play and connect by providing fast, reliable internet connections and an awesome customer experience in twenty states throughout the Midwest and South.

Backed by funds managed by Apollo Global Management, our vision is to accelerate the upgrade of copper to fiber optic technologies, bringing faster and more reliable internet service to many rural markets traditionally underserved by broadband providers, while delivering best-in-class customer experience.

Be a part of the team that will make this vision a reality….designing and building a world class fiber network and creating a customer experience second to none.

Check us out on the web!

raw.title: Demand Generation Manager
raw.excerpt: Job Summary:We are looking for a highly driven, creative, and commercially minded Demand Generation Manager who knows how to create demand, engage potential buyers, and turn prospects into qualified sales opportunities.
raw.description:
Job Summary:

We are looking for a highly driven, creative, and commercially minded Demand Generation Manager who knows how to create demand, engage potential buyers, and turn prospects into qualified sales opportunities.

This is not a conventional email marketing role. We are looking for someone who can build and execute an integrated demand generation strategy using outbound marketing, email campaigns, marketing automation, account-based marketing, and data-driven prospecting.

You will own the demand generation engine, from identifying the right audience and developing compelling messaging to launching campaigns, nurturing prospects, generating qualified meetings, and contributing to revenue growth.

We need someone who thinks strategically but is equally comfortable getting hands-on with campaign execution, writing compelling emails, building automation workflows, researching prospects, and analyzing campaign performance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Email Marketing & Lifecycle Campaigns

  • Own the overall email marketing strategy and execution.
  • Develop targeted email campaigns for different audience segments, industries, buyer personas, and service offerings.
  • Build and manage automated email sequences, nurture workflows, newsletters, and lifecycle campaigns.
  • Create compelling email copy, subject lines, CTAs, and messaging that drive engagement and conversions.
  • Develop re-engagement campaigns for dormant leads, closed-lost opportunities, inactive contacts, and existing databases.
  • Implement audience segmentation, behavioral triggers, lead scoring, and personalized communication.
  • Continuously test and optimize email deliverability, engagement, conversion rates, and campaign performance.
  • Maintain email marketing best practices, sender reputation, domain health, and compliance.

2. Outbound Marketing & Prospecting

  • Develop and execute scalable outbound marketing strategies targeting relevant decision-makers and potential customers.
  • Build targeted prospect databases using ICPs, industry segments, company attributes, and buyer personas.
  • Design personalized cold email campaigns and multi-touch outreach sequences.
  • Develop outbound messaging strategies tailored to different industries, business challenges, and buying motivations.
  • Execute coordinated outreach campaigns across email, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.
  • Identify opportunities to engage high-value accounts through personalized and relevant outreach.
  • Experiment with different outreach approaches, messaging angles, offers, and sequences.
  • Establish processes for prospect research, contact enrichment, list validation, and campaign execution.
  • Work closely with Sales to convert positive responses into qualified meetings and opportunities.

3. Demand Generation Strategy & Campaign Development

  • Develop and execute integrated demand generation strategies aligned with business and revenue objectives.
  • Build campaigns that generate awareness, capture existing demand, nurture prospects, and create new buying opportunities.
  • Develop industry-specific and persona-based campaigns with tailored messaging and value propositions.
  • Identify new opportunities to reach potential customers through targeted campaigns, partnerships, databases, and outbound channels.
  • Plan and execute account-based marketing (ABM) campaigns for high-value target accounts.
  • Develop campaign calendars, messaging frameworks, content requirements, and distribution strategies.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing and Content teams to translate positioning, customer insights, and value propositions into demand generation campaigns.
  • Identify opportunities to reactivate existing leads and accelerate prospects through the sales funnel.

4. Marketing Automation & CRM Management

  • Own demand generation workflows and campaign automation within HubSpot.
  • Build automated nurture sequences based on audience behavior, engagement, lifecycle stages, and lead qualification.
  • Implement lead scoring, segmentation, routing, and qualification workflows.
  • Maintain CRM data quality, campaign tracking, attribution, and contact lifecycle management.
  • Integrate prospecting and outreach platforms with CRM systems to maintain a connected acquisition workflow.
  • Develop reporting dashboards to measure campaign performance, lead progression, and pipeline contribution.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve marketing automation and operational efficiency.

5. Data, Analytics & Performance Optimization

  • Track and analyze campaign performance across email, outbound, nurture, and ABM initiatives.
  • Monitor positive reply rates, qualified meetings, MQLs, SQLs, opportunities, and marketing-sourced pipeline.
  • Measure email engagement, deliverability, bounce rates, unsubscribes, and conversion performance.
  • Analyze campaign performance by industry, audience, messaging, channel, and buyer persona.
  • Conduct A/B testing across email copy, subject lines, CTAs, offers, and outreach sequences.
  • Identify underperforming campaigns and develop actionable optimization strategies.
  • Present regular performance reports, insights, experiments, and recommendations to marketing leadership.
  • Connect demand generation activities to actual business outcomes and revenue contribution.

6. Sales Alignment & Pipeline Development

  • Work closely with Sales to align campaign strategies with sales priorities and revenue targets.
  • Develop clear qualification criteria and processes for handing over sales-ready leads.
  • Collaborate on outbound messaging, target account lists, and industry-specific sales plays.
  • Monitor lead-to-meeting, meeting-to-opportunity, and opportunity-to-customer conversion rates.
  • Gather feedback from Sales to improve targeting, messaging, and lead quality.
  • Build campaigns that support the entire customer acquisition journey, from initial engagement to closed-won opportunities.

Tools & Technology

Hands-on experience with several of the following platforms is expected:

  • CRM & Marketing Automation: HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Marketo.
  • Prospecting & Data Intelligence: Apollo.io, Clay, ZoomInfo, Lusha.
  • Cold Email & Outreach: Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist, Salesloft, Outreach.
  • Email Platforms: HubSpot Marketing Hub, Mailchimp, Brevo.
  • Analytics & Reporting: Google Analytics 4, Looker Studio, HubSpot Reporting.
  • LinkedIn Prospecting: LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

You do not need to have used every platform, but you must understand how to build and manage an effective demand generation technology stack.

Requirements

  • 4-6 years of experience in B2B demand generation, email marketing, outbound marketing, or growth marketing.
  • Demonstrated experience building and executing email marketing and outbound acquisition campaigns.
  • Strong understanding of B2B buyer journeys, ICP development, audience segmentation, and lead qualification.
  • Proven ability to develop effective cold email campaigns and personalized outreach sequences.
  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms, preferably HubSpot.
  • Experience with prospecting, contact enrichment, and outbound campaign tools.
  • Excellent email copywriting and communication skills.
  • Strong understanding of email deliverability, sender reputation, domain warm-up, and email authentication protocols (SPF, DKIM, DMARC).
  • Experience developing nurture journeys, lead scoring, and CRM workflows.
  • Understanding of account-based marketing and multi-channel outreach.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate campaign data into actionable improvements.
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns independently while maintaining strategic direction and execution quality.

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • You have built an outbound engine from scratch and can demonstrate its contribution to qualified pipeline.
  • You understand how to combine personalization, automation, and scale without compromising outreach quality.
  • You know how to write emails that generate meaningful responses rather than generic promotional messages.
  • You understand the difference between lead generation and demand generation.
  • You can identify the right audiences, find decision-makers, and develop campaigns around their actual business challenges.
  • You have successfully executed ABM and industry-specific demand generation campaigns.
  • You understand how to reactivate dormant databases and turn existing contacts into new opportunities.
  • You are comfortable experimenting with AI-powered prospect research, personalization, enrichment, and campaign automation.
  • You think in terms of meetings, opportunities, pipeline, and revenue rather than email volume and open rates.

Who We Are Looking For

We want a demand creator, not an email operator.

Someone who is curious about buyer psychology, understands how businesses make purchasing decisions, knows how to initiate meaningful conversations, and can turn a database into a revenue-generating asset.

Someone who can think strategically, write exceptionally well, execute independently, experiment continuously, and take full ownership of outcomes.

If you believe demand generation is about sending thousands of emails, generating contact lists, and reporting open rates, this role is not for you.

If you know how to identify the right buyers, reach them with the right message, create interest, and turn that interest into qualified business opportunities, we want to hear from you.

Capital Technology Group provides expert consulting services software development, digital transformation, human-centered design, data analytics and visualization, and cybersecurity.

Our multidisciplinary teams use agile methodologies to rapidly and incrementally deliver value in close collaboration with our clients. For over a decade, we have been trusted by both federal and commercial clients to solve complex, mission-critical business challenges. The quality of our work has been recognized by our partners and peers through our inclusion in the Digital Services Coalition, a group of forward- thinking firms recognized for excellence in delivering IT services.

Client Requirements: Applicants MUST BE US Citizens and be able to obtain Public Trust clearance.

The CTG Experience At Capital Technology Group (CTG), our teams are passionate about modernizing how the federal government delivers software. We partner with federal agencies to build secure, scalable, mission-driven solutions that make a meaningful impact on millions of people. CTG was recognized by The Washington Post as a Top Workplace in 2025 and 2026, and our culture is rooted in our mission. Those values guide how we work together and support one another, creating an environment where employees feel trusted, empowered, and encouraged to grow both personally and professionally.

About the RoleCTG is seeking a Solution Architect to lead the technical approach for a large, mission-critical federal program supporting national security missions, spanning enterprise integration, data analytics, and DevSecOps. This role is ideal for a hands-on architect with a strong data background who designs secure, scalable systems that connect people, data, and partner organizations. You’ll turn large volumes of information into timely insight for mission decisions and bring a strong DevSecOps mindset to how those systems are built and delivered. Own the technical approach, implementation, and system knowledge for the work stream

  • Design and build data ingestion pipelines that bring together data from many sources, formats, and systems
  • Architect analytics solutions, including data models, storage, processing, and reporting layers that support mission decisions
  • Make sure data quality, lineage, and governance are built into ingestion and analytics workflows
  • Lead DevSecOps practices across the work stream, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and security scanning
  • Stay hands-on in the code, driving development and runtime analysis to ensure the system performs well
  • Support operations across multiple environments to ensure system reliability and availability
  • Proactively identify technical issues and risks, and lead the work to resolve them
  • Lead system design discussions, architecture reviews, and technical decision-making
  • Translate business and mission requirements into technical implementation strategies
  • Mentor engineers and set engineering standards and best practices
  • Help the company grow by taking part in technical challenges, business development, and recruiting

Who You Are

  • Passionate about building secure, high-quality data solutions in mission-driven environments
  • A hands-on technical expert who drives development and implementation of impactful solutions
  • Someone who takes ownership, sets clear expectations, and delivers high-quality technical work
  • A strong leader with sharp analytical and problem-solving skills
  • An excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing, with team members and outside stakeholders
  • Quick to learn new systems and technologies and to get up to speed on new projects

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, solution architecture, or technical lead role
  • Demonstrated experience designing and documenting end-to-end, multi-tier architectures (application, data, integration, and infrastructure), including architecture diagrams and design specifications
  • Strong proficiency in Java and/or Python and SQL
  • Experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle) and data modeling
  • Experience building cloud-native solutions in AWS or Azure
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and DevSecOps workflows
  • Knowledge of secure development practices and data security best practices
  • Strong communication and technical leadership skills, including directing less senior team members

Nice to Have

  • Experience with data processing and orchestration tools (e.g., Spark, Databricks, Airflow, dbt, AWS Glue)
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, QuickSight)
  • Experience with Docker and/or Kubernetes
  • Experience with Terraform or CloudFormation
  • Experience with API gateways and service proxies (e.g., Apigee, Envoy, Nginx)
  • Experience with search and observability tools (e.g., Elasticsearch/Kibana, Splunk, New Relic)
  • Experience with application security tooling (e.g., SonarQube, Checkmarx, Prisma Cloud/Twistlock, OWASP ZAP) and DISA STIGs
  • Experience architecting AI/ML-enabled solutions, such as natural language processing, named entity recognition, or LLM-based applications (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker)
  • Experience supporting federal government agencies

Salary We are committed to offering a competitive salary for this position, with an estimated range of $145k-190k annually. Please note that this range is intended to provide a general idea of what to expect. The final offer may vary based on experience, skills, and other factors.

Full Time Employee Benefits

  • Remote Work (Hybrid roles will be specified in the job post)
  • Competitive Compensation Package
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • Life Insurance, Short/Long Term Disability
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401(k) with 4% matching
  • Liberal PTO vacation policy
  • Generous Annual Continuing Education
  • Annual Wellness Budget
  • Bonus Incentive Programs (Employee referrals and performance-based rewards)

Thanks for your interest in Capital Technology Group!

Capital Technology Group is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.description:
About the Opportunity

We are partnering with an innovative data center development and infrastructure company supporting the rapidly growing AI and high-performance computing (HPC) industry.

The company develops and operates specialized data center facilities for GPU cloud providers, AI infrastructure companies, and enterprise customers. Its projects range from smaller multi-megawatt deployments to large-scale facilities exceeding 30 MW, including the conversion of existing industrial buildings into high-density computing environments.

We are seeking a Senior Data Center Engineer to oversee critical infrastructure projects from initial site evaluation and utility coordination through engineering design, construction, commissioning, and operational handoff.

This is an owner-side engineering opportunity for someone who can take technical ownership of infrastructure workstreams, coordinate across utilities and external engineering partners, and help deliver reliable, high-density AI data center environments.

What You'll Do

  • Site Evaluation & Infrastructure Planning: Evaluate potential sites for electrical power availability, utility capacity, fiber connectivity, water access, structural requirements, and permitting constraints. Develop phased capacity plans, cost estimates, and implementation schedules.
  • Electrical Infrastructure: Lead utility coordination and review electrical designs involving transformers, switchgear, UPS systems, generators, and rack-level power distribution.
  • Mechanical & Cooling Systems: Review mechanical infrastructure designs for high-density GPU deployments, including air cooling, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, coolant distribution units (CDUs), and facility water systems. Evaluate redundancy, scalability, cost, and implementation timelines.
  • Engineering & Construction Oversight: Represent the owner during construction, review technical submittals and RFIs, resolve engineering issues, and coordinate with engineering firms, contractors, and equipment vendors.
  • Commissioning & Operational Readiness: Lead commissioning activities and integrated systems testing. Develop operating procedures, preventive maintenance plans, and incident response processes.
  • Standards & Continuous Improvement: Help establish repeatable engineering standards, reference designs, and operating procedures that can be applied across future data center projects.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in data center engineering, critical infrastructure, or comparable mission-critical facilities.
  • Hands-on experience owning a significant electrical, mechanical, construction, commissioning, or critical operations workstream.
  • Strong technical knowledge of electrical or mechanical infrastructure, with the ability to understand how power and cooling systems interact in high-density computing environments.
  • Experience coordinating with utilities, engineering firms, general contractors, subcontractors, and/or equipment vendors.
  • Ability to evaluate engineering designs, identify technical tradeoffs, and communicate recommendations to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting projects through multiple phases, ideally from initial design through construction, commissioning, and operational handoff.
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly to project sites throughout the United States, with increased travel during construction and commissioning.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience delivering a multi-megawatt data center or other mission-critical facility from concept through commissioning.

- Professional Engineer (PE) license.

  • Experience with liquid-cooled GPU clusters or other high-density computing environments.
  • Experience converting industrial or existing commercial buildings into data center facilities.
  • Experience coordinating with utilities, particularly within the Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA) service area.
  • Familiarity with data center infrastructure management (DCIM), facility monitoring, and critical infrastructure operating standards.

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation will be based on experience, technical expertise, and project ownership scope. Equity participation may be available for qualified candidates.

Location & Travel

This is a remote position open to candidates throughout the United States. Candidates based in Tennessee are preferred, but applicants nationwide will be considered. Regular travel to active and prospective project sites is required, with heavier travel during construction and commissioning.

raw.description:
Director, AP Italian Language and Culture, Curriculum and Assessment

College Board – AP & I

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type:This is a full-time position


About the Team

The AP Curriculum and Assessment Team at College Board (125+ staff) collaborates with colleagues across all aspects of the AP Program to develop, manage, and deliver AP’s 43 courses in a wide variety of subject areas. AP® is a rigorous academic program built on the commitment, passion, and hard work of students and educators from secondary schools and higher education. AP provides willing and academically prepared high school students with the opportunity to study and learn at the college level. AP’s course teams comprised of educators and disciplinary experts ensure that course curricula are aligned to higher education expectations and reflect the state of the art in the discipline, contribute to instructional resources and tools for teachers, and develop assessments that allow students in these courses to demonstrate their mastery of course content and skills. AP leads in strategic use of AI to expand student access, strengthen instructional design and professional support, and enhance assessment creation and exam analysis. The English, World Languages, and Arts department, which includes English Literature, English Language, Spanish Language, Italian Language, French Language, German Language, Italian Language, Japanese Language, Latin, Music Theory, Spanish Literature, and Art and Design is currently comprised of approximately 35 people supporting 14 courses in the AP portfolio. 


About the Opportunity

As the Director I, AP Italian Language and Culture you will be responsible for preserving and improving the quality and validity of the AP Program’s core deliverables within the subject domain: the exam, the course curriculum, and the professional development content. You are also responsible for item development and management from authoring to administration; training and collaborating with subject-matter experts (SMEs), typically college professors and secondary school teachers. You will ethically and effectively integrate AI technologies in assessment creation and review. This includes judiciously using AI assisted tools to support fairness, validity, and innovation in AP assessments. You will train SMEs on assessment development protocols, translate between academics and technical experts (psychometricians), and collaborate to develop formative assessment materials and resources to support AP Italian Language and Culture teachers worldwide. You will serve as a point of contact in AP for committees and communities of subject-matter experts and will be responsible for the curriculum and assessment for AP Italian Language and Culture, and, in partnership with other AP teams, further the strategic growth of AP Italian Language and Culture across the globe. Additionally, you may have the opportunity to present, speak, and moderate dialogue with academic and membership audiences to ensure that ongoing change and improvement within AP courses and exams is understood, accepted, and supported in secondary and post-secondary educational communities.  


In this role, you will:


Assessment Development and Scoring (45-75%)  

  • Serve as an assessment leader for AP Italian Language and Culture, with primary responsibility for assessment development for AP Italian Language and Culture. Your work in developing and revising test content is of the quality that requires only minimal adjustments based on feedback from your manager and other program leaders. 
  • Independently lead processes for authoring and revising assessment content, including training educator constituents and leveraging generative AI to author and/or review assessment content, improving and/or making more efficient assessment processes and outputs.
  • Independently lead the development and management of assessment content (formative and summative) and scoring materials for AP Italian Language and Culture through iterative review stages with multiple internal and external stakeholders, including the AP Italian Language and Culture Team, Assessment Production team, Test Development Committee, and the Chief Reader, as appropriate.
  • Independently lead the development of assessment forms for AP Italian Language and Culture, ensuring the AP Exam development aligns with approved curricula and test specifications.
  • Lead multiple face-to-face, weekend meetings, and virtual meetings (during work week, evenings, or weekends) annually with the AP Italian Language and Culture Test Development Committee. You strategize and develop an agenda and approach to ensure the committee’s meeting time is of the highest productivity; you successfully adapt and pivot during the meeting as needed; and you successfully resolve all post-meeting item content edits.
  • Train and directly supervise Test Development Committee members in AP Italian Language and Culture as content development contributors and reviewers. Recruit educators for the AP Italian Language and Culture Development Committee and other opportunities to support AP Program.
  • Lead the successful scoring of student responses for AP Italian Language and Culture Exams at the annual scoring event in person and online—the “AP Reading”—and produce AP Reading publications materials for teacher and student use. You plan all year, with increasing intensity in the months leading up to the Reading, ensuring all workflow steps for this incredibly complex event, as well as all post-Reading activities, are accounted for and successfully executed. 

Assessment Quality and Process (10-15%) 

  • Contribute to current research and best practices in assessment, and engage regularly with AP Curriculum & Assessment colleagues to align on standards and shared principles guiding AP’s assessment directions 
  • Support assessment workstreams within the AP English, World Languages, and Arts Department. 
  • Contribute to processes for efficient, high-quality assessment development. 
  • Contribute to initiatives to refine and improve question task models as well as exam design in collaboration with AP Curriculum & Assessment leaders and aligned to other College Board initiatives to achieve psychometric and disciplinary best practices on AP Italian Language and Culture exams. 
  • Monitor exam validity, security, reliability, fairness, and quality, as well as reader reliability in accordance with established Program thresholds for AP Italian Language and Culture exam, identifying areas for improvement and executing on targeted improvement initiatives. 
  • Collaborate with psychometrics and AP Curriculum & Assessment staff to establish fair, reliable, and valid cut scores for AP Italian Language and Culture exam. 

 

Course Development, Program Support, and Stakeholder Engagement (5-25%)

  • Refine and improve AP Italian Language and Culture Framework to ensure clear and explicit learning outcomes that align with strategic priorities, including ensuring college/disciplinary standards as well as expanding the scope of reaching a broader audience of AP students.  
  • Collaborate with AP teams to support the development of new products for AP Italian Language and Culture designed to address unmet teacher instructional needs, potentially including developing prototypes, participating in small-scale market-testing, and creating models for subsequent development in conjunction with other AP workstreams.  
  • Recruit educators for the AP Italian Language and Culture Development Committee and other opportunities to support AP Program. 
  • Serve as a recognized and trusted resource within the educator community by collaboration and engagement with the community to drive teacher satisfaction with AP Italian Language and Culture and its exam. 
  • Collaborate with the AP Professional learning team to support AP Italian Language and Culture consultants and teachers. 
  • Work with the AP Higher Education team to co-develop and implement plans to raise college and university awareness of AP Italian Language and Culture courses and exams, including recruiting college faculty to participate in the AP Reading, co-leading the planning and execution of discipline-specific AP Faculty Colloquia events, and supporting Visiting and Virtual Fellows Programs.  

About You

To qualify for this role, you must have:

  • A Master’s degree in Italian Language or a directly related discipline, and knowledge of current trends in the discipline (required), although a doctorate in the discipline is strongly preferred  
  • Native to near-native fluency in Italian.
  • Expertise in Italian Language with at least 5 years of experience in standardized assessment development or related work; experience with digital assessment and teaching preferred 
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, with solid technical proficiency and a customer-focused mindset 
  • Excellent organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and maintain close attention to detail, including proofreading 
  • Demonstrated ability to implement processes and procedures, manage project plans and schedules, and maintain tracking documentation 
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across all levels, and engage in giving and receiving constructive feedback 
  • Ability to travel 6-8 times per year, plus up to two additional weeks for the AP Reading; must be eligible to work in the United States 

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.


A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $96,000 - $135,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

Job Description: Legal Expert – Civil Rights Law

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Civil Rights Law Experts to support a legal data annotation project focused on improving AI systems' understanding of civil rights matters. You will apply your legal expertise to create, review, and evaluate high-quality legal datasets. No prior AI experience is required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create and review legal annotation tasks covering discrimination, constitutional rights, disability access, police misconduct, and civil rights litigation.
  • Ensure the accuracy, clarity, and legal relevance of datasets and annotation guidelines.
  • Draft clear legal explanations and rationales for complex civil rights scenarios.
  • Review annotation deliverables and provide detailed quality assurance feedback.
  • Collaborate with project managers, platform specialists, and legal experts to improve workflows.
  • Update project documentation and support best practices in legal data annotation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree and active US bar admission.
  • Professional experience as a civil rights, civil liberties, or civil rights litigation attorney.
  • Strong knowledge of civil rights law, constitutional law, discrimination, and police practices.
  • Excellent legal research, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Familiarity with legal technology, data annotation, or digital knowledge management is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work collaboratively in remote, multidisciplinary teams.

Title: Sr Manager StrategyLocation: Statewide Multi Use, ILJob Requisition ID: Req-272210Time Type: Full time

About Lamb Weston


You’ve probably enjoyed our fries without even knowing it! As a leading manufacturer in our industry, we inspire and bring people together with foods they love and trust. Our customer base includes international food service providers, restaurants, and households in over 100 countries around the world.


A highly innovative global corporation with a start-up mindset, we empower every individual to make a genuine difference. You’ll gain access to hands-on training to fuel your growth and success, explore opportunities for new solutions, and you’ll join a winning team of 10,000+ people all dedicated to raising the bar – together.


If you have a strong drive for results, a desire to help us bring the world together through our fries, and are ready for a fresh challenge, we want to hear from you.

Job Description Summary

Sr Manager Strategy will analyze, coordinate, and facilitate analysis identifying information sources, gathering and interpreting data, and presenting findings related to customers, competitors, suppliers. Evaluation will support acquisitions and divestitures as well as partner in strategic planning activities that support the ongoing development of long-term business plans.



Ideal candidate will have a traditional consulting background with strong analytical rigor and problem-solving skillset. Most importantly a proven passion to identify issues, execute analysis, translate data into insights, and develop strategic recommendations across the Lamb Weston business. In addition, the role will require the thought leadership to develop implementation plans of strategic recommendations.



This role supports the Lamb Weston strategic planning process, competitive intelligence activities, M&A activities and competitive benchmarking.

Job Description


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES


  • To generate and maintain the adequate process and databases for gathering micro and macro economical, market, sector, competitive and product knowledge, follow-up analyses, distribution of content and competitive intelligence.
  • Partner with business unit & functional leaders on strategy development. Seek input, collaboration, and information from all the functions involved in Lamb Weston’s strategic planning process.
  • Research new markets, identify key trends, and translate data into actionable insights.
  • Support investment/M&A opportunities.
  • Evaluate inbound investment/M&A opportunities, develop business cases and working with Strategy and Finance leaders:
  • Research and collect information on markets, competition, analysis, defining information, and updating executive reporting.
  • Provide timely updated information relevant to the project.
  • Support the process and the project teams with accurate tailored analysis.
  • Serve as the internal leader and “go-to” expert for business intelligence and market information. Communicate and educate business leaders and others on implication(s) from findings.
  • Liaise with Business Intelligence Manager at LW’s Joint Venture in Europe to ensure consistency of data on a global basis.

CRITICAL CAPABILITIES


  • Financial Management – Ability to understand and apply internal and external business drivers, strategies, modeling to inform opportunities and strategic decisions.
  • Market/Business Intelligence - Maintain the market intelligence for the company. Generate market intelligence through market data collection on strategic, tactical and operational level. Translate market data into business intelligence. Ensuring business strategies and plans are built on fact-based market data.
  • Business Insights - Ability to identify, acquire and communicate insights, both specific customer and marketplace, which can serve as the basis for business strategy creation and initiatives/solutions. Ability to develop and execute impactful presentations of business proposals.
  • Relationship Management - Foster and maintain collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders to identify opportunities and promote business growth, through a shared understanding of success criteria to achieve current and future business goals.
  • Business Planning - Ability to facilitate, develop and implement comprehensive internal/external plans that deliver on objectives. Create models, develop business cases and automate data collection to update plans and inform strategy.
  • Market Segment & Product Optimization – Using a clear understanding of strategic direction, ability to understand how product optimization, assortment & new item initiatives and “segment-based” solutions may influence strategic direction.
  • Cross-Functional Resourcing – Ability to understand, apply and integrate knowledge of Lamb Weston, its customers and the industry as a whole, across functional areas, including supply chain, to optimize performance.

Basic & Preferred Qualifications


PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE / MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS


  • BS/BA degree required, Master’s preferred
  • Consulting experience preferred
  • Preferred experience in CPG Foodservice, retail and experience with Nielsen/Circana/Technomic/data essential data sets
  • Minimum of 5 years financial and quantitative expertise in a global environment
  • Ability to address the complex interrelationships among factors that influence the solutions to business issues in order to articulate key business strategies
  • Advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills
  • Demonstrate strong critical thinking and the ability to express ideas clearly, concisely and logically
  • Ability to make balanced and insightful decisions
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and able to see the “big picture”
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to communicate at all levels of an organization
  • Proven and confident presentation skills
  • Ability to travel with the possibility of international travel

Industry-Competitive Benefits

Coupled with our compensation and bonus incentive programs, our benefits deliver rewards that are market competitive. Some of the most attractive elements of our benefit programs include:

  • Health Insurance Benefits - Medical, Dental, Vision

  • Flexible Spending Accounts for Health and Dependent Care, and Health Reimbursement Accounts

  • Well-being programs including companywide events and a wellness incentive program

  • Paid Time Off

  • Financial Wellness – Industry leading 401(k) plan with generous company contributions, Financial Planning Services, Employee Stock purchase program, and Health Savings Accounts, Life and Accident insurance

  • Family-Friendly Employee events

  • Employee Assistance Program services – mental health and other concierge type services

Benefits may vary based on location, job role/level, job status, and/or the terms of any applicable collective bargaining agreements.

Anticipated Close Date

The anticipated close date is a good faith estimate for when this job will be closed. Some jobs may be unposted or filled earlier or later than the Anticipated Close Date depending on interview processes and business needs.Anticipated Close Date: 01/09/2027

Pay Transparency

In compliance with applicable state and local laws, Lamb Weston has opted to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role. This compensation is specific to this position and takes into account a number of variables. Actual compensation may be higher or lower in the range posted based on various factors, including, but not limited to, job duties, experience and expertise. A candidate's work location could also impact the actual compensation being outside of the range to reflect local cost of labor. A reasonable annual estimate of the range for this role is listed below.Pay Rate or Range: $146,840.00 - $220,250.00

raw.excerpt: Who We AreGreat Minds is a high-growth, mission-driven organization founded by educators in 2007.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Great Minds is a high-growth, mission-driven organization founded by educators in 2007. As a for-profit, Public Benefit Corporation, we believe all students deserve access to meaningful, challenging content—and all teachers deserve tools that are intuitive, effective, and built for the realities of today’s classrooms.

We develop high-quality, knowledge-rich math, science and ELA curricula grounded in research and designed in collaboration with educators. Our materials reflect real classroom needs and are built to drive lasting student outcomes.

We are committed to usability, coherence, and practical implementation—supporting teachers not just through curriculum, but with professional learning, purposeful technology, and responsive service that enable strong adoption and impact.

What We Build

Our products—Eureka Math and Eureka Math², Wit & Wisdom, Geodes, and the newly launched Arts & Letters ELA—are trusted by thousands of schools and districts nationwide.

  • Eureka Math is the most widely used math curriculum in the U.S., and is focused on balancing conceptual understanding, procedural fluency, and application.

  • Wit & Wisdom® and Arts & Letters ELA™ anchor our reading strategy with content-rich, grade-level instruction that integrates literature, history, and the arts, grounded in the science of reading. Geodes® complements our reading suite with decodable texts that pair phonics with meaningful content to support early literacy.

These programs reflect a shared belief in high expectations, joyful rigor, and deep respect for educators and students.

Where We’re Headed

Great Minds is entering a new stage of growth and product maturity. We are focused on building more connected, customer-informed experiences across the full educator journey—from curriculum to professional learning to platform and support.

Our long-term vision is to become a true partner in impact—not just delivering curriculum, but supporting educators in achieving outcomes at scale.


Job Purpose

Reporting to the Associate Director, Print Operations, the Senior Print Procurement Analyst owns strategic sourcing and procurement for Great Minds’ print manufacturing portfolio, one of the organization’s largest categories of annual spend. This role leads competitive sourcing events, builds the cost models that drive award decisions, negotiates pricing and terms with national commercial printers, and manages ongoing vendor performance to protect cost, quality, and delivery for curriculum products shipped to schools and districts nationwide.

The Senior Analyst works as a direct partner to Demand Planning, which sets title, quantity, and timing needs, and aligns with Finance, Product, and Sales to confirm annual print requirements. The role is expected to lead by example in applying AI-enabled tools to procurement: generating RFQs, normalizing and comparing supplier bids, building cost scenarios, automating purchase order workflows, and continuously improving how Great Minds buys print.


Responsibilities

Strategic Sourcing and Vendor Negotiation

  • Lead competitive sourcing events end to end: define requirements and specifications, issue RFQs/RFPs, evaluate supplier responses, and present award recommendations to Operations leadership.

  • Negotiate pricing, payment terms, capacity commitments, service levels, and multi-year agreements with national printers such as Quad/Graphics, Command Web Offset, and other commercial and specialty print manufacturers.

  • Develop and execute a category sourcing strategy for print, including vendor consolidation, capacity allocation across vendors, and qualification of new suppliers to reduce risk and cost.

  • Own measurable savings and cost-avoidance targets for print spend; track and report results to the supply chain leadership team.

  • Conduct cost analyses that account for unit price, paper, freight and landed cost, make-ready and run-length economics, inventory carrying cost, and risk.

  • Monitor paper and commodity market trends and advise leadership on timing, pricing exposure, and procurement strategy.

Analytics, Modeling, and Reporting

  • Build and maintain print cost models that interpolate vendor quotes by page count, quantity, and specification to support budgeting, reprint decisions, and what-if scenarios.

  • Develop vendor scorecards and performance analytics covering price, on-time delivery, quality, responsiveness, and capacity, and lead periodic vendor business reviews.

  • Plan, track, and report print spend, savings, and procurement metrics to the supply chain team; identify trends and recommend corrective action.

  • Support annual print budgeting and forecasting with Finance and Demand Planning, including variance analysis against plan.

AI-Enabled Procurement and Process Improvement

  • Apply AI tools (such as Claude) to generate RFQ documentation, analyze and compare supplier proposals, draft vendor communications, and streamline purchase order issuance, tracking, and reconciliation.

  • Identify, design, and implement automation and AI-driven improvements across print procurement; partner with Operations and Technology teams on tooling and workflow design.

  • Actively test, refine, train others on, and document AI-powered sourcing and procurement workflows so they become repeatable team practices.

  • Maintain key documentation, including SOPs, detailed ISBN print specifications, and vendor print status tracking.

Print Production and Vendor Management

  • Apply deep knowledge of print production (paper stock, binding, color, file formats, press requirements) to validate specifications and evaluate vendor capabilities and proposed alternatives.

  • Coordinate print schedules and vendor timelines with Demand Planning and production partners; proactively identify and escalate risks from capacity constraints, paper availability, or specification changes.

  • Manage purchase order creation, approval, and reconciliation in NetSuite in coordination with Finance, resolving invoice and pricing discrepancies with vendors.

  • Visit key vendors periodically to deepen relationships and knowledge of print manufacturing, and conduct vendor qualification and onboarding activities.

  • Collaborate with Operations leadership to align procurement strategy, supplier relationships, and policies across categories.

Requirements

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in print procurement, print sourcing, print manufacturing, or print operations, including direct vendor negotiation with commercial printers.

  • Demonstrated experience leading large, competitive RFQ/RFP processes and making data-driven award recommendations.

  • Strong analytical skills: advanced Excel (pivot tables, lookups, modeling) and the ability to build cost comparisons, and what-if scenarios from supplier proposals.

  • Working knowledge of print production specifications and processes (offset, digital, binding and finishing, paper) sufficient to verify vendor assumptions.

  • Hands-on experience with, or demonstrated aptitude and enthusiasm for, applying AI tools to sourcing, procurement, or operational workflows.

  • Experience managing purchase orders and procurement transactions in an ERP system (NetSuite or similar).

  • Strong negotiation, vendor management, communication, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

  • Highly results-oriented, with personal accountability, urgency, and persistence in completing high-quality work.

  • Ability to manage multiple sourcing events and projects simultaneously without missing critical deadlines, and to anticipate roadblocks with proactive solutions.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Smartsheet or similar project management software, and SharePoint or similar collaboration platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in educational publishing, curriculum development, or K–12 education.

  • Knowledge of instructional materials manufacturing, warehousing, and distribution, including landed cost and freight considerations.

  • Experience with AI-assisted sourcing, procurement analytics, or workflow automation platforms.

  • Experience with paper purchasing.

  • Working knowledge of NetSuite and Salesforce.

Required Education

Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, business, operations, information systems, or a related field.

Status

Full-time

Location

Remote

The expected base salary range for this position is $85,000-$93,000, however the offered salarymay be higher or lower than the above range dependent on numerous factors including, but not limited to location, work experience, skills and internal equity considerations. The base salary is not inclusive of benefits or other incentives.

A cover letter and resume are required to be considered for this position.

raw.description:
About the team

Zillow’s New Construction business is building a differentiated marketplace that helps homebuilders connect with high-intent buyers and market new and under-construction homes more effectively. Our Operations team helps the business grow by making it easier for Sales and Client Experience teams to serve builder partners efficiently and consistently.
As our products and sales motions evolve, we’re building simpler, more connected ways of working. We partner across Sales, Client Experience, Strategy, Product, Engineering, and Analytics to turn business priorities into scalable processes and reduce the manual work that gets in the way.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Sales Systems Manager to lead process improvement and automation across New Construction. You’ll look beyond individual tools to understand how work moves across teams, identify friction, and design workflows that help us grow without adding complexity or manual effort at every step.

You’ll own the business process improvement roadmap and drive automation initiatives from discovery through implementation and measurement. You’ll partner with our Strategy and Analytics team, Sales Technology Specialist and technical teams to deliver solutions, and with Sales Enablement and Sales leaders to make sure new ways of working are adopted and sustained.

You will get to

  • Own a prioritized process improvement and automation roadmap. Identify opportunities and prioritize based on business impact and effort.
  • Map and redesign end-to-end workflows. Follow work from sales activity and contracting through onboarding, product activation and billing handoffs. Remove unnecessary steps, clarify ownership and reduce manual exceptions.
  • Translate business needs into actionable requirements. Define future-state processes, business rules, data needs, acceptance criteria and success measures that systems and technical partners can execute against.
  • Use AI-enabled capabilities where appropriate, and partner with system owners and Engineering on solutions requiring deeper technical development.
  • Lead implementation from design through stabilization. Coordinate stakeholders, validate solutions through user acceptance testing, manage dependencies and resolve issues after rollout.
  • Connect processes across systems. Partner with Sales Technology to improve how frontline tools support the broader workflow, reducing manual steps and fragmented handoffs.
  • Build durable operating practices. Establish clear process documentation, exception handling, controls and ongoing ownership so improvements remain reliable as products and teams evolve.
  • Partner on adoption. Work with Sales Enablement and frontline leaders to translate changes into usable guidance, gather feedback and address barriers to adoption.
  • Measure results. Establish baselines and track cycle time, manual touchpoints, error and rework rates, adoption, and operational capacity gained. Use results to refine solutions and guide the next investment.
This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $112,800.00 - $180,200.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $107,200.00 - $171,200.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • You bring 8+ years of relevant experience in sales operations, revenue operations, business systems or process improvement, with a track record of delivering cross-functional workflow improvements.
  • You have led initiatives from identifying a problem through implementation, adoption and measuring results.
  • You understand sales and customer-facing operations, including CRM workflows and the handoffs between selling, contracting, onboarding, activation and billing.
  • You are comfortable working with Salesforce and understand how business rules and automation affect the user experience.
  • You have hands-on experience configuring workflow or automation solutions and know when to build directly versus engage technical partners.
  • You use process mapping and data to prioritize the changes that matter most.

raw.description:
Job Summary

As a growing value-based care organization, WellBe offers opportunities to gain broad exposure to the financial and operational drivers of full-risk Medicare Advantage arrangements.

The Senior Actuarial Analyst will support new business valuation, financial projections, actuarial reporting and IBNR reserving, and medical economics analyses. Working closely with actuarial leadership and cross-functional teams, this role will provide insights that inform strategic and operational decisions, with opportunities to mentor junior analysts.

The ideal candidate is analytical, self-motivated, and capable of independently managing complex analyses, investigating unexpected results, identifying underlying business drivers, and translating findings into actionable recommendations.

Job Description

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

New Business Valuation & Financial Modeling (60%)

  • Evaluate new payer partnerships and value-based contracting opportunities through experience analyses and financial projections.
  • Analyze medical claims, eligibility, and revenue data to assess utilization, medical cost trends, risk adjustment, and contract economics.
  • Develop and maintain financial models evaluating contract performance under varying membership, revenue, trend, and clinical intervention assumptions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve actuarial methodologies, automate processes, and enhance analytical efficiency.

Financial Reporting & Reserving (30%)

  • Support the Actuarial Manager in developing monthly financial reports, forecasts, and analyses to support leadership decision-making.
  • Provide mentorship and analytical guidance to the Actuarial Analyst.
  • Develop and enhance IBNR models, evaluate claims development patterns, and assess emerging experience and reserve adequacy.
  • Independently investigate financial variances, data inconsistencies, and unexpected results to identify root causes.
  • Perform thorough quality assurance and reasonableness reviews to ensure accurate, complete, and reliable deliverables.

Medical Economics & Strategic Analytics (10%)

  • Conduct medical economics analyses to assess healthcare utilization, cost drivers, clinical intervention savings, and opportunities for improved financial performance.
  • Support revenue forecasting, risk adjustment analyses, and other strategic initiatives through statistical modeling and advanced analytical techniques.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to address business questions, interpret analytical findings, and provide actionable recommendations.

Salary: $78,000 -$157,000/year

Job Requirements

Required Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 4 years of healthcare actuarial experience.
  • Experience analyzing large healthcare datasets, including medical claims, eligibility, and revenue.

Skills:

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Strong SQL skills.
  • Strong analytical, quantitative, and financial modeling capabilities.
  • Ability to independently investigate complex analytical issues, identify root causes, and develop practical solutions.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver accurate, complete, and timely work.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to evaluate assumptions and analytical results for reasonableness.
  • Ability to communicate complex findings to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Ability to connect financial and actuarial findings to business decisions and recommendations.

Certifications/Licenses:

  • None.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ASA designation or active pursuit of actuarial credentials with at least 4 exams completed.
  • Experience with Medicare Advantage, value-based care, or risk-bearing healthcare organizations.
  • Experience with IBNR reserving, financial reporting, forecasting, contract valuation, or medical economics.
  • Proficiency in Python or other programming languages.

Physical and Mental Requirements

  • Ability to lift up to 20 lbs.
  • Ability to sit for extended periods while performing computer-based analytical work.
  • Visual acuity and fine motor skills necessary to perform computer-based work, review data, and prepare reports.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, analyze complex information, exercise independent judgment, and meet established deadlines.

Work Environment

  • Chicago-based employees are able to work in the office.
  • Remote work is available for employees designated as remote.
  • Travel may be required up to 10% locally or nationally.
  • This position does not have direct supervisory responsibility.

Sponsorship Statement

WellBe does not offer employment-based visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Pay Transparency Statement

Compensation for this position will be disclosed in accordance with applicable state and local pay transparency laws.

Drug Screening Requirement:As a condition of employment, WellBe Senior Medical requires all candidates to successfully complete a pre-employment drug screening. Ongoing employment may also be contingent upon compliance with the company’s Drug-Free Workplace Policy, which includes random, post-accident, and reasonable suspicion drug testing. The company reserves the right to test for substances that may impair an employee’s ability to safely and effectively perform their job duties.

Employment with WellBe is at-will unless otherwise specified by contract. This job description does not constitute an employment contract.
