raw.description:
Alpha Compute is at the cutting edge of high-performance computing, delivering specialized GPU-as-a-Service (GPUaaS) infrastructure to the world's leading AI enterprises, foundational model builders, and research institutions. Built on top-tier, high-density data center environments and the latest NVIDIA architectures, we build and scale the critical underlying infrastructure that powers the next generation of AI.

Within our Global Infrastructure Business, we are seeking a highly technical and commercially savvy Sales Engineer to be a key driver of our growth strategy. This role will directly support Alpha Compute's sales organization, partnering closely with our Account Executives and Strategic Sales leadership to identify, architect, and capture new business opportunities within the AI hardware infrastructure space.

About the role

As a Sales Engineer, you are the technical linchpin supporting the broader sales organization. You will bridge the gap between complex AI hardware capabilities and our customers' business objectives. The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of the AI compute lifecycle, strong industry relationships, and the technical aptitude to effectively communicate the value of our high-density GPUaaS solutions to both engineering leaders and procurement officers.

You will translate complex client workloads (AI training and inference) into precise infrastructure configurations, proving that Alpha Compute's offerings provide the highest performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency in the market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Sales & Solution Architecture: Effectively articulate the technical advantages and value proposition of our GPUaaS solutions to technical (CTOs, ML Engineers, Data Center Architects) and non-technical audiences. Map customer AI workloads to precise hardware configurations (e.g., NVIDIA H100/B200 clusters, InfiniBand networking).
  • Sales Organization Support: Act as the primary technical resource for Account Executives and the VP of Strategic Sales during client engagements, ensuring the sales team has the architectural backing needed to close complex deals.
  • BOM Review & Validation: Meticulously review and validate complex Bill of Materials (BOMs) provided by hardware OEMs and compute brokers to ensure 100% technical accuracy, component compatibility, and alignment with client infrastructure requirements.
  • Strategic Business Development: Partner with the sales team to identify, qualify, and secure new business opportunities with direct customers, brokers, and tier-one/two suppliers. Generate unique value propositions tailored to target companies and OEMs.
  • Cost-Benefit & TCO Analysis: Research, model, and present detailed reports showing potential customers the financial cost-benefits and ROI of utilizing Alpha Compute’s GPUaaS versus alternative cloud or on-premise deployments.
  • Proposal & RFP Development: Act as the technical lead in the development of compelling proposals, bids, and technical responses to complex Requests for Information (RFIs) and Requests for Proposals (RFPs).
  • Relationship Management: Cultivate and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with key stakeholders, specifically focusing on customer engineering leads, technical brokers, and OEM partners.
  • Market Intelligence & Technical Trendspotting: Stay abreast of industry trends, market dynamics, competitor activities, and emerging technologies—with a specific focus on high-density electronics, AI hardware roadmaps, and thermal management/liquid cooling in data centers.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with our internal data center engineering, deployment, and quality teams to ensure seamless project execution and total customer satisfaction from design through handoff.
  • Industry Representation: Represent Alpha Compute at industry trade shows, technical conferences, and networking events to enhance brand visibility and demonstrate our technical leadership.

Qualifications

  • Experience: A minimum of 5-7 years of successful technical sales or pre-sales engineering experience within the GPUaaS, AI hardware, IaaS, or wholesale Data Center markets. Prior experience working directly with or for major hardware OEMs (e.g., SuperMicro, Dell) is considered a strong plus.
  • Technical Acumen: Deep, demonstrable understanding of GPUs, storage architectures, and high-performance networking (InfiniBand, Ethernet). You must understand the physical constraints of AI infrastructure, including power densities and thermal management.
  • BOM & Supply Chain Savvy: Proven experience reviewing, auditing, and pricing out extensive hardware BOMs from OEMs and brokers to ensure technical accuracy and viability.
  • Certifications: Active NVIDIA certifications (e.g., NVIDIA Certified Professional, Deep Learning Institute (DLI) credentials) are highly desirable and considered a strong plus.
  • Communication & Presentation: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You must be able to present complex technical architectures clearly and persuasively to C-suite executives and lead engineers alike.
  • Strategic & Analytical Thinking: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach. Ability to identify technical market opportunities and develop winning architectural strategies.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, or Computer Science preferred), or a related technical field. Highly relevant, proven industry experience may be considered in lieu of a specific degree.
  • Citizenship & Clearance: Must be a U.S. citizen and be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance if required by federal or defense-adjacent clients.

Personal Attributes

  • Strategic thinker with a proactive, consultative approach to technical sales.
  • Unmatched intellectual curiosity regarding AI hardware and data center economics.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth, and dynamic environment.
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and commercial creativity.

Why Partner With Alpha Compute?

  • Market-Leading Position: We are positioning ourselves to be the premier confidential compute destination for the AI revolution, backed by tier-1 data center partnerships and premium hardware.
  • Compensation & Incentives: $120,000 – $150,000/year, plus bonus, eligible for uncapped commission, alongside vesting stock.
  • Elite Culture: Work directly with seasoned industry pioneers and executive leaders who value speed, technical depth, and commercial creativity.

Alpha Compute is an equal opportunity employer.

raw.excerpt: Who We AreAt 8th Light, we bring life to the best ideas.
raw.description:
Who We Are

At 8th Light, we bring life to the best ideas.

Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Chicago, we are a technology solutions provider that partners with organizations to solve meaningful challenges and drive sustainable growth. From early-stage startups to global enterprises, we work across industries to optimize our clients’ digital products through product strategy innovation, experiential design, AI solutions, and deep engineering expertise.

Our commitment to quality means we deliver solutions we’re truly proud of, while our curiosity sparks innovation and breakthrough thinking. 8th Lights thrive in an environment that champions continuous education, fueling our growth through mentorship and hands-on work. We foster an open, collaborative culture grounded in honesty that builds trust, and believe true success is measured by the outcomes we create for our clients.

If this kind of work and our kind of people energizes you, you’ve found the right place.

Who You Are

You are a quality-driven, experienced engagement leader with a strong track record delivering complex, custom software and design engagements in consulting environments, over 10 years. You bring together delivery rigor, product thinking, client partnership, and people leadership enabling high-performing teams while driving meaningful outcomes for clients and for 8th Light.

You operate comfortably in increasingly data-intensive and AI-enabled environments, applying sound judgment to build trust, align stakeholders, and drive meaningful outcomes in complex delivery contexts.

You also have:

  • Deep hands-on experience with a variety of delivery methodologies and frameworks, including fluency with Agile (Scrum, Kanban), and the judgment to adapt PDLC and SDLC practices to context, scale, risk profile, and client maturity.
  • Proven experience integrating AI-enabled tools and workflows to rethink discovery, delivery, and decision-making.
  • Demonstrated success leading and overseeing multiple software engagements across a variety of clients, products, and industries.
  • A history of building trusted, long-term relationships with senior client delivery, product, and technology leaders.
  • Led inclusive, cross-functional forums that support discovery, alignment, decision-making, and problem-solving.
  • Made thoughtful recommendations and set clear direction in the face of ambiguity, risk, and competing priorities.
  • Served as a career manager and coach, supporting the growth, performance, and engagement of team members.
  • Communicated clearly and empathetically with executives, clients, and colleagues, balancing advocacy, transparency, and accountability.

What You’ll Do At 8th Light

As an engagement leader, you’ll oversee multiple client accounts, partnering closely with account and practice leaders to drive delivery excellence, client outcomes, and business growth. You’ll be accountable for engagement health, delivery quality, client relationships, utilization, and people leadership.

You’ll also:

  • Serve as an embedded, trusted advisor to client executives and senior leaders, providing guidance on delivery strategy, organizational dynamics, and decision-making in complex, evolving environments.
  • Act as the day-to-day orchestrator of client engagements, aligning teams, stakeholders, and delivery practices to ensure clarity, momentum, and consistent progress toward outcomes.
  • Participate in account planning, opportunity identification, and business development activities in partnership with account leadership.
  • Develop and maintain multi-horizon roadmaps, delivery plans, and release strategies across complex or long-running engagements.
  • Absorb complexity and work with teams and clients to resolve blockers, so teams can stay focused on outcomes.
  • Monitor and evolve engagement operating models as teams, clients, and products mature, adapting ways of working to support learning, scale, and long-term outcomes.
  • Build AI and agentic workflows into how you run engagements day to day, including status reporting, delivery planning, risk tracking, and client communications.
  • Coach direct reports and work with fellow career managers on consistent feedback and career growth, while modeling our Values and supporting an inclusive, collaborative culture.
  • Contribute to 8th Light by serving as a mentor, leading or designing workshops internally or for clients, representing 8th Light in the tech community, or supporting our hiring processes.

Strongly Preferred Skills

We work across many domains and encourage candidates with relevant experience to apply. We are particularly interested in candidates who bring experience in:

  • Account leadership, including participation in account planning, opportunity shaping, and client growth initiatives.
  • A strong technical background that enables effective partnership with senior engineers, architects, and designers.

How You’ll Be Supported

At 8th Light, we believe our people are our greatest asset. Their growth, well-being, and success shape our future.

Our wellness package is designed with the Whole YOU in mind and includes:

  • A robust L&D program featuring unlimited access to thousands of books, courses, and expert-led training on the O'Reilly learning platform.
  • Annual financial stipend and time allotment for learning & development
  • Coworking support for our global team
  • Flexible PTO
  • 12 weeks of new parent leave available for eligible employees

See our full list of Benefits.

A Note on Compensation

At 8th Light, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that is transparent, fair, and helps us attract and retain top talent in alignment with our company’s strategic growth goals and clients’ needs.

We benchmark our salaries using Geographic Structures to establish competitive pay ranges within the regions where 8th Lights live. Base compensation for our Engagement Manager position within our four US structures are as follows:

  • Structure 1 (Tampa Metro, Ohio, Virginia, Wisconsin)
    • RANGE: $139,462 - $174,327 USD
  • Structure 2 (Chicago Metro, Miami Metro, Philadelphia Metro, Raleigh Metro)
    • RANGE: $146,553 - $183,191 USD
  • Structure 3 (Austin Metro, Boston Metro, DC Metro)
    • RANGE: $156,008 - $195,010 USD
  • Structure 4 (Los Angeles, Seattle, New York City)
    • RANGE: $162,627 - $203,283 USD

This role is also eligible for our client service bonus plan. Reach out to for more relevant information pertaining to your local market.

8th Light Hubs and Geographies

As a remote-first company, 8th Light's culture is rooted in strong connections that extend across our teams, regions, and beyond client work. We are a distributed team across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom, with hubs in Chicago, London, Los Angeles, New York, and Seattle.

If you are hired into a hub, you will be a part of a team with regular rituals around coworking and community building. For team members outside of those cities, we offer access to coworking spaces to foster continued collaboration and connection across our global team.

In most cases, our consulting engagements do not require travel.

We hope to see you apply!

CPRA Notice for California Residents

A Note on Your Privacy

At 8th Light, one of our core values is Honesty that builds trust — and that shapes how we approach hiring. We want you to have a clear picture of who we are, what we're looking for, and how we handle your information throughout the process.

Before submitting your application, please take a moment to review our Global Candidate Privacy Notice. By applying, you acknowledge that you've read it.

You will be the main point of contact for LMS questions, working directly with stakeholders to solve problems, improve how things run, and keep learners and managers supported. This is a part-time evening schedule in India, so please read the hours carefully before applying.

  • Set up and maintain courses, curricula, and learning paths

  • Experience with LMS configuration, such as workflows, automations, and integrations

  • Experience with data migration or platform upgrades

  • Strong Excel skills, and comfort using AI tools to speed up your work

  • Ability to work 9 am to 1 pm EST (about 7:30 pm to 11:30 pm IST) consistently for the full contract

If you know Absorb inside and out and can reliably work 9 am to 1 pm EST (7:30 pm to 11:30 pm IST), we would love to hear from you! Apply now.

Remote Absorb LMS Administrator contract. Open to candidates anywhere in India. 20 hrs/week, 9 am to 1 pm EST (7:30 to 11:30 pm IST). 12 months.

About the Project

TSMG is looking for Quality control specialists to support an AI language project focused on improving speech recognition systems.

As a QC contributor, you will review completed language annotation tasks and ensure that AI-generated transcripts have been accurately converted into natural, readable display text according to the project guidelines. You will focus on identifying and correcting formatting, punctuation, capitalization, and text normalization issues.

What You Will Do

  • Review completed Display Transcription tasks for accuracy and consistency.
  • Compare the Display Transcription against the original lexical transcript and project guidelines.
  • Verify the correct use of:
  • punctuation;
  • capitalization;
  • numbers, dates, times, and currencies;
  • abbreviations and other text normalization rules.
  • Ensure that the original words and meaning have been preserved.
  • Identify and correct formatting or guideline-related errors.
  • Use the reference audio when necessary to verify ambiguous cases.
  • Apply project-specific quality standards consistently.
  • Provide accurate feedback and flag recurring issues when required.
  • Complete assigned QC tasks within project deadlines and productivity targets.

Requirements

  • Excellent written skills in the target language.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Good understanding of punctuation, capitalization, and written language conventions.
  • Ability to identify inconsistencies and errors in formatted text.
  • Ability to follow detailed guidelines and apply them consistently.
  • Basic computer skills and a reliable internet connection.
  • Ability to work independently and meet quality and productivity targets.
  • Previous experience in transcription, proofreading, quality control, annotation, or linguistic projects is a plus.
  • Training and project guidelines will be provided before the project starts.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to contribute to the development of AI and speech recognition technologies.
  • Flexible project-based work.
  • Clear guidelines and training before starting.
  • The opportunity to gain experience in AI language data and quality control projects.

PATH is a global nonprofit advancing health innovations for the people who need them most. With 50 years of experience, a global team of experts, and trusted partnerships spanning 70+ countries, PATH turns breakthroughs into better health for millions every single year.


Consultant – Data analysis and Technical writing (21 days@ 20000 INR/day)


Topic: Data analysis and Development of Peer-Reviewed Publications


Place of Work: Remote


Division: HIV-Hepatitis-STI (HHS)

1. Background


PATH is working on HIV, Hepatitis and STI for technical support to the national programs, operational research, and demonstration new/innovative diagnostic products. Based upon these program and research data, PATH develops technical and policy level documents for facilitating evidence-based decisions. Presently, PATH is looking for a consultant to data analysis, and technical writing, including peer-reviewed scientific publications.

2. Objective of the Assignment


  • To assist and develop peer-reviewed articles and technical document on the on the topics related to HIV, Hepatitis and STIs.

3. Scope of Work


The consultant will undertake the following activities:


3.1. Data analysis

  • Conduct data analysis on the pre-identified topics
  • Discuss and finalize the analytical findings
  • Develop appropriate tables and graphs in discussion with authors andco-authors

3.2. Draft, revise and finalize the article

  • Develop a draft article as per the template of an short-listed international journal with open access
  • Discuss and revise the article with inputs from authors/ Co-authors
  • Finalize the article with submit to the short-listed journal for publication.


4. Expected Deliverables and Timeline


The assignment will be undertaken over two months, from November to 31 December 2026.

Deliverable

Expected timeline

Data analysis and tabulation for two articles

Week 1

Discuss and finalize tables and graphs for two articles

Weeks 2

Draft peer-reviewed article for two articles

Week 3-4

Draft 1 peer-reviewed submission for review for two articles

Weeks 5

Revise and finalize

Weeks 6-7

Submission to journal

Week 8



5. Qualifications and Experience


  • Postgraduate degree (Master’s or PhD) in Public Health, Infectious Diseases, Epidemiology, Health Systems or another relevant discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience in conducting literature reviews, evidence synthesis, or scientific research.
  • Familiarity with data analysis using SPSS/ STATA
  • Strong skills in scientific writing, critical appraisal of research literature, and synthesis of technical evidence.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Experience engaging with technical experts and public health stakeholders will be an advantage.


6. Duration


The assignment will be for two months (November–December 2026). The consultant will work closely with the designated project team and submit deliverables according to the agreed timeline.



7. Reporting


The consultant will report to the designated project lead or technical focal point. The project team will provide feedback on the draft deliverables.



8. Expected Outputs


By the end of the assignment, the consultant will submit:

  • Two draft peer-reviewed articles/ Technical documents
  • Data analysis and the outputs associated with the articles.

raw.description:
Description

Centralized monitoring is an integral part of risk-based monitoring strategy, defined as the timely, remote review of accumulating subject and operational data to help distinguish between reliable and unreliable data, trends, outliers and unusual variability using analytics and statistical methods.

The Principal Central Monitor is responsible for leading the development of new tools, instruction guidelines and analyses essential for centralized statistical review of study data from study start through to study database lock. The Principal Central Monitor enables proactive identification, communication, escalation and management of risks at the study/country/site level.

More specifically, the Principal Central Monitor must:

  • Lead effort on the development of new tools, instruction guidelines and analyses within the area of specialty, including complex and collaborative approaches with other functions.
  • Lead the development and setup of study-specific tools, analyses, and centralized monitoring plans, ensuring that the monitoring approach is aligned with study risks, critical data, and critical processes.
  • Act as the strategic and technical lead for centralized monitoring across multiple studies and for function-wide initiatives, providing direction on complex analyses, resolving escalated issues, and establishing consistent approaches and standards.
  • Assist in creating tools, techniques and processes for automating risk-based monitoring tasks (data integration automation, data retrieval automation, data mapping automation, and automated report generation).
  • Act as mentor as well as train new team members and junior staff.
  • Identify data quality trends indicative of systematic errors and potential performance issues at study/country/site level and track evidence of issues and potential risks with support from senior team members.
  • Represent centralized monitoring in cross-functional study risk assessment meetings and provide expert guidance on identification, evaluation, prioritization, mitigation, and ongoing review of study risks.
  • Provide input to leadership as needed to support development of risk characterization and reporting.

Employees may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements

Education

  • ​​Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to clinical research.

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in central statistical monitoring with an overall 10 years of experience in two or more operational areas such as clinical monitoring, data management, drug safety, medical monitoring, biometrics, or project management.
  • Excellent understanding of statistical monitoring and Risk Based Quality Management (RBQM) and their impact on data integrity.
  • Thorough understanding of the processes associated with clinical study management, data management, and regulatory operations.
  • Knowledge of clinical trial database systems (EDC, IRT, CTMS etc.).
  • Excellent computer skills, with advanced knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and the ability to learn and use interactive computer systems and tools.
  • Advanced level of understanding of descriptive analysis e.g. means, medians, significance, confidence intervals.
  • Demonstrated expertise in analyzing and reviewing clinical data, ability to extract pertinent information from standard study documentation, such as protocols, electronic study data systems with the ability to learn to identify trending of site/study data.
  • Must be able to work in non-traditional work environments.
  • Fluent in English (excellent oral and written).
  • Must be able to communicate clearly and effectively at all levels within the organization and with external customers.
  • Must be a fast learner and able to understand new concepts quickly.
  • Prioritization skills with ability to plan, monitor and manage workload fluidly in response to changing project demands.
  • Good understanding of project protocol, project documentation including centralized monitoring and risk-based monitoring.
  • Broad working knowledge of the roles, functions and process of conducting clinical trials.
  • Must be able to manage time effectively, working with multiple functions and requirements.
  • Must have been involved in the use of trial management or data management systems

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule
  • Permanent full-time position
  • Ongoing learning and development

About Indero

A Global Clinical Leader In Dermatology!

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale.

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

Indero only accepts applicants who can legally work in Argentina.

raw.title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
raw.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
raw.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

raw.description:
Votre rôle

En tant que Consultant Principal au sein de notre équipe Secteur Public, vous aurez l'opportunité de contribuer activement à la montée en puissance de nos activités auprès des collectivités territoriales et des acteurs publics locaux (bailleurs sociaux, établissements publics...).

Vous accompagnez directement les directions générales et leurs équipes métiers, SI ou les élus locaux dans la définition de leur trajectoire de transformation. Grâce à votre maîtrise des enjeux territoriaux et des enjeux et tendances technologiques, vous menez des missions de conseil pour répondre aux besoins des usagers, des agents et des organisations en faisant levier sur le numérique.

Vos principales missions

Piloter et coordonner des projets complexes et stratégiques de transformation digitale, organisationnelle et servicielle pour les acteurs du secteur public local, en garantissant la performance, la qualité du service rendu et la conformité réglementaire.

  • Accompagnement stratégique : Collaborer avec les directions générales et DSI pour élaborer et mettre en œuvre leur stratégie numérique et schémas directeurs du numérique et des SI associés, optimiser les investissements IT et concevoir des trajectoires de mutualisation territoriale.
  • Gestion de la Relation Usagers : Cadrer et déployer des stratégies de relation usagers multicanales pour bâtir un point d'entrée unique, lisible et accessible, tout en optimisant la coordination entre les accueils et les services instructeurs.
  • Transformation des organisations : Réaliser des audits organisationnels, accompagner la modernisation des processus métiers et piloter la conduite du changement auprès des agents territoriaux.
  • Pilotage de projets : Assurer la gouvernance et le suivi de bout en bout des programmes de transformation complexes, garantir l'atteinte des résultats et élaborer des business cases solides.
  • Développement commercial : Contribuer à la croissance de l'équipe par l'identification d'opportunités, le portage de nouvelles offres et le pilotage des réponses aux appels d'offres publics.
  • Veille sectorielle & Innovation : Étudier et capitaliser sur les innovations territoriales, notamment l'intelligence artificielle, la valorisation de la donnée publique et les démarches de territoires durables et connectés.
  • Développement des talents : Encadrer et faire progresser les consultants, partager vos connaissances et cultiver un esprit d'équipe collaboratif et entrepreneurial.

Votre profil

  • Expérience : Vous justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans le conseil en management ou au sein d'une collectivité territoriale, avec une pratique confirmée du pilotage de projets de transformation digitale, d'organisation ou de déploiement de solutions GRU.
  • Connaissance du Secteur Public Local : Maîtrise de l'environnement des collectivités/bailleurs sociaux, de leur gouvernance, de leurs compétences et du Code de la commande publique.
  • Compétences en pilotage de projets : Capacité démontrée à structurer des démarches stratégiques, à animer des comités de direction et à fédérer des acteurs pluridisciplinaires autour d'objectifs communs.
  • Expertise métier et technologique : Solide compréhension des architectures SI, des enjeux de gestion de la relation usagers, de la protection des données personnelles et de la cybersécurité territoriale.
  • Qualités humaines : Excellentes capacités de communication, d'écoute et de négociation. Leadership naturel, sens politique et aptitude à instaurer des relations de confiance durables.
  • Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur, Grande École de management, IEP / Sciences Po ou Master 2 universitaire.
  • Langue : Un niveau d'anglais professionnel est souhaitable.

Qualités personnelles

  • Rigueur, autonomie et sens de l’organisation.
  • Sens du service public, diplomatie et écoute.
  • Esprit d’analyse, esprit de synthèse et curiosité intellectuelle.
  • Capacité d’initiative, dynamisme et goût pour le travail en équipe.

Chez Orange, seules vos compétences comptent

La diversité au sein de nos équipes constitue une force pour le collectif et un vecteur d’innovation. Orange est une entreprise handi-accueillante : n’hésitez pas à nous faire part de vos besoins spécifiques.

Entité

Orange Business est un intégrateur réseau et numérique qui couvre toute la chaîne de valeur du monde digital, permettant à ses clients de se concentrer sur les initiatives stratégiques qui transforment durablement leurs activités.

La direction Orange Consulting est le cabinet de conseil en management et transformation digitale d'Orange Business. Elle accompagne les entreprises et les institutions en France et à l'international sur l'ensemble de leurs problématiques stratégiques, organisationnelles et technologiques.

Travailler chez Orange Consulting, c'est rejoindre un cabinet à taille humaine qui offre à ses collaborateurs des perspectives d'évolution claires et accessibles à travers des parcours de formations spécialement conçus par et pour nos consultants.

Votre rôle

Notre entité, intégrée au sein d’Orange Business, dispose de compétences pointues et reconnues dans l'intégration de solutions globales en Connectivité (LAN/WIFI/WAN/SDWAN/Data Center/MPN), Workplace (O365/Teams, Cloud Telephony, Digital Building, Mobilité) & IoT auprès de clients grands comptes et entreprises. Son rôle est de simplifier la vie digitale de ses clients, en leur offrant les meilleures expériences collaboratives tout en garantissant la meilleure connectivité grâce à des offres sur mesure.Objectif général Assurer la supervision globale et la gestion opérationnelle de projets complexes liés aux réseaux privés, en garantissant leur livraison dans le respect des délais, des coûts, de la qualité et des exigences de sécurité, tout en assurant une couverture radio optimale si nécessaire.

Missions principales :

1. Pilotage et supervision du portefeuille de projets

  • Superviser de manière autonome un portefeuille de projets liés aux réseaux privés, en assurant leur cohérence, leur avancement et leur conformité aux engagements contractuels.
  • Assurer le monitoring de l’activité, la collecte d’informations (reportings, finances, plans de charge, ressources) et la construction d’indicateurs de performance.
  • Piloter la performance des projets, identifier les alertes et mettre en œuvre des actions correctives.

2. Gestion de la planification, des coûts et des risques

  • Planifier, estimer et suivre les coûts, en respectant le budget alloué.
  • Anticiper et gérer les risques liés aux projets, notamment ceux liés à la couverture radio, à la sécurité et à la conformité réglementaire.
  • Mettre en place des mesures pour éviter ou atténuer les impacts négatifs.

3. Conception et déploiement technique

  • Superviser la conception technique des réseaux privés, en intégrant la couverture radio si nécessaire (sites, antennes, fréquences).
  • Organiser et suivre les phases de déploiement, de tests et de validation.
  • Garantir la conformité aux normes techniques, de sécurité et environnementales.

4. Coordination et gestion des équipes

  • Coordonner les équipes internes et externes, y compris celles en charge de la couverture radio et des équipements radio.
  • Favoriser la collaboration entre les diAérentes parties prenantes pour assurer la cohérence du projet.
  • Animer des réunions de suivi et de revue de projet.

5. Amélioration continue et bonnes pratiques

  • Participer à l’amélioration continue des processus et des méthodes de gestion de projet.
  • Capitaliser sur les bonnes pratiques et partager les retours d’expérience.
  • Organiser des revues diagnostics pour analyser la conduite de projet, la maîtrise technique, et identifier des axes d’amélioration.

6. Relation client et reporting

  • Maintenir une relation de confiance avec le client, en assurant une communication claire et régulière.
  • Rendre compte de l’avancement, des risques et des enjeux du projet.
  • Participer aux activités d’avant-vente pour définir les solutions techniques adaptées.

7. Respect des normes et de la sécurité

  • Veiller au respect des consignes de sécurité, santé et environnement sur tous les sites.
  • Assurer la remontée des dysfonctionnements et la mise en œuvre des bonnes pratiques.

Votre profil

Compétences requises

  • Expertise en gestion de projets réseaux privés, infrastructures IT et radiofréquences.
  • Connaissance approfondie des équipements radio, antennes, sites de déploiement, et couverture radio.
  • Maîtrise des méthodologies de gestion de projet (PMI, ITIL, CMMI).
  • Capacité à coordonner des équipes pluridisciplinaires et à gérer des projets complexes.
  • Bonne communication écrite et orale, en français et en anglais.
  • Sens de l’organisation, rigueur et leadership.

Expérience requise

  • Minimum 10 ans d’expérience dans la gestion de projets techniques complexes.
  • Au moins 5 ans dans la gestion de projets liés aux réseaux et infrastructures.
  • Expérience significative dans la gestion de projets intégrant la couverture radio ou des technologies sans fil.

Entité

Orange Business est un intégrateur réseau et numérique qui comprend toute la chaîne de valeur du monde digital, permettant à nos clients de se concentrer sur les initiatives stratégiques qui font avancer leur business. Chaque jour, vous collaborerez avec une équipe dédiée à la livraison de solutions globales cohérentes et durables, peu importe où nos clients opèrent. Avec plus de 30 000 salariés en Europe, Asie, Amérique et Afrique, nous proposons un environnement dynamique et innovant permettant de développer et affiner vos compétences. Nous offrons des opportunités passionnantes dans la data et le digital, le cloud, l'IA, la cybersécurité, ou encore l'IoT et le digital workspace.

raw.description:
Rockstar is recruiting for a digital product studio that specializes in turning ideas into extraordinary digital experiences. This client is a dynamic, remote-first team of savvy professionals known for pushing creative boundaries and delivering high-quality, user-centered products through a collaborative and lean approach.

This client is building a bench of talented product designers for upcoming client work. They are looking for mid-to-senior-level freelance designers who can bring strong UX thinking, sharp visual design skills, and a collaborative spirit to the team.

What they're looking for

If you're a seasoned product designer with a passion for digital excellence, this opportunity is for you. You’ve honed your craft over the years, with a deep understanding of UX design, visual storytelling, and collaborative product development.

You’re equally comfortable working independently and alongside a cross-functional team. You manage your time well, take ownership of your work, and make confident decisions with minimal oversight. You’re fluent in tools like Figma and Adobe Suite, and you bring a user-first mindset to everything you do — whether designing mobile apps or contributing to product strategy.

If you're the type of designer who pushes creative boundaries, communicates clearly, and still knows how to have a little fun in the process — they’d love to hear from you.

The Details

As a Product Design Contractor, you’ll contribute to a range of client-facing projects, collaborating with the Chief Creative Officer and team across the following areas:

  • Digital Product Design (Web & App): Shape intuitive experiences by applying research, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that elevate functionality and user engagement.
  • User Research & Discovery: Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to inform feature planning and prioritization. Help build products grounded in real user needs and business goals.
  • User Experience (UX): Apply UX methodologies like journey mapping, user flows, and usability testing to define products beyond UI — ensuring seamless and strategic user experiences.
  • Visual Design: Lead visual direction on select projects, producing compelling layouts and assets that translate beautifully across platforms — from product to marketing.
  • Presentation Collateral: Design high-impact presentation decks and visuals that bring ideas to life for clients and stakeholders.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering and product teams by providing annotated designs, QA support, and input during handoff and development.
  • Additional Design Support: Contribute to project-related needs like case studies, marketing assets, and content design for social media or internal documentation.

Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of experience in product and visual design, with a strong focus on digital experiences across web and/or mobile
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, including user research, usability testing, and translating insights into design decisions
  • Demonstrated ability to own features or tracks of work with minimal oversight — from wireframes to high-fidelity execution
  • Comfortable leading or contributing to discovery phases and helping define product direction in collaboration with strategy and engineering
  • Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, with experience working in a Mac environment
  • Familiarity with remote collaboration tools such as Google Suite, Slack, Zoom, Jira, and Harvest
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a team-first mindset and the ability to clearly articulate design rationale
  • Organized, proactive, and able to manage your own time in a fast-paced, remote work environment
  • Bonus: experience working in client-facing or agency settings where flexibility, autonomy, and cross-functional teamwork are key

What to Expect from the Process

This is a contract-based role and part of an ongoing effort to build relationships with experienced designers for future client projects. Interviews are being conducted on a rolling basis, and while there may not be immediate openings, strong candidates will be added to the contractor roster and considered as new work becomes available.

Hiring timelines are directly tied to the sales pipeline, so project start dates vary. The team is committed to matching the right designer to the right project — and they will reach out when there’s a fit.

About the Client

This client is a digital product studio that brings together design, technology, and creativity to build meaningful experiences. They believe in pushing boundaries, working collaboratively, and delivering high-quality products that they are proud of.

The remote-first culture values autonomy, trust, and open communication. The team is always exploring new ideas, evolving their process, and building products that move the needle for their clients.

This position is remote and open to all candidates, but applicants based in New York City are prioritized for potential in-person collaboration.

Wil jij werken aan uitdagende spoorprojecten en een directe bijdrage leveren aan de duurzame mobiliteit van Nederland? Jouw rol

Als projectmanager ben jij de drijvende kracht achter de realisatie van projecten voor o.a. ProRail. Je zorgt ervoor dat alles op rolletjes loopt: van de voorbereiding en uitvoering tot en met de afronding. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen techniek, planning, financiën en stakeholders, en weet teams te motiveren om samen de beste resultaten te behalen.
Wat je zoal doet

✅ Leiden en coördineren van multidisciplinaire projectteams;

✅ Afstemmen met opdrachtgevers zoals ProRail en andere stakeholders;

✅ Bewaken van planning, budget en kwaliteit;

✅ Zorgen voor een veilige en efficiënte uitvoering van het werk.

Requirements

Meer bij Dura Vermeer
Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en langetermijnvisievormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Hier zit jij op je plekJe maakt onderdeel uit van de vakgroep Projectmanagement. De verschillende vakgroepen kenmerken zich door de drive om succes te hebben en gezamenlijk de projecten tot een goed einde te brengen. Wanneer je vragen hebt of tegen problemen aanloopt, dan staan je collega's klaar om je te helpen. Samen wordt er gekeken naar een ideale oplossing. Samenwerking en collegialiteit kenmerken de sfeer binnen Dura Vermeer Railinfra.

Wat we van jou verwachten

🔹 Ruime ervaring in een verantwoordelijke projectmanagement functie in de bouw of rail- infra;

🔹 Kennis van contractvormen zoals UAV-GC;

🔹 Een proactieve en oplossingsgerichte mindset;

🔹 Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een talent voor samenwerken en stakeholdermanagement;

Wat wij bieden

✔ Een goed salaris afhankelijk van de meegebrachte kennis, niveau en werkervaring beginnend bij € 7.025,- tot € 8.781,- bruto per 4 weken en dus 13 maal per jaar!;

✔ 43 vrije dagen volgens de Rail CAO, volop ruimte voor een goede werk-privébalans;

✔ Een leaseauto en alle tools die je nodig hebt om je werk goed te doen;

✔ Uitgebreide ontwikkelmogelijkheden: trainingen, opleidingen en doorgroeikansen;

✔ Een team van gedreven professionals met wie je samen de mooiste spoorprojecten realiseert;

Maak impact op de spoorsector!

Wil jij een sleutelrol spelen in de realisatie van belangrijke spoorprojecten? Dan komen we graag met je in contact! Solliciteer direct of neem voor meer informatie contact op met Jeffrey Smit, bereikbaar via 06-41176005 of Of neem contact op met onze directeur; Jaap van der Star. Hij kan je meer vertellen over de inhoud van deze functie. Je kan hem bereiken op 06-53599848

raw.description:
About the role

Division 50 runs outbound sales development for our clients — companies across many different industries who hire us to fill their calendars with qualified meetings. As a UK Cold Calling SDR, you sit on the phones every day calling into the UK market on behalf of those clients. You learn each client's product, ideal customer, and pitch, then dial their target accounts, get past the brush-off, and book qualified meetings their closers actually show up for.

This is a phone-first role. You are not selling Division 50's own services — you represent our clients. The work changes as our client roster changes, so you ramp fast on new products and industries and keep your numbers steady through the switch. This is fully remote, working UK business hours.

What you'll do

  • Make high-volume cold calls into the UK market on behalf of Division 50 clients across different industries (B2B SaaS, professional services, home services, healthcare, finance, and more)
  • Learn each client's offer, ideal customer profile, and objection patterns quickly, and adapt your pitch to whoever you're calling that week
  • Open cold calls that start with a brush-off, hold the line, and turn them into booked, qualified meetings
  • Qualify prospects against each client's criteria before you book, so the meetings that land on a closer's calendar are real
  • Log every dial, conversation, and booked meeting in the CRM so the client and your manager can see the activity
  • Follow up on warm inbound leads for clients who run them — qualify, and book the meeting (this is a plus, not the core of the job)
  • Hit daily dial and weekly meeting-booked targets, and keep them steady even when you switch to a new client or industry

What we're looking for

  • Proven cold-calling experience dialing into the UK market — you've spent your day on outbound phones and have the call volume to show for it
  • A track record of booking qualified B2B meetings from cold dials, with real numbers (dials per day, meetings per week)
  • You ramp fast on a new product or industry and can sound credible on the phone after a short briefing
  • You handle the early brush-off — "not interested," "send me an email," "we're not looking" — and keep the conversation alive
  • Clear, confident spoken English and a natural phone manner UK prospects respond to
  • Disciplined with CRM hygiene and daily activity targets
  • Comfortable with a smaller base + high uncapped commission tied to booked meetings

Nice to have

  • Experience qualifying warm inbound leads as well as cold outbound
  • Time spent in an agency, BPO, or outsourced-SDR setting where you carried multiple client accounts at once
  • Familiarity with dialers, sales engagement tools, and CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce, Close, or similar)
  • Experience calling into more than one industry or buyer type

About us & how to apply

Division 50 is a B2B lead generation and marketing agency. We run appointment-setting and outbound SDR programs for clients across many industries, alongside paid ads, SEO, and social media management. This SDR role sits inside our client-fulfillment team — the people who actually pick up the phone and book the meetings our clients pay us for.

To apply, complete the short application and screening questions. Strong applicants move to a conversation with Raffi, our AI recruiter, where we'll go deep on your cold-calling background. We hire for outbound skill and consistency, not industry pedigree.

raw.title: Principal Product Designer, eCommerce
raw.excerpt: Who We Are: Therabody® is the wellness tech leader with a mission to inspire and enable everybody to feel, perform and look their best.
raw.description:
Who We Are:

Therabody® is the wellness tech leader with a mission to inspire and enable everybody to feel, perform and look their best. Therabody’s product ecosystem includes category-creating innovations in wellness, performance and beauty products, proprietary software and digital content. Not only is it part of our brand ethos to help others, but we are also defining the cutting edge of wellness technology while winning accolades such as Fast Company’s Brands That Matter, Oprah's Favorite Things and the TIME Best Inventions 2025 award.

We’re committed to continuous innovation and surround ourselves with specialists, thought leaders, and experts - inside and outside of the office. If you thrive in creative environments, are concerned with big, innovative ideas, love to collaborate, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and are driven to succeed, get in touch with us. Together we can push the limits of what can be achieved for everybody.

Who We’re Looking For:

We’re looking for a freelance UX/UI Designer to drive the creation of engaging, high-converting shopping experiences on Therabody.com. You’ll work hands-on across the full purchase journey—product discovery, browsing, cart, checkout, and post-purchase—translating briefs and business goals into thoughtful, user-centered designs. This is a collaborative, execution-focused role where you’ll partner with our product, engineering, ecommerce, and brand teams to ship work that looks great and performs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end design of the Therabody.com shopping experience across product detail pages, collection and category pages, search and discovery, cart, checkout, and post-purchase — for a global, multi-market storefront.
  • Set the ecommerce design direction: define the UX patterns, interaction standards, and quality bar that web PMs and engineers build against.
  • Frame the problem before designing the solution — synthesize analytics, session replay, research, and merchandising input into a clear point of view on where the experience is losing customers and what to do about it.
  • Partner with the product and analytics teams to build and prioritize an experimentation roadmap; design the variants, define what a win looks like, and read the results honestly — including when your design lost.
  • Extend and steward Therabody’s design system for commerce surfaces: contribute reusable components, document usage, and eliminate one-off patterns rather than adding to them.
  • Work directly with front-end engineers on specs, handoff, and design QA — you are accountable for what actually ships, not just what was designed.
  • Design within the realities of our commerce platform (Shopify), and make deliberate trade-offs between what is ideal, what is buildable, and what is worth building now.
  • Bring design into scoping and roadmap conversations early, so that sequencing, feasibility, and customer impact are weighed together rather than after the fact.
  • Run lean, fast research and usability testing to validate direction — and know when a five-user test is enough and when it isn’t.
  • Raise the level of design practice across the team through critique, mentorship, and example.

About You

  • 7+ years of product or UX design experience, with deep, demonstrable focus on ecommerce — ideally DTC, consumer hardware, or subscription commerce.
  • A history of leading significant design work as an individual contributor — setting direction, aligning partners, and raising the quality bar through craft and clear thinking.
  • A portfolio that shows real ecommerce depth: product pages, discovery and comparison flows, cart and checkout — with the reasoning, constraints, and outcomes behind the work, not just the final screens.
  • Expert in Figma, including building and maintaining component libraries, variables, and design systems at scale. Fluent with AI-assisted design tooling and clear-eyed about where it accelerates work and where it produces plausible-looking noise.
  • Comfortable working in analytics and behavioral tools — GA4, FullStory, or similar — well enough to pull your own data, form a hypothesis, and defend it.
  • Deep familiarity with Shopify or comparable commerce platforms, and a practical understanding of their UX constraints, theme and app ecosystem, and checkout limitations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication. You can walk an executive audience through a recommendation, the trade-offs you considered, and the risks you accepted — and hold your position under scrutiny.
  • Exposure to conversational or AI-assisted shopping experiences, product finders, or guided selling.
  • Experience designing for app and web as a connected ecosystem rather than separate surfaces.

raw.description:
We are seeking a Sr. Software Product Manager to lead our software-enabled hardware journey. Our devices have long earned customers' trust; we are building the software layer that extends that value across the workflow.

In this role, you will lead the way in defining and delivering software products our customers love. You will act as a bridge between our established hardware product organization and the software capabilities we are building around it. You will help define where software workflow solutions belong on the overall product roadmap, balance investment between bold feature innovations and the steady improvement of the core platform. You will establish software product management best practices needed to succeed— from product definition to sales enablement to customer implementations. This role is based in the U.S. and works closely with product, engineering, sales, and customer success teams around the world.

Who You Are

  • Experienced software product leader with a strong history of building workflow software that interacts with hardware devices.
  • Pragmatic bridge builder who can translate between hardware engineering culture and software product thinking
  • Strategic thinker who can balance bold new software initiatives against the discipline required to sustain a core platform.
  • Structured operator who can stand up new best practices — for product definition, sales, and implementation
  • Effective global collaborator, comfortable working across time zones, functions, and cultures

Key ResponsibilitiesSoftware Roadmap Strategy & Integration

  • Partner with hardware product management, engineering, and executive leadership to integrate software workflow solutions into the company-wide product roadmap.
  • Assess where software creates the most customer and business value and translate that into a prioritized software roadmap.
  • Define and defend prioritization tradeoffs between strategic feature innovations and ongoing core platform improvements.
  • Build the business case for software investment, including ROI, adoption, and consideration of business models influenced by hardware.
  • Work with Product Planning team to explore bold innovative solutions and markets.
  • Work closely with hardware Product Managers where software creates value alongside devices in customer workflows.

Product Definition & Best Practices

  • Establish repeatable best practices for defining successful software workflow products and success metrics suited to hardware-adjacent software.
  • Create and maintain process and templates for defining and delivering value in each release.
  • Work very closely with Product Owners align on customer value, definition, scoping, and prioritization of feature backlog.
  • Champion a consistent software product release cycle that complements existing hardware NPI release plans.
  • Lead prioritization cadence to communicate software roadmap priorities, needs, and tradeoffs to leadership.

Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement

  • Partner with sales and commercial teams to define and refine ideal customer profiles and the sales process for hardware/software combined solutions.
  • Develop sales enablement materials, pricing frameworks, and tiered offerings that reflect customer needs.
  • Coach and enable the sales organization to position and sell workflow software alongside hardware.

Customer Implementation & Success

  • Work closely with and coach customer success and sales engineering teams on pre-sale nurturing and post-sale implementations, ensuring customer satisfaction.
  • Identify and resolve common points of friction in onboarding, adoption, and change management.
  • Gather customer feedback and usage data to continuously improve product definition and implementation practices.

QualificationsRequirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field
  • 7+ years of software product management experience, including direct experience managing workflow software products.
  • Demonstrated experience leading software products through transformational growth cycles.
  • Strong understanding of B2B sales processes, particularly for combined hardware/software solutions
  • Experience building or scaling software product management best practices.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with experience working across global teams and time zones.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%, domestically and internationally.

Preferred

  • MBA or equivalent strategic experience
  • Experience in a medical device, industrial, or other hardware-first industry undergoing digital product transformation.
  • Familiarity with IoT, connected devices, or embedded systems.

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers use and love our software products. Adoption and business outcomes are accelerating due to your leadership.
  • Bold software workflow solutions are integrated into the company's core product roadmap and portfolio prioritization process.
  • A clear, well-understood framework exists for balancing strategic innovation with core platform investments.
  • Sales and customer implementation teams have documented, repeatable best practices for hardware/software solutions.
  • The organization has a strong, reusable foundation for future software product development.

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

About Fluke Health Solutions

Comprised of four industry leaders—Fluke Biomedical, LANDAUER, RaySafe, and Victoreen — Fluke Health Solutions (FHS) leads the biomedical and radiation detection markets with innovative products and services that help keep customers, patients, and clients safe.Fluke Biomedical leads the world in manufacturing biomedical test equipment like defibrillator analyzers and digital pressure meters. LANDAUER measures radiation exposure with dosimeter and radiation monitoring badges. RaySafe is the worldwide leader of X-ray test equipment, real-time staff dosimetry, and radiation survey meters. And Victoreen instruments are the trusted source for radiation monitoring systems and quality assurance for nuclear power professionals.At FHS, we believe in your potential — your ability to learn, grow and contribute in meaningful ways. raw.description:
Symmetrio is recruiting a Director of Professional Services (Healthcare SaaS) for our customer, a rapidly growing international healthcare technology organization focused on advanced healthcare technology solutions for complex cancer workflows.

This is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing customer onboarding, technical implementations, application support operations, escalation governance, and service quality standards within a regulated healthcare SaaS environment. The Director of Professional Services (Healthcare SaaS) will partner closely with Customer Success, Product, Software Engineering, Platform, and Clinical teams to ensure the delivery of secure, predictable, and high-quality technology services to customers. As the senior leader responsible for customer-facing technical service operations, the Director of Professional Services (Healthcare SaaS) will establish structured frameworks, define service standards, manage executive-level escalations, and build a high-performing technical service team. The position will report to the VP of Technology & Security.

This Is a full-time remote position. Ideal candidate will be based In Central or Western United States.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop a high-performing Technology Service Operations function, including Support and Implementation resources.
  • Lead end-to-end technology service delivery across onboarding, integrations, application support, and ongoing operational support.
  • Establish and maintain structured service frameworks including SLAs, escalation pathways, case management standards, and operational reporting
  • Ensure repeatable and secure onboarding processes for healthcare customers, including authentication, identity configuration, and connectivity validation
  • Monitor service performance metrics and proactively address operational risks
  • Drive continuous improvement across support tooling, documentation standards, and service workflows
  • Act as the senior operational escalation point for customer technology and service-related matters
  • Partner with Customer Success and Sales to support account health, renewals, and expansion initiatives
  • Engage directly with hospital IT leadership, clinical stakeholders, and executive sponsors where required
  • Provide structured service reviews and operational reporting to internal leadership and customers
  • Ensure clear, professional, and timely communication during critical incidents or service-impacting events
  • Own regional coordination of customer-impacting technology incidents.
  • Establish structured incident response standards and communication protocols
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Reliability teams to address systemic risks and strengthen platform resilience.
  • Oversee technical onboarding processes including secure connectivity, SSO, directory integrations, and network configuration validation
  • Partner with Engineering and Platform teams to streamline onboarding workflows and reduce time-to-value
  • Identify recurring onboarding friction points and implement operational or tooling improvements
  • Ensure integrations with customer IT environments meet security and compliance expectations
  • Establish clear role definitions, accountability frameworks, and performance standards.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, and professional development within the team.
  • Foster a culture of structured troubleshooting, operational discipline, and customer-first thinking.
  • Ensure alignment between service operations, product development, and commercial teams.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • 8+ years’ experience in B2B SaaS service delivery, technical operations, or IT service management roles
  • 3+ years’ experience leading customer-facing technical teams
  • Demonstrated experience working with enterprise or healthcare customers in regulated environments
  • Demonstrated experience identifying implementation challenges for enterprise healthcare customers using SaaS software
  • Strong understanding of SaaS onboarding, application support models, incident management, and escalation frameworks
  • Experience partnering with Engineering and Platform teams to resolve cross-functional technical service issues
  • Familiarity with identity and authentication systems, including SAML or OIDC and platforms such as Auth0 or Entra ID / Active Directory
  • Experience with cloud-based application environments, secure customer connectivity models, and AWS
  • Experience defining and monitoring SLAs, KPIs, and operational dashboards
  • Strong executive-level communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience in healthcare technology environments advantageous
  • Based in the Central or Western United States is preferred
